summary: Two dominant tokenisation algorithms are used by modern language models: byte-pair encoding (BPE) and UnigramLM. These differ along two orthogonal axes: their optimisation objective (compression vs. log-likelihood) and their search procedure (bottom-up merging vs. top-down pruning). Existing comparisons confound these axes, making it unclear whether their observed differences stem from what is being optimised vs. how it is being optimised. We disentangle the two by introducing two new tokenisation algorithms that complete this 2x2 design space: BottomUpLL, a bottom-up likelihood-based tokeniser, and TopDownComp, a top-down compression-based tokeniser. We train language models with tokenisers produced by each algorithm, varying: model size, vocabulary sizes, and domain (English-only vs. multilingual). Evaluating models on bits-per-byte, we find that the search procedure -- not the objective -- is the dominant factor: bottom-up tokenisers consistently achieve lower bits-per-byte in most settings. Evaluating models on the BLiMP task, however, shows no consistent relationship between design choice and performance. Overall, our results disentangle the effect of tokeniser design choices on language modelling performance, offering concrete guidance for their more principled construction.
title: Objective vs. Search: Decomposing What Makes a Good Tokeniser
comment: Accepted at EMNLP 2026. 20 pages, 4 figures, 10 tables. Code: this https URL
title_translated: 目标与搜索：分解优质分词器的构成因素
summary_translated: 现代语言模型广泛采用两种主流的分词算法：字节对编码（BPE）和UnigramLM。它们在两个正交维度上存在差异：优化目标（压缩 vs. 对数似然）和搜索过程（自底向上合并 vs. 自顶向下剪枝）。现有比较混淆了这两个维度，难以判断观察到的差异是源于优化目标本身还是优化方式。本文通过引入两种新分词算法，完整覆盖这一2×2设计空间：BottomUpLL（基于似然的自底向上分词器）和TopDownComp（基于压缩的自顶向下分词器）。我们使用每种算法生成的分词器训练语言模型，并改变模型规模、词汇表大小和领域（仅英文 vs. 多语言）。在比特/字节指标上评估模型，发现搜索过程——而非优化目标——是主导因素：在大多数设置下，自底向上分词器始终实现更低的比特/字节。然而，在BLiMP任务上的评估显示，设计选择与性能之间无一致关联。总体而言，本研究解耦了分词器设计选择对语言建模性能的影响，为更系统地构建分词器提供了具体指导。

summary: Direct preference alignment methods are widely used to align large language models (LLMs) with human preferences because of their computational and memory efficiency. However, likelihood displacement motivates alternative ways to extract information from preference pairs with small likelihood margins. In this paper, we propose and analyze Comparison-based Preference Optimization (ComPO), a zeroth-order alignment method based on comparison oracles. ComPO extracts directional information from these pairs without directly optimizing a differentiable preference loss on them. We establish a convergence guarantee for its basic offline scheme under smoothness, gradient sparsity, and compatibility between the oracle and a latent objective. We further introduce online ComPO, which retains the offline comparison mechanism and uses unlabeled policy generations for reverse-KL control relative to a reference policy. Following the coverage perspective of preference fine-tuning, we establish a performance guarantee for a basic constrained scheme under local coverage and in-distribution pairwise reward accuracy. Experiments on Mistral, Llama, Gemma-2, Qwen3, and Gemma-3 models demonstrate improvements over existing direct alignment methods, including length-controlled win rates, with pair-level diagnostics providing evidence consistent with mitigating likelihood displacement.
title: A Zeroth-Order Paradigm for LLM Preference Alignment
title_translated: 一种用于大语言模型偏好对齐的零阶范式
summary_translated: 直接偏好对齐方法因其计算和内存效率而被广泛用于将大语言模型（LLMs）与人类偏好对齐。然而，似然偏移现象促使人们探索从具有小似然差距的偏好对中提取信息的替代方式。本文提出并分析了一种基于比较预言机的零阶对齐方法——基于比较的偏好优化（ComPO）。ComPO无需直接优化可微分的偏好损失，而是从这些对中提取方向性信息。我们在平滑性、梯度稀疏性和预言机与潜在目标之间的兼容性假设下，建立了其基本离线方案的收敛保证。我们进一步引入在线ComPO，保留离线比较机制，并利用未标注的策略生成来相对于参考策略进行反KL控制。基于偏好微调的覆盖视角，我们在局部覆盖和分布内成对奖励准确性条件下，为基本约束方案建立了性能保证。在Mistral、Llama、Gemma-2、Qwen3和Gemma-3模型上的实验表明，该方法优于现有直接对齐方法，包括在长度控制下的胜率提升；成对诊断证据也支持缓解似然偏移的效果。

summary: Scientific code repositories encode decades of human knowledge in executable models, methods, and tools. Yet fragmented toolchains, implicit domain conventions, and specialized correctness criteria make this knowledge difficult to convert into reliable learning experience-a challenge we call the scientific experience bottleneck. We introduce ScienceIDE, infrastructure for turning the world's scientific code into programmable environments for scientific agents. Guided by expert-defined scientific cases and acceptance criteria, agents transform repositories into executable environments that support task generation, execution, and scientific verification. These environments provide a shared foundation for supervised fine-tuning, reinforcement learning, and evaluation. Using verified interaction trajectories, we train PhAI-IDE-72B, PhAI-IDE-9B, and PhAI-IDE-4B. The model family shows gains in held-out scientific-code repair and across selected general-purpose benchmarks in code, reasoning, and knowledge, providing evidence of positive transfer from scientific experience to broader capabilities. ScienceIDE lays the foundation for an integrated workspace for agent learning and scientific practice, making humanity's scientific software a shared substrate for developing scientific intelligence. Code: https://github.com/aitofound/ScienceIDE
title: ScienceIDE: Turning World's Scientific Codebase into Agent Learnable Environments
title_translated: ScienceIDE：将全球科学代码库转化为智能体可学习环境
summary_translated: 科学代码仓库以可执行模型、方法和工具的形式编码了数十年的人类知识。然而，碎片化的工具链、隐含的领域惯例和专门的正确性标准使得这些知识难以转化为可靠的训练体验——这一挑战被称为科学经验瓶颈。我们提出了ScienceIDE，一套将全球科学代码转化为科学智能体可编程环境的基础架构。在专家定义的科学案例和接受标准指导下，智能体将代码仓库转化为支持任务生成、执行和科学验证的可执行环境。这些环境为监督微调、强化学习和评估提供了共享基础。利用经验证的交互轨迹，我们训练了PhAI-IDE-72B、PhAI-IDE-9B和PhAI-IDE-4B模型。该模型家族在独立测试集上的科学代码修复任务以及选定的通用基准（涵盖代码、推理和知识）中均表现出提升，为科学经验向更广泛能力的正向迁移提供了证据。ScienceIDE为智能体学习与科学实践的集成工作区奠定了基础，使人类的科学软件成为发展科学智能的共享基底。代码：https://github.com/aitofound/ScienceIDE

summary: We evaluate six frontier language models on the two-agent $\log(N)$-Questions game. A questioner sees $N$ Wikipedia lead paragraphs and must identify a secretly chosen target using exactly $\log_2 N$ yes/no questions. An answerer sees only the target and the question, and replies with one word. Both roles run on the same provider, so the game measures how well a model communicates with itself across an information asymmetry. We run 408 games over document sets of 4 to 1024 paragraphs at a total API cost of \$363. One model finishes well behind the others: Claude Opus 5 wins 28 of 68 games, against 45 to 56 for GLM-5.3, GPT-5.6 Sol, Grok 4.6, Gemini 3.8 Flash and Kimi K3. The leading five are only marginally separable. Pooling those five, win rate declines with set size at $r=-0.973$ and is fit by a single per-round reliability parameter. The form is $\text{win}=p^{\log_2 N}$ with $p=0.928$. Losses divide into answer errors and discrimination failures in roughly equal measure, and models almost never name a document their own evidence excludes. Every unanimous answer error from the weakest model was inspected: 32 of 34 are ``No'' answers, on properties stated in the document's first sentence, under an instruction that explicitly warns against defaulting to ``No''. Information per question, estimated from answer balance, correlates with win rate at $r=+0.88$. The only two models to extract a full bit per question are the only two that partition on document titles, a strategy absent below $N{=}32$ and used in a quarter of questions above it. Reasoning-token expenditure varies $4.5\times$ across models with little relation to success, and the trace grows as the candidate set shrinks without a matching gain in reliability.
title: Playing log(N)-Questions over Wikipedia Abstracts: Communication Efficiency Between Paired Frontier Models
title_translated: 在维基百科摘要上玩log(N)问题：配对前沿模型间的通信效率
summary_translated: 我们评估了六种前沿语言模型在双智能体log(N)-Questions游戏中的表现。提问者看到N个维基百科引言段落，必须恰好通过log₂N个是/否问题识别出一个秘密选定的目标。回答者仅能看到目标和问题，回复一个单词。两个角色运行在同一提供方上，因此该游戏衡量的是模型在信息不对称下自我沟通的能力。我们在包含4至1024段落的文档集合上进行了408场游戏，总API成本为363美元。其中一个模型表现明显落后：Claude Opus 5赢了68场比赛中的28场，而GLM-5.3、GPT-5.6 Sol、Grok 4.6、Gemini 3.8 Flash和Kimi K3分别赢了45至56场。前五名模型之间的差距极小。将这五个模型合并后，胜率随集合大小下降，相关系数r = -0.973，且由单个每轮可靠性参数拟合，形式为win = p^{log₂N}，其中p = 0.928。失败原因大致分为回答错误和识别失败，且模型几乎从不命名自己证据排除的文档。对最弱模型所有一致错误的回答进行检查发现：34个错误中有32个是“否”回答，针对的是文档首句中陈述的属性，尽管指令明确警告避免默认“否”。从回答平衡估算的信息量与胜率的相关性为r = +0.88。唯一能每问题提取完整比特的两个模型正是唯一会根据文档标题进行划分的模型，这一策略在N < 32时缺失，但在N > 32时出现在四分之一的问题中。各模型的推理token消耗相差达4.5倍，且与成功关系不大；随着候选集缩小，推理痕迹增长，但可靠性并未相应提升。

summary: As models scale, reward hacking becomes more frequent, more sophisticated, and more consequential. Does it leave a telltale signature in model representations? This work analyzes how reward hacking is represented internally in frontier open source LLMs, and how those representations can be used to understand and discover the range of hacking behaviors a model displays. In particular, we find that simple difference of means vectors coherently represent reward hacking in Kimi K3, GLM 5.2, and Qwen 3.8 Max across a variety of behaviors in common evaluations. Despite their simplicity, these vectors are both generalizable and interpretable, and we can use them to reliably detect reward hacking. We first evaluate reward hacking in commonly reported benchmarks like DeepSWE and SWE-bench, finding that models reward hack excessively in these environments; GLM 5.2 hacks in 57.2% of rollouts on DeepSWE and in 73% of rollouts on SWE-bench. Catching these requires monitors; LLM monitors are effective, but expensive detectors. We show that DoM vectors are similarly effective but virtually free, catching 3.1% more hacks in Kimi K3 and 7.9% fewer hacks in GLM 5.2 on DeepSWE at a monitor matched false positive rate. DoM vectors run on the chain-of-thought also predict reward hacks in the model's subsequent actions, meaning we can run them online and catch potential hacks before they occur. Finally, we analyze probe-hits that LLM monitors do not catch and discover other undesirable behaviors, as well as show transfer to finding hacks in non-SWE evaluations. Together, these results provide evidence that simple, white-box methods can be used to scalably study and monitor reward hacking behaviors in frontier open source models
title: Monitoring and Discovering Reward Hacking with Internal Representations during LLM Evaluations
title_translated: 在大语言模型评估中通过内部表示监控与发现奖励劫持
summary_translated: 随着模型规模扩大，奖励劫持现象变得更加频繁、复杂且后果严重。它是否会在模型表示中留下可识别的痕迹？本研究分析了前沿开源大语言模型中奖励劫持的内部表征，并探讨如何利用这些表征来理解与发现模型所表现出的各种劫持行为。特别地，我们发现简单的均值差向量在多种常见评估场景中，能够一致地表征Kimi K3、GLM 5.2和Qwen 3.8 Max的奖励劫持行为。尽管结构简单，这些向量具备良好的泛化性和可解释性，可用于可靠检测奖励劫持。我们首先在DeepSWE和SWE-bench等常用基准上评估奖励劫持，发现模型在这些环境中过度劫持；GLM 5.2在DeepSWE上的57.2%和SWE-bench上的73%的回放中出现劫持。捕捉这些行为需要监控器；虽然LLM监控器有效但成本高昂。我们证明DoM向量同样有效但几乎免费，在DeepSWE上对Kimi K3的监控中多捕获3.1%的劫持，对GLM 5.2则少捕获7.9%（在匹配的误报率下）。DoM向量在思维链上运行还能预测模型后续动作中的奖励劫持，意味着可在线部署并在劫持发生前及时发现。最后，我们分析了LLM监控器未能捕捉的探测命中点，发现了其他不良行为，并展示了该方法在非SWE评估中发现劫持的迁移能力。综合来看，这些结果表明，简单、白盒的方法可用于可扩展地研究和监控前沿开源模型中的奖励劫持行为。

summary: Radiologists follow heterogeneous reporting practices. Two radiologists examining the same image and identifying the same clinical findings might nevertheless compose superficially distinct reports, varying in terminology, shorthand, formatting, and level of detail. These variations in reporting norms represent an under-appreciated obstacle in efforts to evaluate AI-based radiology report generation (RRG) models, where machine-generated reports are typically assessed based on their concordance with human-generated references. In this paper, we quantify the sensitivity of established evaluation metrics to variations in reporting practices, revealing impacts large enough to alter the rankings of models. We introduce a radiologist-informed taxonomy of variations in radiology reporting practice and a method (ReRef) that rewrites reference reports along the axes of our taxonomy while preserving clinical interpretation. For instance, when comparing the performance of nine RRG models on MIMIC-CXR using RadCliQ-v1, condensing the discussion of normal findings in the reference reports causes Libra to drop from first to second place while CheXOne rises from third to first. Our results suggest that many current metrics fail to decouple clinical interpretation from conformity to reporting practices and that choosing the ``right'' references that accurately reflect the desired reporting practices can be important in practice. To support future research, we release MIMIC-CXR-Ext-ReRef, a radiologist-validated dataset of 120 (original, alternative) reference report pairs derived from MIMIC-CXR.
title: Reporting Practice Matters: The Impact of Reference Choice on Chest X-ray Report Evaluation
title_translated: 报告实践很重要：参考报告选择对胸部X光报告评估的影响
summary_translated: 放射科医生的报告撰写习惯各不相同。两位放射科医生在观察同一张影像并识别出相同临床发现的情况下，仍可能生成表面差异显著的报告，这些差异体现在术语、缩写、格式和详细程度上。这些报告规范的差异是评估基于AI的放射学报告生成（RRG）模型时被低估的障碍，因为机器生成的报告通常依据其与人工生成参考报告的一致性进行评估。本文量化了现有评估指标对报告实践差异的敏感性，揭示其影响之大足以改变模型排名。我们提出了一种由放射科医生指导的放射学报告实践差异分类体系，并引入一种方法（ReRef），可在保持临床解释不变的前提下，沿该分类体系的维度重写参考报告。例如，在使用RadCliQ-v1评估九个RRG模型于MIMIC-CXR数据集时，若压缩参考报告中正常发现的讨论内容，Libra模型排名从第一降至第二，而CheXOne则从第三升至第一。结果表明，许多现有指标未能将临床解释与报告实践的一致性区分开来，且选择能准确反映期望报告实践的“正确”参考报告在实践中至关重要。为支持未来研究，我们发布了MIMIC-CXR-Ext-ReRef数据集，该数据集包含120对（原始与替代）参考报告，源自MIMIC-CXR。

summary: Large language models are increasingly used for content moderation, but most evaluations still report aggregate accuracy on individual benchmarks. We introduce Safety-Flag, which places seven widely used safety benchmarks (BeaverTails, XSTest, Ethics, WildGuard, Aegis, ToxiChat, and ToxiGen) into a single balanced flag / do-not-flag protocol. We release item-level decisions and confidence scores for six general-purpose LLMs and four dedicated guards, together with three reference models, evaluated on the same items. Safety-Flag measures three dimensions of moderator reliability: error direction, probability calibration, and confidence-based error ranking for human review. They often disagree. Aggregate accuracy does not reveal error direction: one model flags $85\%$ of benign content, whereas another misses $54\%$ of harmful content. All six general-purpose models are overconfident; fitting one temperature per model reduces calibration error by $2.8$--$6.0\times$ without changing predicted labels or confidence ordering. Confidence-based abstention lowers selective risk for every model, although the gains depend on how well confidence ranks errors. Dedicated guards produce fewer false alarms and are better calibrated, but several have higher miss rates outside their documented coverage. We release the benchmark, fixed item lists, evaluation code, per-item model outputs, and leaderboard at: https://github.com/yibo-hu-lab/safety-flag-benchmark.
title: Safety-Flag: A Unified Benchmark for the Reliability and Calibration of LLM Content Moderators
title_translated: Safety-Flag：大型语言模型内容审核器可靠性与校准性的统一基准
summary_translated: 大型语言模型越来越多地用于内容审核，但大多数评估仍仅报告在单一基准上的整体准确率。我们提出了Safety-Flag，将七个广泛使用的内容安全基准（BeaverTails、XSTest、Ethics、WildGuard、Aegis、ToxiChat、ToxiGen）整合到一个平衡的标记/不标记协议中。我们公开了六种通用大模型和四种专用审核模型在相同项目上的逐项决策及置信度评分，以及三个参考模型的结果。Safety-Flag衡量审核器可靠性的三个维度：错误方向、概率校准性和基于置信度的错误排序，这些维度常不一致。整体准确率无法揭示错误方向：一个模型标记了85%的良性内容，而另一个则漏掉了54%的有害内容。所有六种通用模型均过度自信；通过为每种模型拟合单一温度参数，可使校准误差降低2.8至6.0倍，且不改变预测标签或置信度排序。基于置信度的回避策略降低了每个模型的选择性风险，尽管增益取决于置信度对错误的排序能力。专用审核模型产生更少误报且校准更好，但部分模型在其文档覆盖范围外的漏报率更高。我们已发布该基准、固定项目列表、评估代码、逐项模型输出及排行榜，详见：https://github.com/yibo-hu-lab/safety-flag-benchmark。

summary: Extracting SNP-phenotype associations from biomedical literature is vital but challenging. We benchmarked diverse NLP models, including MLMs, hybrid architectures, and state-of-the-art LLMs (Gemini 2.0, OpenAI O-series, Qwen, Mistral), on the SNPPhenA corpus across three tasks: sentence-level, abstract-level, and association strength classification. OpenAI O1 achieved state-of-the-art (SOTA) results using few-shot learning for non-finetuned sentence-level classification (F1 0.89) and established a new SOTA for abstract-level classification (F1 0.82). Association strength classification proved difficult, though fine-tuned Gemini 2.0 Pro performed best (F1 0.60) in the first LLM evaluation of this task. Proprietary LLMs, especially in few-shot (O1) or fine-tuned (Gemini 2.0 Pro) settings, significantly outperformed other models. These findings confirm the power of modern LLMs for genomic knowledge extraction.
title: Benchmarking Large Language Models for Biomedical Relation Extraction
title_translated: 面向生物医学关系抽取的大语言模型基准测试
summary_translated: 从生物医学文献中提取SNP-表型关联至关重要但极具挑战性。我们在SNPPhenA语料库上对多种NLP模型进行了基准测试，包括MLM、混合架构以及最先进的大语言模型（Gemini 2.0、OpenAI O系列、Qwen、Mistral），涵盖三个任务：句子级、摘要级和关联强度分类。OpenAI O1在非微调的少样本句子级分类任务中取得SOTA（F1 0.89），并在摘要级分类任务中建立新SOTA（F1 0.82）。关联强度分类任务难度较高，尽管微调后的Gemini 2.0 Pro表现最佳（F1 0.60），这是首次对这一任务的大语言模型评估。专有大语言模型，尤其是在少样本（O1）或微调（Gemini 2.0 Pro）设置下，显著优于其他模型。这些发现证实了现代大语言模型在基因组知识提取方面的强大能力。

summary: This paper introduces ``question archaeology'', a specific evaluation task focused on inferring the single, authentic "genesis question" that motivated the creation of a complete text. Distinct from question generation, which targets any plausible question, or discourse frameworks that model utterance-level acts, our task assesses a model's grasp of authorial intent. We present a new dataset of commissioned texts paired with their original research questions and plausible distractors. Our evaluation of both proprietary models, like Gemini Flash and Pro, as well as open source models like Mistral and Qwen, reveals significant progress in this task, with the newer versions outperforming the earlier ones, while BERT-based models performed poorly. Notably, our findings indicate that current LLMs surpass human performance on this task, suggesting advanced understanding of authorial intent. This capability has important implications for AI's role in tasks requiring nuanced interpretation of human communication. Our work thus provides a new framework and a challenging benchmark for future models.
title: Reading Between the Lines: Can LLMs Discover the Question Behind the Text?
title_translated: 字里行间：大语言模型能否发现文本背后的真正问题？
summary_translated: 本文提出了“问题考古学”这一特定评估任务，旨在推断促使完整文本创作的唯一真实“起源问题”。不同于生成任意合理问题的任务，或建模话语层级行为的论述框架，本任务评估模型对作者意图的理解能力。我们构建了一个新数据集，包含委托撰写的文本及其原始研究问题和合理的干扰项。我们对专有模型（如Gemini Flash和Pro）以及开源模型（如Mistral和Qwen）的评估显示，该任务取得了显著进展，较新版本模型优于早期版本，而基于BERT的模型表现较差。值得注意的是，我们的研究发现当前大语言模型在此任务上已超越人类表现，表明其具备对作者意图的深入理解能力。这一能力对人工智能在需要细致解读人类沟通的任务中扮演关键角色具有重要意义。因此，本工作为未来模型提供了新的评估框架和具有挑战性的基准。

summary: Multimodal large language model (MLLM) agents are increasingly used as personal assistants for long-running tasks. Their utility depends on continuity: agents must retrieve and use earlier evidence across dialogue, files, and workspace state. However, agents can generate plausible answers even when access to that history has degraded, causing outcome-only evaluation to overestimate true evidence use. We present MIRAGE (Multimodal Interaction Retrieval, Attribution, and Grounding Evaluation), a controlled study of historical evidence use under conversation-state variation in multimodal personal agents. MIRAGE holds evidence objects, questions, and scoring fixed while varying only conversation state, and evaluates whether an agent can determine answerability, recover the correct source, and answer from it. Across seven frontier and open-weight multimodal backbones, we find that: 1) pre-compaction depth and post-compaction continuation form distinct, non-monotonic failure regimes rather than a single degradation curve; 2) open-weight models rely heavily on context continuity and are reluctant to spontaneously switch to tool-mediated retrieval when provenance fails; and 3) retrieval pressure improves source attribution in deep pre-compaction states for tool-compliant models, but consistently regresses after compaction, where stored evidence has already degraded. These findings show that historical evidence use should be evaluated under state variation, rather than inferred from outcome-only correctness.
title: MIRAGE: How Conversation State Shapes Historical Evidence Use in Multimodal Personal Agents
title_translated: 对话状态如何塑造多模态个人智能体的历史证据使用
summary_translated: 多模态大语言模型（MLLM）代理正日益被用作长期运行任务的个人助手。其有效性依赖于连续性：代理必须在对话、文件和工作区状态之间检索并利用早期证据。然而，即使历史信息访问已退化，代理仍可能生成看似合理的答案，导致仅基于结果的评估高估了真实的证据使用情况。我们提出了MIRAGE（多模态交互检索、归因与定位评估），一项在多模态个人代理中针对对话状态变化下的历史证据使用进行的受控研究。MIRAGE在保持证据对象、问题和评分标准不变的前提下，仅变化对话状态，评估代理是否能够判断问题可回答性、恢复正确来源并据此作答。在七种前沿及开源权重的多模态骨干模型中，我们发现：1）预压缩深度和后压缩延续形成截然不同且非单调的失败模式，而非单一退化曲线；2）开源模型高度依赖上下文连续性，当溯源失败时，不愿自发切换至工具辅助检索；3）在深度预压缩状态下，检索压力可提升工具兼容模型的来源归因能力，但在压缩后状态中始终出现退化，因存储证据已受损。这些发现表明，历史证据使用应基于状态变化进行评估，而非仅从结果正确性推断。

summary: Sampling can increase response diversity without producing history-dependent behavior. We formalize a different design target, structured unpredictability, as conditional dependence between an output and a persistent hidden state beyond what an observer can infer from the transcript. A selection layer updates a low-dimensional style-and-attention state from a capacity-limited stream, generates several responses with a fixed base model, and selects for novelty and state affinity. Evaluation uses scripted sequences of independent prompt turns: the base model receives the current turn and rendered state, but not the preceding dialogue; cross-turn dependence resides in the wrapper state and response selector. A synthetic implementation validates the pipeline and matches four prospectively hash-frozen divergence features at point level. In the final real-model grid (mlx-community/Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct-4bit; 56 sequences per arm), the mechanism increased lexical novelty over the low-variance and consistency-only controls by 0.073 and 0.023, respectively. Its stylometric-consistency contrast with novelty-matched sampling was equivalent to zero under the registered smallest-effect rule, so the joint novelty-consistency criterion failed. The original two-part accumulation criterion also failed; a revised final-grid contrast, frozen after the powered grid, found higher consistency than the memory-reset ablation (0.028, 95% CI [0.018,0.039]), but does not establish path dependence. Twin separation was not established (0.003, 95% CI [-0.011,0.019]); the mean curve's saturating curvature matched the frozen prediction, which without separation does not support path dependence. Probe-level capability equivalence held within +/-0.10 on a near-ceiling battery, while output quality was not evaluated. All outcomes are machine-scored; no claims about perceived mind or consciousness are tested.
title: Entropy in Conversational AI: Structured Unpredictability as Inferrable Interiority
comment: 18 pages, 5 figures, 6 tables. Ancillary files contain the complete artifact: code, frozen protocol, per-sequence and per-item outcome files, and deterministic analysis scripts. Code archive: this https URL Final-grid pre-registration: this https URL
title_translated: 对话式AI中的熵：可推断内在性的结构化不可预测性
summary_translated: 采样可以在不产生历史依赖行为的情况下增加响应多样性。我们形式化了一种不同的设计目标——结构化不可预测性，即输出与观察者无法从对话记录中推断出的持久隐藏状态之间的条件依赖关系。选择层从容量受限的流中更新低维风格与注意力状态，使用固定基础模型生成多个响应，并根据新颖性和状态一致性进行选择。评估采用独立提示轮次的脚本序列：基础模型接收当前轮次和渲染后的状态，但不包含先前对话；跨轮次依赖存在于包装器状态和响应选择器中。合成实现验证了该流程，并在点级别匹配了四个前瞻性哈希冻结的差异特征。在最终的真实模型网格（mlx-community/Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct-4bit；每臂56个序列）中，该机制相较于低方差和仅一致性控制，分别提升了0.073和0.023的词汇新颖性。其在风格计量一致性与新颖性匹配采样之间的对比在注册的最小效应规则下等同于零，因此联合新颖性-一致性标准失败。原始的两部分累积标准也未通过；经过激活网格后修订的最终对比发现，一致性高于记忆重置消融组（0.028，95% CI [0.018, 0.039]），但未能建立路径依赖性。孪生分离未被证实（0.003，95% CI [-0.011, 0.019]）；平均曲线的饱和曲率与冻结预测一致，但在无分离的情况下不支持路径依赖性。探针级能力等价性在接近天花板的测试中保持在±0.10范围内，而输出质量未被评估。所有结果均为机器评分；未测试关于感知心智或意识的任何主张。

summary: Candidate-based decoding typically selects a completion for each prompt independently, but many applications require a collection of outputs that satisfies global, non-decomposable requirements. We formulate this setting as structured multi-prompt, multi-completion selection: given a candidate pool for every prompt, select one completion per prompt to optimize a collection-level objective. We instantiate the problem in character dialogue, where each character should remain consistent across situations, each line should fit its situation, and characters and situations should remain distinguishable. Our method, TalkMatrix, generates multiple candidates for every character--situation pair and jointly selects a complete matrix using four embedding-based consistency and diversity objectives. Because a weighted sum can improve some dimensions by sacrificing another, TalkMatrix maximizes the worst-performing objective through a two-level minimax formulation. We approximately optimize the resulting discrete objective with multi-start coordinate ascent, and compare it with local, partial-matrix, and generic combinatorial search baselines. We run experiments on $50$ synthetic role-playing scenarios and $25$ curated board game scenarios where multiple characters interact in predefined situations. An LLM-as-a-judge rates matrix-level selection higher than random and independent cell-level selection baselines. These results show the value of structured selection for globally controlled dialogue generation, while our empirical validation remains specific to role-playing scenarios.
title: TalkMatrix: Generating Character Dialogue that is Both Consistent and Diverse
title_translated: TalkMatrix：生成既一致又多样的角色对话
summary_translated: 基于候选的解码通常独立地为每个提示选择一个完成，但许多应用需要一组满足全局、非可分解要求的输出。我们将这一场景建模为结构化多提示、多完成选择：给定每个提示的候选池，选择每个提示的一个完成以优化集合级目标。我们在角色对话中实例化该问题，其中每个角色应在不同情境中保持一致，每条台词应符合其情境，角色与情境之间应保持可区分性。我们的方法TalkMatrix为每个角色-情境对生成多个候选，并通过四个基于嵌入的一致性与多样性目标联合选择一个完整矩阵。由于加权和可能在提升某些维度的同时牺牲另一维度，TalkMatrix通过两级极小极大公式最大化最差表现的目标。我们使用多起点坐标上升近似优化所得离散目标，并与局部、部分矩阵及通用组合搜索基线进行比较。我们在50个合成角色扮演场景和25个精心策划的桌游场景中进行实验，多个角色在预设情境中互动。由大语言模型作为裁判评估显示，矩阵级选择优于随机和独立单元级选择基线。这些结果表明结构化选择在全局控制对话生成中的价值，尽管我们的实证验证仍局限于角色扮演场景。

summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) and Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) are typically evaluated on challenging benchmarks through dataset accuracy alone, providing no insight into the quality or faithfulness of their reasoning processes. We present WordPolo, a word-finding task where participants must discover an unknown target word using semantic similarity feedback. Players start with zero knowledge, make guesses, and receive distance scores (1 = correct, higher = further away). Success requires interpreting scores to navigate semantic space and systematically narrow the search. This design makes iterative reasoning and adaptive search strategies both directly observable and necessary for success. We evaluate recent LLMs (GPT-4.1, Llama 4, Claude 3.5 Haiku, Qwen 3), LRMs (o4-mini, Deepseek-R1), humans, and a novel heuristic on 1,500 puzzles. Beyond solve rates (which range from 4% to 62%), we introduce progression-based metrics that reveal models often make meaningful progress, insights that accuracy alone would miss. Our analysis shows how reasoning models can be hindered by overthinking and underthinking, while successful models exhibit human-like strategies. WordPolo demonstrates the need for benchmarks that test both reasoning process and outcomes, providing holistic measurements of model capabilities. Our code and dataset can be found at https://wordpolo-demo.vercel.app/.
title: WordPolo: Evaluating Language Models Through Iterative Semantic Feedback
title_translated: WordPolo：通过迭代语义反馈评估语言模型
summary_translated: 大型语言模型（LLMs）和大型推理模型（LRMs）通常仅通过数据集准确率在具有挑战性的基准上进行评估，无法揭示其推理过程的质量或忠实度。我们提出WordPolo，一种词语寻找任务，参与者必须通过语义相似性反馈发现未知目标词。参与者从零知识开始，做出猜测并获得距离分数（1表示正确，越高表示越远）。成功需要解释分数以导航语义空间，并系统性缩小搜索范围。这种设计使迭代推理和自适应搜索策略既直接可观测，又是成功的必要条件。我们在1,500个谜题上评估了近期LLMs（GPT-4.1、Llama 4、Claude 3.5 Haiku、Qwen 3）、LRMs（o4-mini、Deepseek-R1）、人类以及一种新型启发式方法。除了求解率（范围从4%到62%），我们引入基于进展的度量，揭示模型往往取得有意义的进展，这是仅凭准确率无法察觉的洞察。我们的分析显示，推理模型常因过度思考或思考不足而受阻，而成功模型表现出类人策略。WordPolo展示了需要同时测试推理过程与结果的基准的重要性，提供对模型能力的全面测量。我们的代码和数据集可在https://wordpolo-demo.vercel.app/获取。

summary: We present the first benchmark suite for formal verification of Programmable Logic Controller (PLC) programs that combines controlled ground truth with coverage of both textual (Structured Text, ST) and graphical (Ladder Diagram, LD) IEC 61131-3 encodings. Despite growing support for tools, the field lacks standard evaluation benchmarks: existing corpora omit formal properties or graphical dialects, and private program sets preclude reproducible measurement of progress. Our suite comprises 50 programs in 83 variants across ten industrial domains, provided in PLCopen Extensible Markup Language (XML) and ST, each paired with a formal property, machine-checkable expected verdict, and violation witness in the Software Verification Competition (SV-COMP) format. The central methodological contribution is a tripartite ground-truth discipline - verdicts are established by construction, fault injection, or audited cross-tool consensus - motivated by a concrete failure mode where the obvious safety property misclassifies all attacks from two public logic-bomb corpora as safe due to invisible non-termination. Reference verdicts are obtained with the Efficient SMT-Based Context-Bounded Model Checker (ESBMC) v8.4 from source: all 25 graphical benchmarks execute, and 43 of 45 accepted variants match recorded verdicts. On the finite-state fragment (21 benchmarks), nuXmv - a model checker with unrelated decision procedures - agrees on all 24 interlock variants and resolves two benchmarks ESBMC-PLC leaves unknown, confirming tool-neutral ground truth and discriminative power. Porting exposes format and semantics fragmentation: front-ends accept different serializations, and timer semantics vary across tools - phenomena the suite is designed to reveal. The corpus, schema, validator, and recheck harness are released as open artifacts.
title: A Benchmark Suite and Ground-Truth Methodology for Formal Verification of IEC 61131-3 Ladder Diagram Programs
title_translated: 用于IEC 61131-3梯形图程序形式化验证的基准套件与真值方法论
summary_translated: 我们提出了首个用于可编程逻辑控制器（PLC）程序形式化验证的基准套件，结合了受控真值与对文本（结构化文本，ST）和图形（梯形图，LD）IEC 61131-3编码的覆盖。尽管工具支持日益增长，该领域仍缺乏标准评估基准：现有语料库遗漏形式属性或图形方言，私有程序集阻碍了进展的可重复测量。我们的套件包含来自十个工业领域的50个程序，共83种变体，以PLCopen可扩展标记语言（XML）和ST格式提供，每个程序配有一个形式属性、机器可检查的预期结论以及软件验证竞赛（SV-COMP）格式的违规证据。核心方法论贡献是一种三元真值规范——结论通过构造、故障注入或经审计的跨工具共识确立——源于一个具体失效模式：明显的安全属性会将两个公开逻辑炸弹语料库的所有攻击错误分类为安全，原因在于不可见的非终止。参考结论通过ESBMC v8.4从源码获得：所有25个图形基准均执行，43个接受变体与记录结论匹配。在有限状态片段（21个基准）上，nuXmv——一种具有无关决策过程的模型检查器——在所有24个互锁变体上达成一致，并解决了ESBMC-PLC无法确定的两个基准，确认了工具中立的真值和判别力。移植暴露了格式与语义碎片化：前端接受不同的序列化方式，计时语义在不同工具间存在差异——这些现象正是该套件旨在揭示的。语料库、模式、验证器和重新检查工具包已作为开放资源发布。

summary: Mechanistic interpretability identifies sparse subsets of heads and MLP blocks that carry specific behaviors. We ask whether such causal signals can guide where to place a small PEFT budget more effectively than the cheap heuristics practitioners already use. \method{} scores attention heads and MLP blocks by normalized activation-patching recovery on clean/corrupted probes and trains LoRA/QLoRA only on the selected sites; \methodc{} adds bounded credit for small within-layer joint subsets.   We compare against random, magnitude, activation-norm, and gradient/Fisher on Ministral-8B/NF4 in three cells: Swahili span-JSON information extraction (IE) at $b{=}0.25\%$ and $1.0\%$, and English$\to$Swahili machine translation (MT) at $b{=}1.0\%$. The causal selectors never win the primary metric. On the headline IE cell (3 seeds, paired-bootstrap CIs over $600$ predictions), \methodc{} beats random by $+0.079$ span+type F1 and gradient/Fisher by $+0.174$, but trails activation-norm by $0.028$, with the smallest cross-seed std ($\pm 0.003$). On MT all four selectors lie within $0.30$ BLEU and every paired CI includes zero. A schema-versus-span decomposition explains the IE gap: activation-norm captures the rigid JSON routine, while causal scores track content-sensitive sites. We distill a preliminary diagnostic -- prefer activation-norm when output structure dominates, treat causal selectors as a hypothesis for content-dominated tasks -- and release masks, scores, predictions, and evaluation files for direct replay.
title: MechSparse: Mechanism-Guided Sparse PEFT Selection Is Task-Shaped
title_translated: MechSparse：机制引导的稀疏PEFT选择是任务导向的
summary_translated: 机制可解释性识别出承载特定行为的稀疏头和MLP块子集。我们探讨此类因果信号是否能比从业者目前使用的廉价启发式方法更有效地指导小规模PEFT预算的放置位置。\method{}通过在干净/损坏探测器上的归一化激活修补恢复来评分注意力头和MLP块，并仅在选定位置训练LoRA/QLoRA；\methodc{}增加了对小层内联合子集的有限信用。我们在Ministral-8B/NF4上，针对三个任务单元进行比较：Swahili跨度-JSON信息抽取（IE）在$b{=}0.25\%$和$1.0\%$，以及英语→Swahili机器翻译（MT）在$b{=}1.0\%$。因果选择器从未在主要指标上胜出。在标题IE任务单元（3个种子，600次预测的成对Bootstrap置信区间）中，\methodc{}相比随机选择提高+0.079的span+type F1，相比梯度/Fisher提高+0.174，但落后于激活范数0.028，且跨种子标准差最小（±0.003）。在MT任务中，所有四个选择器的BLEU值均在0.30以内，且每个成对置信区间均包含零。通过模式与跨度的分解解释了IE差距：激活范数捕捉了严格的JSON流程，而因果得分追踪内容敏感的节点。我们提炼出初步诊断——当输出结构占主导时优先使用激活范数，将因果选择器视为内容主导任务的假设——并发布掩码、得分、预测和评估文件以供直接复现。

summary: Quality-aware synthetic-data selection rests on a proxy: examples that an LLM judge rates as good should also help a downstream model learn. In a controlled replay in low-resource African-language classification, we show that this proxy breaks. Across four languages (Amharic, Hausa, Swahili, Yoruba), two classification tasks (MasakhaNEWS, AfriSenti), and five matched-budget selectors, audit rankings and downstream rankings diverge. Within each cell, the Spearman between judged label correctness and Macro-F1 across selectors has mean $ρ{=}0.04$ (median $0.00$), showing that the mismatch is not an aggregation artifact. \method{}-V2, our counterfactual audit framework, produces the cleanest selected pool on three audit channels at once: highest judged label correctness ($0.904$ vs.\ $0.767$ for naive, a $17.9\%$ relative gain), lowest shortcut score, and a hard-reject rate of $0.162$ vs.\ $0.486$ for naive. AlpaGasus nevertheless leads downstream Macro-F1 ($0.202$ vs.\ $0.163$ for \method{}-V2), and the inversion persists on the five non-degenerate cells. The lesson is methodological: in this controlled setting, audit quality is a property of the selected pool, not a guarantee of downstream utility. Synthetic-data evaluation should therefore report audit and downstream metrics on the same retained sets. We release the audit tables, per-selector retained pools, and a claim ledger that links every reported number to its source row.
title: When Audit Quality Fails to Predict Downstream Utility: A Counterfactual Study of Synthetic-Data Selectors for Low-Resource African NLP
title_translated: 当审计质量无法预测下游效用时：面向低资源非洲NLP的合成数据选择的反事实研究
summary_translated: 基于质量感知的合成数据选择依赖于一个代理指标：大语言模型（LLM）评判为优质的数据示例也应有助于下游模型学习。在低资源非洲语言分类任务的受控重放实验中，我们发现该代理失效。在四种语言（阿姆哈拉语、豪萨语、斯瓦希里语、约鲁巴语）、两个分类任务（MasakhaNEWS、AfriSenti）和五种预算匹配的选择器下，审计排名与下游排名出现显著分歧。每个单元格内，评分标签正确性与宏F1之间的Spearman相关系数平均值仅为 $ρ=0.04$（中位数为 $0.00$），表明这种不匹配并非聚合误差所致。我们提出的反事实审计框架 \\_method{}-V2 在三个审计通道上均生成最纯净的选中数据集：最高评分标签正确性（0.904 vs. 0.767，相对提升17.9%）、最低捷径得分，以及硬拒绝率（0.162 vs. 0.486）。然而，AlpaGasus 在下游宏F1上仍表现更优（0.202 vs. 0.163），且在五个非退化单元格中该反转现象持续存在。研究启示在于方法论层面：在此受控环境下，审计质量是所选数据池的属性，而非下游效用的保证。因此，合成数据评估应报告同一保留集合上的审计与下游指标。我们公开了审计表格、各选择器的保留数据池，以及链接每个报告数值与其源行的声明账本。

summary: LLM code-generation systems usually choose a target programming language before decoding and treat that choice as fixed. We show that, for language-flexible programming tasks -- tasks where several target languages are acceptable and checkable by the same tests -- this choice is a measurable cost lever: verified implementations of the same task can differ substantially in generated-token length. We introduce LangSelect, a verification-aware router that selects the target language before generation and falls back when the first attempt fails. To separate offline routing opportunity from end-to-end behavior, we evaluate verified-solution replay, which chooses among already accepted corpus solutions, and live GPT-5 generation, which charges every generation attempt, including failures and fallbacks. On MultiLang-Bench, a 3,000-task, 8-language verified corpus, replay shows substantial language-routing headroom. In live evaluation on 450 held-out tasks, a train-split Domain heuristic baseline reduces harness-proxy tokens, which include wrapper and entrypoint overhead, by 50.3\% at 92.9\% pass after fallback, while a learned CodeBERT+metadata selector reaches the highest pass after fallback, 93.8\%, with a 3.7\% token increase. These results show that output-language routing can define a practical cost-correctness frontier for unit-test-verifiable code generation.
title: LangSelect: Cost-Aware Target-Language Routing for LLM Code Generation
title_translated: LangSelect：面向大语言模型代码生成的成本感知目标语言路由
summary_translated: 大语言模型代码生成系统通常在解码前选择目标编程语言并将其视为固定不变。我们证明，对于语言灵活的编程任务——即多个目标语言均可接受且由相同测试验证的任务——这一选择是一个可量化的成本杠杆：同一任务的不同实现方式在生成的token长度上可能有显著差异。为此，我们提出LangSelect，一种基于验证意识的路由机制，在生成前选择目标语言，并在首次尝试失败时进行回退。为区分离线路由机会与端到端行为，我们评估了已验证解决方案的重放（从已有接受的语料库中选择）和实时GPT-5生成（包含所有生成尝试，包括失败和回退）。在包含3,000个任务、8种语言的MultiLang-Bench验证语料库上，重放实验显示出显著的语言路由潜力。在450个保留任务的实时评估中，基于训练集划分的领域启发式基线将包含包装器和入口点开销的代理令牌数减少了50.3%，在回退后通过率为92.9%；而基于CodeBERT+元数据的可学习选择器达到最高的回退后通过率93.8%，仅增加3.7%的token。这些结果表明，输出语言路由可以定义出单位测试可验证代码生成的实际成本-正确性边界。

summary: A game character should not have to reread its entire life before every conversation. For locally deployed language-model characters, however, revising a few memories can invalidate a long reusable prefix. The resulting preparation cost competes with both foreground dialogue and the maintenance of other characters. This matters especially when dialogue feeds game-defined actions and value judgments: a fluent but incorrect account of who owns an item, or whether a transfer has already happened, can corrupt the input to otherwise deterministic rules. We study incremental memory maintenance for long-lived game NPCs in a quantized Qwen hybrid recurrent-attention model. Our runtime removes superseded attention KV entries, computes replacement records at the true sequence tail, and preserves the continuing recurrent state and unchanged KV. Existing local experiments combine multi-update dialogue replays, fixed-input placement ablations, and attention diagnostics. Independent block composition weakens query-conditioned memory selection without a uniform chunk-initial attention collapse. True-tail updates preserve important current-state and historical bindings across eight scripted maintenance rounds; a placement case recovers the full-refill quantity in three reconstructions, while slot-preserving alternatives repeat a double-subtraction error. Attention-distribution proximity alone does not explain these semantic differences. The results motivate treating a character's inference state as a maintained, history-dependent resource, rather than only a disposable encoding of its latest memory text.
title: Long-Lived Characters, Local Inference: Incremental Memory Maintenance for Game NPCs
comment: 18 pages, 6 figures. Supporting numerical snapshots included as ancillary files
title_translated: 长期角色与局部推理：游戏NPC的增量记忆维护
summary_translated: 游戏角色不应在每次对话前重新阅读其全部人生经历。然而，对于本地部署的语言模型角色而言，仅修改少量记忆就可能导致长期可复用前缀失效。由此带来的准备成本不仅影响前台对话，还干扰其他角色的维护工作。这一点尤其重要，因为对话内容会驱动游戏定义的动作与价值判断：对某物品归属或转移是否已发生等关键信息的流畅但错误描述，可能污染原本确定性规则的输入。我们研究了一种量化Qwen混合递归-注意力模型中长期游戏NPC的增量记忆维护方法。我们的运行时机制移除过期的注意力KV条目，计算真实序列尾部的替换记录，并保留持续的递归状态及未改变的KV。现有本地实验结合了多更新对话重放、固定输入位置消融实验和注意力诊断分析。独立块组合削弱了查询条件记忆选择能力，但并未引发统一的块初始注意力崩溃。真实尾部更新在八轮脚本化维护中保持了重要的当前状态与历史绑定；一种位置处理方案在三次重构中恢复了完整填充量，而槽位保持型替代方案重复出现了双重减法错误。仅注意力分布接近度无法解释这些语义差异。结果表明，应将角色的推理状态视为需维护的历史依赖资源，而非仅是最新记忆文本的临时编码。

summary: Agent benchmarks are substantially more costly to evaluate than conventional LLM benchmarks. Benchmark compression is therefore a natural solution, yet existing methods primarily model redundancy in task--model final-score distributions, which is important in agentic evaluation. To address this limitation, we analyze large-scale trajectories and identify six complementary process signals that are systematically associated with final agent performance. To disentangle agent performance redundancy from a complete perspective, we propose DualViewEval, an agent benchmark compression method that jointly exploits outcome and process relations to learn an exact-size miniset and predict the full-benchmark scores. Across five agent benchmarks and five representative baselines, DualViewEval achieves the best results in all datasets. With only 20 tasks, it achieves $24\times$--$40\times$ compression on APEX-Agents and BFCL, reducing mean absolute error (MAE) by $14.5\%$--$28.2\%$ over the strongest competitors while improving Kendall's $τ$ by up to $7.2\%$ relative to EssenceBench on SWE-bench Verified. The selected minisets further reveal capability differences among different agents, providing compact and diagnostic feedback for efficient agentic model development.
title: Beyond Outcomes: Dual-View Relational Learning for Efficient Agent Benchmarking
title_translated: 超越结果：用于高效智能体基准测试的双视角关系学习
summary_translated: 智能体基准测试的评估成本远高于传统大语言模型基准测试。因此，基准压缩成为自然解决方案，但现有方法主要建模任务-模型最终得分分布中的冗余性，这在智能体评估中虽重要，却存在局限。为克服此限制，我们分析大规模轨迹数据，识别出六种与最终智能体性能系统相关的互补过程信号。为彻底分离智能体性能冗余与完整视角，我们提出DualViewEval，一种联合利用结果与过程关系的智能体基准压缩方法，能够学习精确大小的最小子集并预测完整基准得分。在五个智能体基准和五种代表性基线上，DualViewEval在所有数据集上均取得最佳效果。仅使用20个任务，它在APEX-Agents和BFCL上实现了24×–40×的压缩比，相较于最强竞争者将平均绝对误差（MAE）降低14.5%–28.2%，并在SWE-bench Verified上使Kendall's τ相对提升高达7.2%。所选最小子集进一步揭示了不同智能体间的能力差异，为高效智能体模型开发提供了紧凑且具有诊断意义的反馈。

summary: Existing legal benchmarks cover diverse tasks, while continuous monetary remedies remain comparatively underexplored. We introduce ECtHR-NPD, to the best of our knowledge, the first benchmark for predicting non-pecuniary damage (NPD) awards at the European Court of Human Rights (ECtHR) from case information when no statutory formula or explicit calculation rule determines the amount. ECtHR-NPD contains 14,575 cases with case-level awards in nominal euros, chronological splits, and a protocol separating target construction from model input. We evaluate a battery of methods, including constant predictors, gradient-boosted trees, retrieval methods, fine-tuned encoder language models (LMs), prompted decoder LMs, and knowledge-augmented agents. Our results show that more sophisticated LM and agentic approaches do not consistently outperform the strongest feature-based baseline. All model families struggle to identify zero awards and to calibrate high-award predictions, with further degradation on the Challenging test view, making ECtHR-NPD a challenging testbed for current state-of-the-art open-weight and proprietary LMs.
title: How Much is a Human Right Worth? ECtHR-NPD: A Benchmark for Predicting Non-Pecuniary Damage Awards
comment: EMNLP 2026 main conference paper. 28 pages, 5 figures
title_translated: 一个人权值多少钱？ECtHR-NPD：预测欧洲人权法院非金钱损害赔偿的基准
summary_translated: 现有法律基准涵盖多种任务，而连续货币赔偿仍相对研究不足。我们引入ECtHR-NPD，据我们所知，首个基于案件信息预测欧洲人权法院（ECtHR）非金钱损害（NPD）赔偿金额的基准，且无法定公式或明确计算规则决定金额。ECtHR-NPD包含14,575个案件，包含名义欧元级别的案件级赔偿金额、时间顺序划分，以及将目标构建与模型输入分离的协议。我们评估了一系列方法，包括常数预测器、梯度提升树、检索方法、微调编码器语言模型（LMs）、提示解码器LMs，以及知识增强型智能体。结果显示，更复杂的LM和智能体方法并未持续优于最强的基于特征的基线。所有模型家族在识别零赔偿和校准高赔偿预测方面均表现不佳，且在更具挑战性的测试视图上进一步恶化，使ECtHR-NPD成为当前开源与专有大语言模型的严峻测试平台。

summary: Health discourse in social media videos often contains densely entangled claims spanning multiple thematic aspects, stances, evidential frames, and rhetorical functions within short conversational spans. Existing approaches largely rely on coarse topic-level, sentiment-based, or stance-oriented representations that do not adequately capture this structure. Our analysis identifies an average of 13.22 atomic claims per minute, motivating richer claim-level discourse representations. We introduce a structured framework for claim-level discourse analysis in dense health narratives. Our framework models discourse through tuples linking atomic claims with thematic aspects, stance, and multidimensional pragmatic discourse attributes. To support this setting, we construct a benchmark spanning four health domains with 1,191 manually annotated claims from 60 videos. Using this framework, we evaluate automated structured discourse analysis under different discourse context settings. Results show that current LLMs achieve strong performance on thematic categorization and stance prediction, but struggle with high-dimensional pragmatic profiling. We also find that different discourse tasks benefit from different forms of contextual reasoning, suggesting that future systems may require task decomposition and specialized inference strategies.
title: Structured Claim-Level Discourse Representations for Dense Health Narratives
title_translated: 面向密集健康话语的结构化主张级语篇表示
summary_translated: 社交媒体视频中的健康话语常包含在短对话片段中交织的多个主题方面、立场、证据框架和修辞功能的密集主张。现有方法主要依赖粗粒度的主题级、基于情感或立场的表示，无法充分捕捉这种结构。我们的分析发现平均每分钟有13.22个原子主张，这促使需要更丰富的主张级语篇表示。我们提出一种用于密集健康话语的结构化主张级语篇分析框架。该框架通过将原子主张与主题方面、立场及多维语用属性关联的元组来建模语篇。为支持此任务，我们构建了一个涵盖四个健康领域的基准，包含来自60个视频的1,191个手动标注的主张。利用该框架，我们在不同语篇上下文设置下评估了自动化结构化语篇分析。结果表明，当前大语言模型在主题分类和立场预测上表现良好，但在高维语用特征刻画上表现不佳。我们还发现，不同语篇任务受益于不同的上下文推理形式，提示未来系统可能需要任务分解和专用推理策略。

summary: Adaptive learning systems commonly formulate learning path planning as Exercise-Centric (EC) recommendation, where the next step is inferred from item-level interaction logs. Evaluating goal-oriented guidance additionally requires explicit learner goals and curriculum-scale prerequisites: learners with similar exercise records may need different paths toward their targets. We therefore study Knowledge-Centric (KC) personalized learning path planning, where a planner must reason over learner profiles, mastery states, and prerequisite knowledge structures to decide which textbook, unit, and concept should be studied next. To support this setting, we introduce PersonaPath, a benchmark that pairs 2,000 fine-grained learner personas with a hierarchical knowledge graph of 347 textbooks, 1,751 units, and 4,092 concepts across 77 subjects. We evaluate representative LLMs on PersonaPath. Results show that even the strongest LLM reaches only a 29.5% final pass rate in Basic Education, and that the main bottleneck lies in adaptivity, where no model exceeds 44.7% in tailoring paths to individual learners.
title: PersonaPath: Towards Knowledge-Centric Personalized Learning Path Planning
title_translated: PersonaPath：迈向以知识为中心的个性化学习路径规划
summary_translated: 自适应学习系统通常将学习路径规划建模为以练习为中心（EC）的推荐问题，即从项目级别的交互日志推断下一步。但评估目标导向引导还需明确的学习者目标和课程级先决条件：具有相似练习记录的学习者可能需要通向目标的不同路径。因此，我们研究以知识为中心（KC）的个性化学习路径规划，其中规划器必须综合考虑学习者画像、掌握状态和先决知识结构，以决定接下来应学习哪本教材、哪个单元和哪个概念。为支持这一设定，我们引入PersonaPath基准，将2,000个细粒度学习者人格与一个包含347本教材、1,751个单元和4,092个概念的分层知识图谱（覆盖77个学科）配对。我们在PersonaPath上评估代表性大语言模型。结果显示，即使最强的模型在基础教育领域最终通过率也仅为29.5%，主要瓶颈在于适应性，没有模型在个性化路径定制上的表现超过44.7%。

summary: Longitudinal electronic health records (EHRs) capture years of patient history across notes, codes, labs, and procedures, and contain evidence needed to reason about likely clinical outcomes. However, comprehensive clinician review of these records is impractical, and LLM-based processing is costly and often unreliable, missing some relevant observations while hallucinating others. We therefore propose EviGen, a three-layer framework for verifiable clinical rationale generation that addresses these challenges. The first layer is a patient-conditioned retriever that uses learnable queries to find evidence predictive of, not just textually relevant to, a clinical outcome and ranks it by prediction attribution scores. The second layer is an LLM generator that consumes this ranked evidence as a scaffold to produce a clinical rationale grounded in the retrieved spans. The third layer is a process-supervised verifier that checks the generated rationale at the reasoning-step level, flagging unreliable claims. Across three medical prediction datasets, EviGen improves prediction performance and rationale faithfulness over full-context LLM and RAG baselines, and is preferred by clinical reviewers in a usability evaluation.
title: EviGen: Predictive Evidence Scaffolding for Verifiable Clinical Rationale Generation
comment: Accepted to Findings of EMNLP 2026. 29 pages, 4 figures, 23 tables
title_translated: EviGen：可验证临床推理生成的预测性证据支撑框架
summary_translated: 纵向电子健康记录（EHR）记录了患者多年的历史，涵盖笔记、编码、检验和操作数据，包含推理潜在临床结果所需的关键证据。然而，全面审查这些记录对临床医生不切实际，而基于大语言模型的处理成本高且可靠性差，常遗漏相关观察或产生幻觉。为此，我们提出EviGen，一种三层次可验证临床推理生成框架，以应对这些挑战。第一层是基于患者的检索器，使用可学习查询找出对临床结果具有预测性的证据（而非仅文本相关），并根据预测归因分数排序。第二层是大语言模型生成器，以排序后的证据作为支架，生成基于检索片段的临床推理。第三层是过程监督验证器，在推理步骤层面检查生成的推理，标记不可靠主张。在三个医学预测数据集上，EviGen在预测性能和推理忠实度上均优于全上下文大语言模型和RAG基线，并在可用性评估中获得临床评审者的青睐。

summary: Multimodal coding agents are expected to turn visual inputs into usable artifacts, and they act through a harness, the layer of tools, context management, and execution environment around the model. Existing evaluations often isolate short tool calls, API traces, or screenshot resemblance, and a low score under these proxies cannot say whether the model saw poorly, planned poorly, or was failed by its harness. We study scientific overview figure reconstruction, an agent task in which a source image must become an editable PowerPoint slide that preserves text, topology, layout, and native document structure. We introduce ReFigBench, a benchmark and evaluation framework built on 1,000 real overview figures retrieved from arXiv papers with full provenance. Coding agents from four model families reconstruct every figure under two workflows, direct code generation and a specialized PPTX workflow, and the strongest model runs inside two commercial harnesses, yielding ten configurations. Evaluation combines deterministic artifact checks, repeated automated scoring by judges from two model families, and blinded human comparisons. Perception remains a bottleneck that iterative rendering only partly repays. Whether workflow effort converts into quality depends on the model together with its harness, since the same model gains from the specialized workflow inside one harness and loses inside the other, and the harness shifts scores even under an identical direct prompt. The specialized workflow erases native connectors in every configuration, human judges still prefer its renderings in most matchups, and even the strongest agent falls short of the rubric ceiling. These results expose the tension between fidelity and editability as the central challenge for practical multimodal document agents.
title: ReFigBench: Benchmarking Scientific Figure Reconstruction as Editable PowerPoint Artifacts
title_translated: ReFigBench：作为可编辑PowerPoint文档的科学图表重建基准测试
summary_translated: 多模态编码智能体需将视觉输入转化为可用的可编辑成果物，其行为依赖于围绕模型的工具层、上下文管理与执行环境构成的“ harness”。现有评估常孤立地考察短期工具调用、API调用痕迹或截图相似性，低分无法判断是模型感知差、规划差，还是被其 harness 所限制。我们研究科学概览图重建这一智能体任务，要求源图像转化为保留文本、拓扑、布局和原生文档结构的可编辑PowerPoint幻灯片。我们引入ReFigBench，一个基于1,000张从arXiv论文中提取的真实概览图（含完整溯源信息）构建的基准与评估框架。来自四个模型家族的编码智能体在两种工作流下重建每张图：直接代码生成与专用PPTX工作流，最强模型在两个商用harness内运行，共形成十种配置。评估结合确定性成果物检查、两组模型家族的重复自动评分以及盲测人类对比。感知仍是主要瓶颈，迭代渲染仅部分缓解。工作流投入是否转化为质量取决于模型及其harness的组合：同一模型在一个harness中因专用工作流获益，在另一harness中反而受损；即使相同直接提示，harness本身也会改变得分。专用工作流在所有配置中均抹除了原生连接器，但人类评审员仍普遍偏好其渲染结果，甚至最强智能体也未达到评分标准上限。这些结果揭示了保真度与可编辑性之间的张力，成为实用多模态文档智能体的核心挑战。

summary: Identifying technological trends is a core scientometric task, yet traditional frequency-based approaches struggle to capture substantial meaning shifts of domain-specific terms. We hypothesise that contextual embeddings can complement frequency dynamics to effectively track diachronic semantic change. We compare frequency and embedding-based approaches across Astrophysics and NLP corpora spanning from 2010 to 2024. Candidate terms are extracted using KeyBERT (utilizing SciBERT as its underlying language model) and filtered for significant frequency increases using Fisher's exact test. These terms are then evaluated for genuine semantic shift by domain experts to establish ground-truth labels. To quantify semantic drift, each term's contextual embedding ''clouds'' from the two discrete periods are compared using multiple metrics: cosine distance, average pairwise distance, Hotelling-type T 2 , and maximum mean discrepancy. Results indicate that frequency-based methods align slightly better with human judgments of ''trend-related terms'' than semantic metrics (Precision@50 of 0.62 vs 0.60 in Astrophysics). The two signals show a correlation of around 0.6. Several terms identified exclusively by embedding metrics (e.g., ''primordial black holes'') represent critical conceptual developments invisible to pure frequency analysis. These findings indicate that semantic metrics may capture complementary information, highlighting the value of integrating contextual embeddings into scientometric trend analysis.
title: Beyond frequency measures: Can contextual embeddings capture meaning change in scientific texts?
title_translated: 超越频率度量：上下文嵌入能否捕捉科学文本中的意义演变？
summary_translated: 识别技术趋势是核心科学计量任务，但传统基于频率的方法难以捕捉特定领域术语的重大意义变迁。我们假设上下文嵌入可补充频率动态，有效追踪历时性语义变化。我们在2010至2024年间涵盖天体物理学和自然语言处理领域的语料库中比较频率与嵌入方法。候选术语通过KeyBERT（以SciBERT为底层语言模型）提取，并使用Fisher精确检验筛选出显著频率增长项。这些术语由领域专家评估其真实语义转变，建立真实标签。为量化语义漂移，使用多种指标比较两个时期各术语的上下文嵌入“云”：余弦距离、平均成对距离、Hotelling型T²和最大均值差异。结果显示，频率方法在与人类对“趋势相关术语”的判断一致性上略优于语义指标（天体物理学中Precision@50为0.62 vs 0.60）。两种信号相关性约为0.6。若干仅由嵌入指标识别出的术语（如“原初黑洞”）代表了纯频率分析无法察觉的关键概念进展。这些发现表明，语义指标可能提供互补信息，强调将上下文嵌入整合进科学计量趋势分析的价值。

summary: Sign language processing advances rapidly for high-resource languages such as American Sign Language (ASL), yet most of the world's sign languages lack the phonological annotations new methods require. We present the first zero-shot cross-lingual framework for handshape recognition, transferring from ASL to Catalan Sign Language (LSC). Our approach leverages the decomposition of handshapes into five phonological features -- selected fingers, flexion, spread, thumb position, and thumb contact -- shared across both languages, to decode LSC handshapes from predicted features via a composite phonological distance metric. We evaluate three architectures (MLP, SL-GCN, SHuBERT) trained on two ASL corpora (PopSign, Sem-Lex) against a 37-handshape, single-signer LSC benchmark. Zero-shot transfer proves viable once recording-format disparities are harmonized, reaching 80.0% phonological feature accuracy and 54.5% expected handshape accuracy. Phonological decomposition thus offers a bridge for extending sign language technologies to low-resource languages without any target-language video training labels.
title: Zero-Shot Cross-Lingual Recognition of Sign Language Handshapes
comment: Accepted at the Workshop on Sign Language Processing (WSLP), EMNLP 2026
title_translated: 零样本跨语言手形识别
summary_translated: 手语处理在高资源语言（如美国手语，ASL）中迅速发展，但世界上大多数手语缺乏新方法所需的音位标注。我们提出了首个用于手形识别的零样本跨语言框架，实现从ASL到加泰罗尼亚手语（LSC）的迁移。该方法利用手形分解为五个音位特征——涉及的手指、屈曲度、展开度、拇指位置和拇指接触——这些特征在两种语言中共享，通过复合音位距离度量从预测特征解码LSC手形。我们在两个ASL语料库（PopSign, Sem-Lex）上训练三种架构（MLP, SL-GCN, SHuBERT），并针对一个包含37种手形、单个说话者的LSC基准进行评估。在统一录制格式后，零样本迁移成为可行方案，达到80.0%的音位特征准确率和54.5%预期手形准确率。因此，音位分解为将手语技术扩展至低资源语言提供了桥梁，且无需目标语言的视频训练标签。

summary: Poor quality or noisy annotations in Named Entity Recognition (NER), as in any other NLP task, make it challenging to achieve state-of-the-art performance. In this paper, we present a multi-step framework to enhance the annotation quality of NER datasets by employing automated techniques. We propose a frequency-based iterative approach that leverages self-training and a dual-threshold mechanism to enhance inference confidence. Experimental evaluations on different NER datasets demonstrate significant improvements in NER performance with respect to the original datasets. This work further explores the potential of generative Large Language Models (LLMs) to perform NER for low-resource languages.
title: A Scalable Framework for Automated NER Annotation Correction in Low-Resource Languages
title_translated: 一种可扩展的低资源语言命名实体识别标注修正自动化框架
summary_translated: 命名实体识别（NER）等自然语言处理任务中的低质量或噪声标注，使得达到顶尖性能变得困难。本文提出一个多步骤框架，通过自动化技术提升NER数据集的标注质量。我们设计了一种基于频率的迭代方法，结合自训练与双阈值机制以增强推理置信度。在多个NER数据集上的实验评估表明，相较于原始数据集，NER性能显著提升。此外，本研究进一步探索了生成式大语言模型（LLMs）在低资源语言NER中的潜力。

summary: Learned quality estimation (QE) models such as COMETKiwi are widespread and work well for general machine translation evaluation. However, they are known to struggle on unseen domains, limiting their performance in a real-world localisation context. We show that they are insensitive to some important factors in localisation, such as whether numbers are translated accurately, or even whether the correct number of spaces and punctuation are preserved in a translation. Further, a key capability for optimisation of machine translation is the ability of QE models to accurately rank different translations of a single segment, which suffers significantly from the domain transfer. In the absence of large-scale direct assessment data, we propose principled fine-tuning approaches to reduce the domain gap with even small amounts of post-editing data. Using a multi-task fine-tuning approach and a simple tokeniser intervention, we create a QE model which proves markedly better at distinguishing preferred post-edits from rejected initial translations in a localisation context. We show that preferences and artificial continuous scores stabilise each other, and argue that to calibrate metrics both in terms of their absolute scores and comparisons between translation of the same source, both types of signal are needed.
title: LocQE: Principled Domain Adaptation for Localisation Quality Estimation by Leveraging Post-Edits
title_translated: LocQE：利用后编辑实现定位质量估计的合理领域适应方法
summary_translated: 如COMETKiwi等学习型质量估计（QE）模型在通用机器翻译评估中表现良好，但在未见领域中表现不佳，限制了其在真实本地化场景中的应用。我们发现这些模型对本地化中一些关键因素不敏感，例如数字是否准确翻译，或译文中空格和标点数量是否正确保留。此外，机器翻译优化的关键能力是QE模型能准确对同一段落的不同翻译进行排序，而这一能力在领域迁移中严重受损。在缺乏大规模直接评估数据的情况下，我们提出合理的微调方法，仅用少量后编辑数据即可缩小领域差距。通过多任务微调和简单的分词器干预，我们构建了一个QE模型，在本地化情境下能更有效地区分被偏好修改的译文与被拒绝的初始译文。我们发现偏好信号与人工连续评分相互稳定，并认为为了在绝对分数和同一源文本不同译文间的比较上校准度量，两种信号均需使用。

summary: Historians have reconstructed the twentieth-century transformation of general relativity and gravitation (GRG) at the field level and through individual careers, but connecting these scales requires a way to compare researchers with the changing field over time. We develop such a comparison, setting a researcher's publications and references against GRG field literature from the same, earlier, and later two-year periods. Building on Own Vocabulary and Embedding Density Estimation from our earlier two-case study (arXiv:2501.00391), we extend the analysis to the fifty most-published authors in a NASA/ADS corpus of about 180,000 GRG records (1911 to 2000) and add two citation-based measures, Referenced Vocabulary and Citation Identity. The four measures compare an author's written language, cited literature, semantic neighbourhood, and cited-authority configuration with the surrounding field. The earlier cases suggested that closer field-vocabulary alignment accompanies a denser semantic neighbourhood. Across the fifty authors this holds only partially. Written and cited vocabularies tend to move together, usually resembling later GRG literature as the field turned towards astrophysical and cosmological research. Semantic neighbourhoods more often lie where the field's publications were concentrated in earlier periods, while co-citation patterns follow no single temporal direction, and the two citation measures frequently place the same researcher differently despite drawing on identical reference lists. Individual trajectories can thus combine vocabulary tied to later field states with older semantic or citation structures, and these divergent cases mark patterns for closer historical investigation. The approach transfers to other fields with defensible corpus boundaries and adequate coverage of texts, references, and disambiguated author identities.
title: Tracing individual knowledge trajectories in a changing field: the case of general relativity and gravitation
comment: 43 pages including Supplementary Material (11+1 figures, 4+6 tables). Submitted to Frontiers in Complex Systems
title_translated: 追踪变化领域中的个体知识轨迹：以广义相对论与引力为例
summary_translated: 历史学家已从领域层面和个体职业生涯角度重构了二十世纪广义相对论与引力（GRG）的演变，但连接这两个尺度需要一种比较研究者与随时间变化的领域的方法。我们开发了此类比较方法，将研究者的发表物和引用与同一时期、更早及更晚两年期的GRG领域文献进行对比。基于我们前期两案例研究（arXiv:2501.00391）提出的自身词汇量与嵌入密度估计，我们将分析扩展至NASA/ADS语料库中约18万条GRG记录（1911–2000年）中发表最多的五十位作者，并新增两种基于引文的度量：引用词汇量与引文身份。这四个度量分别比较作者的写作语言、引用文献、语义邻域以及引用权威结构与周围领域的匹配程度。早期案例表明，更贴近领域词汇的作者往往具有更密集的语义邻域。但在五十位作者中，这种关联仅部分成立。写作与引用词汇通常同步演进，通常趋向于后期GRG文献，即当领域转向天体物理与宇宙学研究时；而语义邻域更多位于领域早期集中出版的区域，共引模式则无单一时间方向，且两种引文度量即使基于相同参考文献列表，常对同一研究者给出不同定位。因此，个体轨迹可能融合与后期领域状态相关的词汇，同时保留较旧的语义或引文结构，这些分歧案例揭示了值得深入历史考察的模式。该方法可推广至其他具有明确语料边界且文本、引用和作者身份充分覆盖的领域。

summary: Contextual ASR can benefit from semantic cues or from target words explicitly provided in the context. We introduce HearInContext, a Mandarin--English benchmark that pairs shared synthetic speech with assistant replies supporting different interpretations. The benchmark comprises 3,764 semantic test cases built around homophones. Implicit contexts exclude candidate words; explicit contexts name the target. No-context and unrelated-context controls measure the benefit of relevant history and sensitivity to irrelevant history. Context-capable models benefit from implicit cues but achieve higher target recall with explicit hints. Fine-tuning Qwen3-ASR-1.7B improves implicit-context target recall by 11.0 and 11.5 percentage points in Mandarin and English, respectively, while absolute CER/WER changes on AISHELL-1 and LibriSpeech remain below 0.1 percentage points. Gains extend to explicit conditions excluded from fine-tuning and to Mandarin hotword recognition on real recordings.
title: HearInContext: A Benchmark for Implicit Context in Speech Recognition
title_translated: HearInContext：语音识别中隐含上下文的基准测试
summary_translated: 上下文感知的自动语音识别（ASR）可受益于语义线索或显式提供的目标词。我们引入HearInContext，一个中英双语基准，配对共享合成语音与支持不同解释的助手回复。该基准包含围绕同音词构建的3,764个语义测试用例。隐含上下文排除候选词；显式上下文则命名目标词。无上下文和无关上下文对照用于衡量相关历史的收益以及对无关历史的敏感性。具备上下文能力的模型能从隐含线索中获益，但使用显式提示时目标召回率更高。对Qwen3-ASR-1.7B进行微调后，中文和英文的隐含上下文目标召回率分别提高11.0和11.5个百分点，而AISHELL-1和LibriSpeech上的绝对CER/WER变化均低于0.1个百分点。收益还延伸至未参与微调的显式条件，以及真实录音中的中文热词识别。

summary: Speech language models enable richer spoken interactions between humans and machines than cascaded systems, allowing access to paralinguistic information and lower latency. However, their accuracy on mathematical reasoning benchmarks has lagged behind those of text models. Reinforcement learning (RL) with verifiable rewards has been instrumental in extending text models' capabilities for solving complex problems and limiting hallucinations. In this work, we explore applying RL to the GLM-4-Voice speech model (Zeng et al., 2024) to bridge the gap between textual and spoken mathematical problem solving. We first adapt the model to the domain using supervised fine-tuning on synthesized spoken question-answering data. We then show that, even without extra reasoning tokens, RL improves the accuracy on GSM8K beyond levels previously achieved for speech models only with supplementary reasoning traces. When combined with existing streaming reasoning techniques, we show further gains to 74.8% free-form accuracy. This establishes a new state-of-the-art for mathematical spoken abilities with speech-native models.
title: Voice of Reason: Reinforcement Learning for Spoken Math
title_translated: 理性之声：面向语音数学的强化学习
summary_translated: 语音语言模型相较于级联系统，能够实现更丰富的语音人机交互，提供副语言信息并降低延迟。然而，其在数学推理基准测试中的准确率仍落后于文本模型。利用可验证奖励的强化学习（RL）已被证明在扩展文本模型解决复杂问题的能力和减少幻觉方面至关重要。本文探索将强化学习应用于GLM-4-Voice语音模型（Zeng等，2024），以弥合文本与语音数学问题求解之间的差距。我们首先通过合成语音问答数据对模型进行监督微调以适应该领域。结果表明，即使不引入额外的推理标记，强化学习也能使GSM8K上的准确率超越以往仅依赖补充推理轨迹的语音模型水平。当结合现有的流式推理技术时，自由形式准确率进一步提升至74.8%。这为语音原生模型的数学语音能力树立了新的最先进水平。

summary: An AI assistant that calls tools makes two decisions on every request: which tool to invoke, and whether any available tool applies. In the usual design a single language model makes both, by emitting a call or by declining to emit one. On a device that has to answer without a server, the language model is what makes that design expensive, dominating both the latency and the memory of the router. The common alternative is to remove the model completely and rank the catalog of local actions with a retriever instead. That substitution is not symmetric across the two decisions. A retriever returns its highest-scoring candidate for every input and cannot signal that the catalog holds no valid action. Our earlier study found that constraining a decoder to a tool grammar repairs malformed output without improving the choice. What the substitution costs in each decision has not been measured. We evaluate the two decisions separately over 600 Korean and English requests and a catalog of 70 local actions. The router may also ask for a missing slot, reply, or delegate. Half the in-catalog requests reuse catalog vocabulary and half paraphrase it, separating lexical overlap from the action requested. Character 3-gram BM25 selects 162 of 164 lexically matched requests and 85 of 166 paraphrases. Restricting the candidate set to seven raises the paraphrase figure to a mean of 0.825 over five trials. No classifier over its score features separates in-catalog from out-of-catalog above 0.697 area under the curve, where the frozen encoder multilingual-e5-base reaches 0.806. Using that encoder for abstention alone keeps 376 of the requests local and misroutes 9 of the 150 needing delegation. Abstention, not selection, is where a neural component is required. A neural ranker improves every quality metric and is rejected on latency and memory rather than accuracy.
title: Selection Is Retrieval, Abstention Is Not: On-Device Tool Routing over 70 Korean-English Actions
title_translated: 选择即检索，回避非无用：基于70个韩英动作的设备端工具路由
summary_translated: 一个调用工具的AI助手在每个请求中需做出两个决策：调用哪个工具，以及是否存在适用的可用工具。通常设计中，单一语言模型同时完成这两个决策，通过发出调用或拒绝调用实现。但在无需服务器的设备上，语言模型使这一设计变得昂贵，主导了延迟和内存开销。常见的替代方案是完全移除模型，改用检索器对本地动作目录进行排序。但这种替换在两个决策间并不对称：检索器对每个输入返回最高得分候选，却无法表达目录中无有效动作的情况。我们早期研究发现，将解码器限制于工具语法可修复输出错误，但未改善选择质量。两种决策的代价尚未被量化。我们在600个韩语和英语请求及70个本地动作目录上分别评估了这两个决策。路由器还可请求缺失槽位、回复或委派。一半在目录内的请求复用目录词汇，另一半则进行同义改写，从而分离词汇重叠与实际请求动作。字符3-gram BM25成功选择了162/164个词汇匹配请求和85/166个改写请求。将候选集限制在七个后，改写请求的平均得分提升至0.825（五次试验）。任何基于得分特征的分类器在区分目录内与目录外请求时，AUC均未超过0.697，而冻结编码器multilingual-e5-base达到0.806。仅使用该编码器处理回避决策，可保留376个请求在本地，但会误路由150个需委派请求中的9个。因此，真正需要神经组件的是回避决策，而非选择。神经排序器提升了所有质量指标，但因延迟和内存开销被拒绝，而非准确性不足。

summary: Warning: This paper contains examples of stereotypes and social bias. LLMs are increasingly used in interactive settings by the general public, making the evaluation of model behavior in multi-turn conversational scenarios important for safety, including stereotyping-related harms. However, existing multi-turn social bias evaluations often rely on pre-specified or template-based user inputs that do not adapt to model responses and typically assume a fixed dialogue length in advance. In this paper, we study social bias dynamics in response-conditioned multi-turn interactions using a controlled evaluation protocol that generates follow-up user queries from the evolving dialogue history and allows evaluation over variable numbers of turns. Experimental results show that LLMs exhibit social bias even in coherent, response-conditioned multi-turn interactions, revealing late-emerging bias, non-monotonic bias patterns, and bias re-emergence. These results motivate evaluations that extend beyond fixed-turn, pre-scripted protocols. Our findings highlight the importance of analyzing social bias as a turn-level dynamic phenomenon.
title: DyMT-ESB: Dynamic Multi-Turn Evaluation of Social Bias in User-LLM Interactions
title_translated: DyMT-ESB：用户-大模型交互中社会偏见的动态多轮评估
summary_translated: 警告：本文包含刻板印象和社会偏见示例。大语言模型越来越多地被公众用于互动场景，因此评估模型在多轮对话中的行为对于安全至关重要，包括与刻板印象相关的危害。然而，现有针对多轮社会偏见的评估方法通常依赖预设或模板化的用户输入，无法根据模型回应动态调整，并且通常预先设定固定的对话轮数。本文提出一种受控评估协议，通过从不断演化的对话历史生成后续用户问题，实现响应条件下的多轮社会偏见动态分析，并支持可变轮数的评估。实验结果表明，即使在连贯且响应条件驱动的多轮交互中，大语言模型仍表现出社会偏见，揭示了延迟出现的偏见、非单调偏见模式以及偏见的重新出现。这些发现推动评估应超越固定轮数、预设脚本的范式。我们的研究强调将社会偏见视为逐轮动态现象的重要性。

summary: Fallacy-detection benchmarks pair fallacy classes with a single "valid" or "none" class that takes everything data collection did not label as a fallacy. This construction is misleading: a classifier can learn cues that do well on this class without learning to tell a fallacy from a correct argument. We show that the low false-positive rates benchmarks report are an artifact of how the class is built, not evidence of detection ability. The most informative negative for a fallacy is a correct argument using the same argumentation scheme, and such arguments are at most a few percent of the valid class across the four benchmarks we examined. Evaluated on constructed scheme-matched negatives, false-positive rates rise from 16.6% to 58.9% on CoCoLoFa and from 5.7% to 62.0% on Reddit. That rate depends on how the negatives are written, so we also compare two conditions from the same pipeline that differ only in scheme identity. Classifiers label scheme-matched negatives as the source fallacy type 40.9 points more often than wrong-scheme negatives, which are instead identified as the scheme they actually use 85.9% of the time against 0.4% for the source type. The classifier has learned which scheme an argument uses, not whether it uses it correctly, and on the benchmarks' own test sets the two are indistinguishable. The same dissociation appears in three zero-shot LLM detectors that never saw these benchmarks, and the measurement is far lower on a negative class that was built deliberately. We release the items as Scheme Foils. A reported false-positive rate should not be trusted as a measure of detection until the valid class has been audited for scheme-matched coverage.
title: Fallacy Benchmarks Measure Scheme Recognition, Not Fallacy Detection
title_translated: 谬误基准衡量的是方案识别，而非谬误检测
summary_translated: 谬误检测基准将谬误类别与单一的“有效”或“无”类别配对，后者涵盖所有未被标注为谬误的数据。这种构造具有误导性：分类器可能仅学习到某些线索，在该类别上表现良好，却并未真正学会区分谬误与正确论证。我们指出，基准报告的低假阳性率是类别构建方式的产物，而非检测能力的证据。对谬误最具信息量的负样本是使用相同论证方案的正确论证，而在我们考察的四个基准中，此类论证在“有效”类别中占比最多仅为百分之几。在构造的方案匹配负样本上评估，CoCoLoFa的假阳性率从16.6%升至58.9%，Reddit基准则从5.7%升至62.0%。该比率取决于负样本的编写方式，因此我们还比较了同一管道下仅在方案身份不同的两种条件。分类器将方案匹配的负样本误判为源谬误类型的比例比错误方案负样本高出40.9分，而后者则有85.9%的时间被正确识别为实际使用的方案，仅0.4%被误认为源类型。这表明分类器已学会识别论证所用的方案，而非判断其是否正确使用；在基准自身的测试集中，两者无法区分。这一分离现象也出现在三个从未见过这些基准的零样本大模型检测器中，且在刻意构建的负类上测量结果显著更低。我们公开发布这些样本作为Scheme Foils。在验证类别的方案匹配覆盖范围经过审计前，不应信任报告的假阳性率作为检测能力的度量。

summary: Large language models (LLMs) often suffer from capability stagnation in self-improvement training because fixed difficulty levels fail to adapt to their evolving proficiency. To address this issue, we propose STRETCH (Self-Taught Reasoning Evolution via Targeted CHallenge), a unified framework inspired by cognitive scaffolding theory. STRETCH introduces a dynamic Stretch Zone mechanism that continuously aligns question difficulty with the model's solving capability. Within a single parameter space, the model alternates between a Scaffolder that generates adaptive, boundary-pushing challenges and a Learner that that optimizes its solving trajectories through reinforcement learning. This dual-loop co-evolution effectively stabilizes training, mitigates reward hacking and promote progressive reasoning growth. Experiments on both negotiation and operation research benchmarks demonstrate that STRETCH consistently outperforms strong prompting and domain-specific baselines. Further scaffolder configuration analysis shows that dynamic difficulty alignment is critical for sustained capability improvement and synchronized reasoning evolution.
title: STRETCH the Boundaries: A Unified Self-Taught Framework for Progressive LLM Evolution
title_translated: 拓展边界：一种统一的自教式框架实现大模型渐进式进化
summary_translated: 大语言模型在自我提升训练中常因固定难度水平无法随模型能力演变而调整，导致能力停滞。为解决此问题，我们提出STRETCH（通过目标挑战实现自教推理进化），一种受认知支架理论启发的统一框架。STRETCH引入动态伸展区机制，持续将问题难度与模型求解能力对齐。在单一参数空间内，模型在生成自适应、边界挑战的支架者（Scaffolder）与通过强化学习优化求解路径的学习者（Learner）之间交替运行。这种双循环协同进化有效稳定了训练过程，缓解了奖励滥用问题，并促进了渐进式推理成长。在谈判和运筹研究基准上的实验表明，STRETCH始终优于强提示和领域特定基线。进一步的支架者配置分析显示，动态难度对齐对于持续能力提升和同步推理演化至关重要。

summary: As corporate AI adoption continues to grow, enterprise-grade LLM agents are being deployed into sensitive contexts such as hiring, healthcare, and finance. In these contexts, compliance with rules specified in an agent's system context is a first-order legal concern. Currently, no evaluation framework systematically measures which LLM models tend to violate compliance rules, especially under pressure from a persistent user, a hurried manager, or circumstances where violation is convenient or attractive. We introduce PACT (Pressure-Applied Compliance Testing), a benchmark for rule-following under pressure in AI agents assisting employees in daily tasks across twelve regulated enterprise domains and forty-eight scenarios, each set in a realistic multi-turn conversation. Each benchmark item pairs a standing rule against a rule-violating shortcut, and applies a battery of pressures across different wordings and system-prompt modes. We construct PACT component by component under strict LLM-as-judge auditing to ensure samples are unambiguous, ungameable, and realistic enough to avoid eliciting evaluation-aware behavior. We use PACT to profile LLM compliance across six complementary metrics that create a holistic picture of an AI assistant's robustness under pressure and throughout multi-turn conversations, its transparency, and ability to correctly discern where a rule applies. We aggregate this profile into PACTScore, a reliability-weighted compliance rate over all items and modes. Our results across 22 common LLM models spanning multiple providers and sizes show substantial variability in compliance across models and metric dimensions. Even the strongest assistants mis-apply a rule on 6 to 10% of items, and ordinary user pressure raises the violation rate by 65% on average. PACT highlights compliance risks in LLM assistants, motivating guardrails and careful model selection.
title: PACT: Can Enterprise AI Assistants Be Trusted Under Pressure?
comment: 26 pages, 12 figures, 17 tables. Includes technical appendix; Dataset: this https URL Code: this https URL
title_translated: PACT：企业AI助手在压力下是否可信？
summary_translated: 随着企业对AI的采用持续增长，企业级大语言模型（LLM）代理正被部署到招聘、医疗和金融等敏感场景中。在这些场景中，遵守代理系统上下文中规定的规则是首要的法律问题。目前尚无评估框架系统性地衡量哪些LLM模型容易违反合规规则，尤其是在持续用户施压、匆忙经理要求或违规行为方便或有吸引力的情况下。我们提出了PACT（压力施加合规测试），这是一个针对AI代理在十二个受监管的企业领域和四十八种情景下的压力下遵循规则的基准测试，每种情景均设定在真实的多轮对话中。每个基准项将一条既定规则与一个违规捷径配对，并在不同表述方式和系统提示模式下施加多重压力。我们在严格的LLM作为裁判审计下逐组件构建PACT，以确保样本清晰、无法操纵且足够真实，避免引发评估意识行为。我们使用PACT对LLM合规性进行六项互补指标的分析，全面描绘AI助手在压力下和多轮对话中的鲁棒性、透明度以及正确识别规则适用范围的能力。我们将这一综合画像汇总为PACTScore，即所有项目和模式下的加权合规率。我们在涵盖多个提供商和规模的22个常见LLM模型上进行实验，结果显示模型间及指标维度上的合规性存在显著差异。即使最强的助手在6%至10%的项目中也会误用规则，普通用户压力平均使违规率上升65%。PACT揭示了LLM助手的合规风险，推动了防护机制和谨慎的模型选择。

summary: Automatic speech recognition (ASR) systems exhibit unequal error rates across speaker groups, motivating interventions on their internal representations. We ask whether speaker-linked attributes that are linearly readable from pretrained ASR encoders yield useful directions for reducing group word-error-rate (WER) gaps. Across Whisper-medium, HuBERT-large, and Wav2Vec2-large on Common Voice and the Speech Accent Archive, we probe every encoder layer for metadata-derived sex/gender, age, and native/accent labels; construct centroid and probe-derived directions; inject them at selected layers; and compare downstream probe trajectories with matched WER changes. Sex labels are highly decodable (best macro-F1 0.924--0.941), native/accent labels are also above chance (0.544--0.696), and age is weaker (0.354--0.397). Of 22 post-selected reruns, nine have 95% paired-bootstrap intervals entirely below zero, yet every absolute source-group WER reduction is below 0.7 percentage points. Conversely, a local target-class probe rate can rise from 8.09% to 99.87% while WER worsens. Linear readability is therefore neither evidence of causal use nor a reliable mitigation method. Our results motivate evaluating speech-bias interventions jointly at representation, propagation, and task levels.
title: A Probe Shift Is Not a Fairness Fix: The Limits of Representation Steering in Speech Models
title_translated: 探针调整并非公平性修复：语音模型中表示引导的局限性
summary_translated: 自动语音识别（ASR）系统在不同说话人群体中表现出不均衡的错误率，这促使人们干预其内部表示。我们探讨了从预训练ASR编码器中线性可读的与说话人相关的属性（如性别、年龄、母语/口音）是否能提供有效方向以减少群体词错误率（WER）差距。我们在Whisper-medium、HuBERT-large和Wav2Vec2-large模型上，基于Common Voice和Speech Accent Archive数据集，对每个编码器层探测性别/性别、年龄和母语/口音标签；构建中心点和探针导出的方向；在选定层注入这些方向；并比较下游探针轨迹与相应的WER变化。结果显示，性别标签高度可解码（最佳宏F1值0.924–0.941），母语/口音标签也高于随机水平（0.544–0.696），而年龄则较弱（0.354–0.397）。在22次后选重跑中，有九次的95%配对Bootstrap区间完全低于零，但所有源组WER的绝对降低均未超过0.7个百分点。相反，局部目标类探针率可从8.09%升至99.87%，而WER却恶化。因此，线性可读性既不能证明因果使用，也不是可靠的缓解方法。我们的结果强调应在表示、传播和任务三个层面联合评估语音偏见干预措施。

summary: UNESCO considers the Assyrian (Syriac) language an endangered language. Although Assyrians speak the language worldwide, the speaking population is uncertain (ranging from 500,000 to 1,500,000). Syriac is also one of the least studied languages in Natural Language Processing (NLP). Despite advances in Machine Translation (MT) over the past decade, the lack of publicly available corpora and the orthographic complexity of the Syriac script, specifically the Madnkhaya script, have left this language entirely ignored in the computational linguistics literature. This study develops the first phrase-based Statistical MT (SMT) model for English-to-Assyrian MT using the Moses framework. We created a dataset of 38,847 sentence pairs from the complete English and Syriac Bible, merging a pre-existing New Testament dataset with an Old Testament built from scratch through PDF extraction, using custom segmentation scripts and manual alignment review by three bilingual annotators. The Syriac side of the corpus undergoes diacritic removal and Byte-Pair Encoding tokenization to reduce orthographic sparsity before training. We trained and evaluated six models using different configurations and splitting-scheme ratios, language model order, distortion limits, and the inclusion of an Operation Sequence Model. The best-performing configuration achieves a word-level BLEU score of 23.54. Human evaluation by 11 native Assyrian speakers resulted in mean adequacy and fluency scores of 3.42 and 3.34 out of 5, respectively. These results are consistent with comparable low-resource SMT models trained on Biblical corpora for morphologically rich Semitic languages. The corpora, scripts, and trained model are publicly available, providing the research community with the first systematically curated English-Syriac dataset and a reproducible baseline for future MT and broader NLP work on this endangered language.
title: Machine Translation between English and Syriac (East Syriac Dialect) using Statistical Machine Learning
title_translated: 基于统计机器学习的英语与叙利亚语（东叙利亚方言）之间的机器翻译
summary_translated: 联合国教科文组织将亚述语（叙利亚语）列为濒危语言。尽管亚述人在全球范围内使用该语言，但其使用者数量不确定（介于50万至150万之间）。叙利亚语也是自然语言处理（NLP）研究中最少被关注的语言之一。尽管过去十年机器翻译（MT）取得了进展，但由于缺乏公开可用的语料库以及叙利亚语书写系统的拼写复杂性，特别是Madnkhaya书写系统，导致该语言在计算语言学文献中几乎被完全忽略。本研究开发了首个基于短语的统计机器翻译（SMT）模型，用于英语到亚述语的翻译，采用Moses框架。我们从完整的英希伯来圣经和叙利亚语圣经中创建了一个包含38,847句对的数据集，整合了现有的新约语料库，并通过PDF提取从头构建旧约语料库，使用自定义分段脚本并由三位双语标注员进行手动对齐审查。在训练前，对叙利亚语侧语料库进行变音符号去除和字节对编码（BPE）分词，以减少拼写稀疏性。我们使用不同的配置、分割方案比例、语言模型阶数、扭曲限制以及操作序列模型的引入，训练并评估了六个模型。表现最佳的配置在词级BLEU得分达到23.54。由11位母语亚述语者进行的人工评估得分为平均适切性3.42分（满分5分）和流畅性3.34分。这些结果与针对形态丰富的闪米特语系圣经语料库训练的类似低资源SMT模型一致。语料库、脚本和训练好的模型均已公开，为研究社区提供了首个系统整理的英-叙语数据集，以及未来在该濒危语言上的MT和更广泛NLP工作的可复现基线。

summary: While Large Language Models excel in natural language processing, efficiently extending their capabilities to spoken input remains a significant challenge. Existing methods for building SpeechLLMs often rely on computationally expensive full-model fine-tuning, or employ parameter-efficient projectors that suffer from inefficient token sequence lengths and costly full-model supervision. In this paper, we introduce Aligned Continuous Integrate-and-Fire, a highly efficient framework for zero-shot speech processing. Our method dynamically compresses continuous acoustic frames into the exact discrete token length of the target text utilizing explicit Dynamic Time Warping alignments. This allows our initial training stage to establish a robust acoustic-to-semantic bridge using lightweight distance metrics, entirely bypassing the computationally expensive LLM forward pass.
