For subsequent fine-tuning, we propose a memory-efficient knowledge distillation objective that targets a single LLM layer, performing competitively with full-model cross-entropy training at a fraction of the computational cost. Through extensive evaluations on Automatic Speech Recognition and Speech Translation, we demonstrate that our method achieves superior performance compared to prior parameter-efficient baselines.
title: Align, Integrate, and Fire: Efficient Token-Level Alignment for Zero-Shot SpeechLLMs
title_translated: 对齐、集成、触发：零样本语音LLM的高效逐标记对齐
summary_translated: 尽管大型语言模型在自然语言处理方面表现出色，但高效扩展其能力以处理语音输入仍是一个重大挑战。现有构建语音LLM的方法通常依赖于计算成本高昂的全模型微调，或使用参数高效的投影器，但后者存在token序列长度效率低下和全模型监督成本高的问题。本文提出Aligned Continuous Integrate-and-Fire（ACIF），一种高效的零样本语音处理框架。我们的方法利用显式的动态时间规整（DTW）对齐，将连续声学帧动态压缩为与目标文本完全匹配的离散token长度。这使得初始训练阶段能够仅通过轻量级距离度量建立稳健的声学-语义桥梁，完全绕过计算昂贵的LLM前向传播。在后续微调阶段，我们提出一种内存高效的知识蒸馏目标，仅针对单个LLM层，其性能在远低于全模型交叉熵训练的计算成本下仍具有竞争力。通过在自动语音识别和语音翻译任务上的广泛评估，我们证明该方法优于以往的参数高效基线。

summary: Creating universal, high-quality representations of web documents in high-traffic industrial environments requires models that are both performant and economic. Existing approaches, however, often depend on large models, overlook the structural information inherent in HTML, or are constrained by short context windows, limiting their ability to process real-world web pages. We present HTML-LM, a compact foundation model with 154 million parameters that addresses these limitations through HTML-aware training and a ModernBERT-based architecture. It was trained on 100 million web documents using multiple objectives, including masked language modeling, bag-of-words prediction, and contrastive distillation from large language models. Consequently, HTML-LM sets a new state-of-the-art for classification and regression applications in the Czech Internet domain, surpassing both larger encoders and small-sized LLMs. The model is deployed in production, processing thousands of web documents per second, and released to the community under the CC BY-NC 4.0. https://huggingface.co/Seznam/html-lm.
title: Size Matters: Foundation Model for Czech HTML documents
title_translated: 规模至关重要：面向捷克HTML文档的基础模型
summary_translated: 在高流量工业环境中创建通用且高质量的网页文档表示，需要既高效又经济的模型。然而，现有方法往往依赖大型模型，忽视HTML固有的结构信息，或受限于短上下文窗口，限制了其处理现实世界网页的能力。我们提出HTML-LM，一个拥有1.54亿参数的紧凑型基础模型，通过HTML感知训练和ModernBERT架构解决了这些局限。该模型在1亿个网页文档上进行训练，采用多种目标，包括掩码语言建模、词袋预测以及从大型语言模型进行对比蒸馏。因此，HTML-LM在捷克互联网领域的分类和回归应用中达到了新的最先进水平，超越了更大的编码器和小型LLM。该模型已在生产环境中部署，每秒可处理数千个网页文档，并以CC BY-NC 4.0许可发布给社区。https://huggingface.co/Seznam/html-lm。

summary: Agent skills, reusable procedural documents that extend LLM agents beyond their parametric memory, have become an important interface for deploying agents on real-world tasks. Community-maintained skill libraries built around this interface are growing rapidly. However, this ecosystem remains deeply English-centric: our audit finds that low-resource languages such as Swahili and Hindi have no in-language skill content, so retrieval often returns a skill written in a different language than the query, degrading accuracy and recall. A practical solution is to synthesize in-language skills for retrieval but the quality can be unreliable, so relevance in this setting alone often surfaces a related but unusable candidate. To address this, we propose M-SQE, a post-retrieval Multilingual Skill Quality Estimation framework that scores candidates via a Theory view for intrinsic quality and an Action view for task-grounded utility, unified into a domain-conditioned final score. We evaluate M-SQE across three skill-use domains: general, tool-use, and cultural tasks. Empirically, we build three-layer candidate skill pools mirroring today's ecosystem, where M-SQE's task success exceeds existing baseline's average by at least +3.5 points across three different retrievers. Particularly, M-SQE lifts the lowest-resource languages most (+12.9pp on Hindi and +5.6pp on Swahili) and achieves strong performance across all six culture regions, thereby moving agentic skill use toward linguistic and cultural equality.
title: M-SQE: Multilingual Skill Quality Estimation for Enhancing Language Equality in Agentic Skill Use
title_translated: M-SQE：用于提升智能体技能使用中语言平等性的多语言技能质量评估
summary_translated: 智能体技能是可重用的过程文档，能够将大语言模型代理的能力扩展至其参数化记忆之外，已成为部署代理完成现实任务的重要接口。围绕这一接口构建的社区维护技能库正在迅速增长。然而，该生态系统仍严重以英语为中心：我们的审计发现，斯瓦希里语和印地语等低资源语言缺乏本语言的技能内容，导致检索结果经常返回与查询语言不同的技能，从而降低准确率和召回率。一个实用的解决方案是合成本语言技能以供检索，但其质量可能不可靠，因此仅依赖相关性往往会产生相关但无法使用的候选技能。为解决此问题，我们提出M-SQE，一种后检索阶段的多语言技能质量评估框架，通过理论视角评估内在质量、行动视角评估任务相关的实用性，并将其统一为领域条件下的最终评分。我们在三个技能使用领域（通用、工具使用、文化任务）对M-SQE进行了评估。实证上，我们构建了三层候选技能池，模拟当前生态系统，结果显示M-SQE在三种不同检索器上的任务成功率均比现有基线平均高出至少+3.5分。尤其值得注意的是，M-SQE显著提升了最低资源语言的表现（印地语提升+12.9个百分点，斯瓦希里语提升+5.6个百分点），并在所有六个文化区域均表现出色，推动智能体技能使用向语言和文化平等迈进。

summary: Lindsey et al. (2025) report that Claude 3.5 Haiku plans rhymes: features for candidate rhyme words are active on the newline before a line is written, and a suppress-and-inject intervention redirects the line only when applied there (their Figure 13). We test how far this generalizes on seven cells crossing four open models (0.6B to 2.6B parameters) with six open cross-layer transcoders (CLTs), on one consumer GPU, decomposing the claim into position specificity (C1), newline site identity (C2), and a newline-resident plan (C3). This is a stress test rather than a faithful reproduction: attribution graphs are unavailable for these CLTs, so features are found bottom-up from decoder vectors. C1 generalizes, in every cell and in all 247 of 444 prompt-by-inject pairs with a detectable effect, but the effective position is the final prompt token, adjacent to emission, and only two cells reach behaviorally meaningful probabilities. C2 and C3 are not recovered by any probe: a census of every active feature finds no rhyme-anticipating enrichment at the newline, and steering the newline while the model composes the whole line, over 36 runs and 8,640 sampled lines, shows why. That intervention is strong but one token long, making the injected word the first word of the composed line in 703 of 720 samples and leaving the rhyme six words later untouched. A final test drops the transcoder entirely: patching the newline's whole residual, at every layer, from a minimal-pair poem whose third line ends on a different rhyme moves the rhyme in 11 of 1,260 composed lines against 4 at baseline, with a design resolving 1.4%. We read this as a boundary condition rather than a refutation: at this scale and with these transcoders, the causal site is emission-adjacent. We reproduce Figure 13's shape, not its mechanism. Code and data are public (code: github.com/PCfVW/poetry-planning-site).
title: Planning or Improvisation? Stress-Testing the Poetry Planning Site on Open Models and Open Cross-Layer Transcoders
comment: 17 pages, 3 figures, 8 tables. Code, data and analysis scripts: this https URL . An earlier version was submitted to the BlackboxNLP 2026 special track on reproducibility and reliability in interpretability analyses; this version adds a rerun composition-horizon experiment (36 runs, 8,640 sampled lines) and a transcoder-free activation-patching test
title_translated: 规划还是即兴？对开放模型与开放跨层转换器的诗歌规划位置进行压力测试
summary_translated: Lindsey等人（2025）报告称，Claude 3.5 Haiku会在换行前就规划押韵：候选押韵词的特征在写入一行之前已在换行处激活，且抑制并注入干预仅在该位置应用时才有效（其图13）。我们在此对七组实验单元（涵盖四个开源模型，参数量从0.6B到2.6B，以及六种开源跨层转换器CLTs）在单个消费级GPU上进行测试，将该结论分解为位置特异性（C1）、换行位置身份（C2）和换行驻留规划（C3）。这是一次压力测试而非忠实复现：由于这些CLTs缺乏归属图，特征需从解码器向量自底向上探测。C1在所有实验单元及444个提示-注入对中的247个具有可检测效应的情况下均成立，但有效位置为紧邻生成的最后一个提示标记，且仅有两个实验单元达到行为上有意义的概率。C2和C3未被任何探测器恢复：对所有活跃特征的普查显示，换行处并无押韵预判增强；在36轮运行、8,640条采样行中，当模型正在生成整行时对换行进行引导，也解释了原因。该干预虽强但仅持续一标记，导致注入词在703/720样本中成为生成行的第一个词，而押韵部分则在六词之后保持不变。最后的测试完全移除转换器：在每一层上从一个最小差异诗（第三行结尾押韵不同）中修补换行的整个残差，仅在11/1,260条生成行中改变了押韵，而基线为4条，设计解决率为1.4%。我们认为这是边界条件而非否定：在当前规模和转换器配置下，因果位置位于生成邻近处。我们复现了图13的形状，但未复现其机制。代码与数据公开（code: github.com/PCfVW/poetry-planning-site）。

summary: Multi-turn agent trajectories often contain redundant rounds (failed tool calls, parallel sub-queries, verification-only steps) that inflate both training and inference cost. We propose viewing each trajectory as a \emph{round-level dependency DAG} that exposes which rounds are globally load-bearing for the final answer, and fine-tune agents on trajectories refined through this DAG. Given an LLM-annotated DAG, these edits are deterministic and interpretable, with optional rephrasing. Models trained on these refined trajectories consistently outperform those trained on the original trajectories at lower inference cost. Specifically, across four multi-modal QA benchmarks, our refinements improve downstream accuracy by up to $1.7$\,pp over vanilla SFT (and $5.7$\,pp over an LLM-deletion baseline) while reducing per-sample inference messages by up to approximately $40\%$ and inference tokens by up to approximately $48\%$, translating to substantial savings in compute and serving cost. Code is available.
title: Dependency-Aware Trajectory Refinement for Efficient Multi-Turn Agent Fine-Tuning
title_translated: 依赖感知轨迹优化：实现高效多轮智能体微调的方法
summary_translated: 多轮智能体轨迹通常包含冗余回合（失败的工具调用、并行子查询、仅验证步骤），这增加了训练和推理成本。我们提出将每条轨迹视为一个	extit{轮次级依赖有向无环图}（DAG），以揭示哪些轮次对最终答案具有全局关键作用，并基于该DAG对轨迹进行优化后进行智能体微调。给定由大语言模型标注的DAG，这些编辑操作是确定性和可解释的，可选地进行重述。在这些优化轨迹上训练的模型在推理成本更低的情况下，始终优于在原始轨迹上训练的模型。具体而言，在四个多模态问答基准测试中，我们的优化方法在下游准确率上相比标准SFT提升最高达1.7个百分点（相比LLM删除基线提升5.7个百分点），同时每样本推理消息减少约40%，推理token减少约48%，显著降低了计算和部署成本。代码已公开。

summary: Emotions are an essential aspect of human communication, particularly on social media, where authors frequently combine text and images to convey their emotions. Yet prior work on emotion analysis of social media posts has overlooked two important aspects in regard to measuring how well readers can reconstruct the authors' intent: (1)~the image modality, with most work focusing solely on text, and (2)~the real-world events that trigger the expressed emotions, and their relationship to the post content. We therefore study the relation between (a) the author's experience of the event that caused them to write a social media post and (b) the content of the post, with a focus on readers' capability to reconstruct that emotion expression. To do that, we introduce the Multimodal Multi-Emotion-Model dataset Mult2EMo, created by collecting annotations from both authors and readers on the posts and their triggering events. We find that reconstruction is possible but challenging for both human readers and computational models. We show that understanding the triggering event is crucial for accurate reconstruction, and that reconstruction is particularly challenging when posts rely heavily on the image to express emotion.
title: Emotion Experience, Expression, and Perception: Emotion Analysis on Multimodal Social Media Posts
comment: Accepted for publication at EMNLP 2026 main conference
title_translated: 情绪体验、表达与感知：多模态社交媒体帖子中的情绪分析
summary_translated: 情绪是人类交流的重要方面，尤其是在社交媒体中，作者经常结合文本与图像来传达情绪。然而，以往关于社交媒体帖子的情绪分析研究忽略了两个重要方面：（1）图像模态——大多数研究仅关注文本；（2）引发情绪的真实事件及其与帖子内容的关系。因此，我们研究了（a）作者因触发事件而产生的情绪体验与（b）帖子内容之间的关系，重点考察读者重构这种情绪表达的能力。为此，我们引入了Multimodal Multi-Emotion-Model数据集Mult2EMo，该数据集通过收集作者和读者对帖子及其触发事件的标注构建而成。我们发现，无论是人类读者还是计算模型，情绪重构都是可能但具有挑战性的。我们表明，理解触发事件对于准确重构至关重要，且当帖子高度依赖图像表达情绪时，重构尤为困难。

summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) frequently exhibit hallucinations, presenting a major barrier to reliability in complex reasoning tasks. While traditional detection methods rely on output-based confidence metrics, these logits are often miscalibrated by modern alignment techniques. In this paper, we investigate the temporal volatility of internal attention mechanisms as an alternative diagnostic signal for hallucination that does not depend on output calibration. By introducing an unsupervised metric for attention dispersion, we show that epistemic uncertainty leaves a measurable trace within intermediate layers, where spikes in attention entropy are associated with reasoning breakdowns. We evaluate our approach on mathematical reasoning benchmarks (GSM8K and MATH-500) using the Qwen2.5 model family (1.5B and 3B parameters), finding statistically significant AUC improvements of up to +0.076 over output-based baselines across all tested conditions. These findings suggest that attention dispersion is a promising complement to traditional hallucination detection methods, requiring further investigation across broader model families and task domains.
title: Attention Dispersion as a Diagnostic Signal for Hallucination in Large Language Models
title_translated: 注意力分散作为大语言模型幻觉的诊断信号
summary_translated: 大语言模型（LLMs）频繁出现幻觉，这在复杂推理任务中构成了重大可靠性障碍。尽管传统检测方法依赖于输出层面的置信度指标，但现代对齐技术常导致这些logits校准失准。本文探讨内部注意力机制的时间波动性作为一种不依赖输出校准的替代诊断信号。通过引入一种无监督的注意力分散度量，我们发现认知不确定性会在中间层留下可测量的痕迹，注意力熵的峰值与推理崩溃相关。我们在数学推理基准（GSM8K和MATH-500）上使用Qwen2.5模型系列（1.5B和3B参数）评估该方法，发现在所有测试条件下，与基于输出的基线相比，AUC值最高提升+0.076，具有统计显著性。这些发现表明，注意力分散是传统幻觉检测方法的有力补充，值得在更广泛的模型家族和任务领域中进一步研究。

summary: Large language models (LLMs) suffer from a long-tail deficit: culturally specific facts, particularly those concerning underrepresented regions such as Latin America, appear too rarely in pretraining corpora to be reliably memorized. Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) addresses this by grounding generation in external text, but structured alternatives such as Knowledge Graphs (KGs) offer tighter control over what enters the context, along with potential gains in explainability and updatability. We benchmark Graph-RAG against standard RAG on LatamQA, a culturally grounded multiple-choice dataset spanning eight thematic categories. The graphs are built end-to-end from Wikipedia articles with KGGen, a recent open-domain extractor, without manual curation in our main setting. G-Retriever is competitive with RAG and reduces the error of the base LLM by 72\% with a standard KG and 78\% with a benchmark-aware variant, the gap to RAG narrowing further as the graph is oriented toward task-relevant content. The trained projection transfers zero-shot to Portuguese without target-language fine-tuning, indicating multilingual reach.
title: Knowledge-Graph Based Augmentation versus Retrieval Augmented Generation for Cultural-Related Question Answering
title_translated: 基于知识图谱的增强与检索增强生成在文化相关问答中的比较
summary_translated: 大型语言模型（LLMs）存在长尾缺陷：关于特定文化背景的事实，尤其是拉丁美洲等代表性不足地区的事实，在预训练语料库中出现频率过低，难以被可靠记忆。检索增强生成（RAG）通过将生成过程锚定在外部文本来解决此问题，但结构化替代方案如知识图谱（KGs）能更严格地控制进入上下文的内容，并可能提升可解释性和可更新性。我们在LatamQA——一个涵盖八个主题类别的文化基础多项选择数据集上，对Graph-RAG与标准RAG进行了基准测试。图谱在主要设置中通过KGGen（一种近期的开放域提取器）从维基百科文章端到端构建，无需人工校准。G-Retriever的表现与RAG相当，并使基础LLM的错误率降低了72%（使用标准KG）和78%（使用任务感知变体），随着图谱内容更聚焦于任务相关性，与RAG的差距进一步缩小。经过训练的投影在未进行目标语言微调的情况下即可零样本迁移到葡萄牙语，表明其具备多语言能力。

summary: We introduce Nemotron-SEA-LION-v4.8, a family of Southeast Asian Languages in One Network (SEA-LION) built upon NVIDIA Nemotron 3. The family includes 30B-A3B and 120B-A12B models, with both continued-pretrained base checkpoints and post-trained variants. We adapt the models using Southeast Asian, reasoning, code, and multilingual parallel datasets, followed by post-training with supervised fine-tuning and online on-policy distillation. On SEA-HELM, the 30B-A3B model improves the overall SEA score from 46.06 to 51.57, while the 120B-A12B model improves from 49.30 to 63.44. The strongest gains are observed in instruction following, natural language reasoning, and natural language understanding across seven Southeast Asian languages.
title: SEA-LION-v4.8: A Technical Report
title_translated: SEA-LION-v4.8：技术报告
summary_translated: 我们介绍了Nemotron-SEA-LION-v4.8，这是一个基于NVIDIA Nemotron 3构建的东南亚语言一体化网络（SEA-LION）家族，包含30B-A3B和120B-A12B两个模型，均提供持续预训练的基础检查点及后续训练的变体。我们利用东南亚语言、推理、代码和多语言平行数据集对模型进行适配，并通过监督微调和在线策略内蒸馏进行后续训练。在SEA-HELM基准上，30B-A3B模型的整体SEA得分从46.06提升至51.57，而120B-A12B模型则从49.30提升至63.44。最强增益体现在指令遵循、自然语言推理和自然语言理解方面，覆盖七种东南亚语言。

summary: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly tackle long-horizon tasks through multi-step environment interaction, yet a single erroneous action can alter subsequent states and observations, causing errors to compound over time. Existing methods either correct the context without repairing altered environment states or restore earlier states while discarding useful experience, making it difficult to both eliminate failure conditions and avoid repeating past mistakes. We argue that reliable recovery should instead be treated as a rollback-boundary control problem that jointly determines when to intervene, where to resume, and what information should survive recovery. Based on this view, we propose Rollback-Induced Reflection (RIR), a unified recovery framework that restores execution to a selected prior state while carrying forward reusable knowledge distilled from the abandoned trajectory to guide subsequent decisions. We further characterize recovery through a unified operator over rollback depth and retained memory, providing a general view of state restoration and knowledge retention. Experiments on three long-horizon benchmarks demonstrate that RIR consistently improves task performance across multiple LLM backbones, with structured reflection memory preserving useful experience and selective rollback enabling efficient recovery.
title: Rollback the World, Keep the Reflection: Rollback-Induced Reflection for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
title_translated: 回滚世界，保留反思：长时序LLM智能体的回滚诱导反思机制
summary_translated: 大型语言模型（LLM）代理正通过多步环境交互处理长时序任务，但单个错误操作可能改变后续状态与观测，导致错误随时间累积。现有方法要么仅修正上下文而不修复被改变的环境状态，要么恢复早期状态却丢弃有用经验，难以同时消除失败条件并避免重复过去错误。我们认为，可靠的恢复应被视为一种回滚边界控制问题，需联合决定何时干预、从何处恢复以及哪些信息应保留在恢复过程中。基于此观点，我们提出回滚诱导反思（RIR）框架，可在恢复执行至选定先前状态的同时，将废弃轨迹中提炼出的可复用知识传递下去，以指导后续决策。我们进一步通过统一算子刻画回滚深度与保留记忆的关系，提供了一种通用的状态恢复与知识保留视角。在三个长时序基准上的实验表明，RIR在多个LLM骨干模型上均持续提升了任务性能，结构化反思记忆有效保留了有用经验，选择性回滚实现了高效恢复。

summary: In recent years, three initiatives have emerged to develop generative language models in Hungary. The motivation behind them is the same. For Hungarian, no model with the given capability existed, or existing English-centric models offered limited proficiency. A detailed examination of the corresponding studies, however, reveals several methodological limitations. First, the reliability of the evaluation protocols is questionable. Contrary to the findings of Csibi et al. [2026], evaluation under the recommended inference settings shows that Qwen3-4B achieves higher scores than Racka-4B, its Hungarian-adapted version. Data contamination is evident in the work of Yang et al. [2025d] and Szentmihályi et al. [2025], potentially biasing the reported results. Second, the training pipelines fall short of current best practices in corpus curation and data mixture, which risks wasting substantial compute on low-quality data. The lack of controlled ablations prevents reliable assessment of these choices. Third, none of the three papers assessed forgetting or capability loss. Testing the adapted models on a subset of the original benchmarks indicates performance decline in all three cases, especially Racka-4B. These observations emphasize the importance of rigorous experimental design in language model development, given the significant computational and financial costs involved.
title: Made in Hungary: Comments on the performance of generative language models
title_translated: 匈牙利制造：关于生成式语言模型性能的评论
summary_translated: 近年来，匈牙利出现了三项开发生成式语言模型的倡议。其动机相同：对于匈牙利语而言，尚不存在具备相应能力的模型，而现有的以英语为中心的模型表现有限。然而，对相关研究的详细分析揭示了若干方法论缺陷。首先，评估协议的可靠性存疑。与Csibi等人[2026]的发现相反，在推荐的推理设置下，Qwen3-4B的表现优于其匈牙利语适配版本Racka-4B。Yang等人[2025d]和Szentmihályi等人[2025]的研究中存在明显的数据污染，可能导致结果偏差。其次，训练流程未能达到当前最佳实践的语料库整理与数据混合标准，存在大量计算资源浪费于低质量数据的风险。缺乏受控消融实验，无法可靠评估这些选择的影响。第三，三篇论文均未评估遗忘或能力退化问题。在原始基准的子集上测试适配模型后发现，三者均出现性能下降，尤其以Racka-4B最为显著。这些观察强调了在语言模型开发中严谨实验设计的重要性，鉴于其巨大的计算与财务成本。

summary: Large language models are increasingly used to generate and evaluate online content, yet it remains unclear whether the qualities they associate with higher engagement match what real users respond to. We study this question using 1.17 million answers to 25,978 questions from Zhihu, Quora, and Reddit, comparing real platform answers and AI-generated answers across four within-question engagement levels. We introduce Ontological Preference Measurement, which represents answers along three dimensions: logic, affect, and expression. We find a systematic gap between AI preference and real user engagement: as target engagement increases, LLMs add more explicit logical structure, while real user engagement is more strongly associated with affective and expressive salience. We call this tendency logic overbinding. Based on this diagnosis, we propose Ontology-Masked Reasoning Autoencoding (OMRA), a controlled intervention that masks and reconstructs over-explained spans while preserving stance, factual content, and coherence. Across four LLM families, OMRA reduces the measured gap by an average of 54.4%. In human evaluation, OMRA wins 62.4% of pairwise preference judgments against matched real platform answers, even though the real answers are more often judged to be human-written.
title: Too Good to Be Real? Diagnosing and Reducing the Gap Between AI Preference and Real User Engagement
title_translated: 好得不像真的？诊断并减少AI偏好与真实用户参与度之间的差距
summary_translated: 大型语言模型越来越多地用于生成和评估在线内容，但其认为能带来更高参与度的特质是否真正符合真实用户的反应仍不明确。我们基于来自知乎、Quora和Reddit的117万条回答（共25,978个问题），通过四个问题内参与度层级，比较了真实平台回答与AI生成回答的表现。我们引入本体偏好测量方法，从逻辑、情感和表达三个维度表征回答。研究发现，AI偏好与真实用户参与度之间存在系统性差距：随着目标参与度提高，LLMs会增加更明显的逻辑结构，而真实用户参与度则更强烈地与情感和表达的显著性相关。我们称此现象为‘逻辑过度绑定’。基于该诊断，我们提出本体掩码推理自编码（OMRA），一种可控干预方法，通过掩码并重建过度解释的部分，同时保留立场、事实内容和连贯性。在四个LLM家族中，OMRA平均减少了54.4%的测量差距。在人类评估中，OMRA在与匹配的真实平台回答的成对偏好判断中胜出62.4%，尽管真实回答更常被认为是由人类撰写的。

summary: Classroom observations are widely recognized as a key tool for establishing benchmarks of education quality and guiding pedagogical improvement, yet they remain resource-intensive and dependent on trained observers. This study evaluated the feasibility of using a LLM (GPT-5 model) to score teacher-child interactions in early childhood classrooms, benchmarked against human raters. The study analyzed 87 video-recorded observations from 38 classrooms across 30 kindergartens in Hong Kong. Using observation transcripts, the AI model was configured to apply the full Classroom Assessment Scoring System (CLASS) framework. AI-rated scores were then compared with human ratings by examining correlations and differences in mean scores of the CLASS domains and dimensions. The results showed greater convergence between AI and raters for the Emotional Support domain and, in particular, the Quality of Feedback dimension, which captures how teachers use feedback to extend children's learning. Greater divergence emerged for interactions that were more procedural or context-dependent, particularly within the Classroom Organization and Instructional Support domains. These findings suggest that transcript-based AI scoring may capture some of the relative variation in teacher-child interactions but cannot yet reproduce calibrated human judgements consistently across the full CLASS framework. AI-assisted observation may therefore be more appropriate as a preliminary screening tool rather than as a replacement for trained observers, providing teachers with evidence for reflection rather than high-stakes evaluation. Future research should examine whether domain-specific training and incorporation of contextual and visual information can improve alignment between AI and human rated scores.
title: I code or AI code: A comparative evaluation of AI-rated scores in classroom observations
title_translated: 我编程还是AI编程：课堂观察中AI评分与人工评分的对比评估
summary_translated: 课堂观察被广泛认为是建立教育质量基准和指导教学改进的关键工具，但其仍存在资源消耗大且依赖 trained 观察员的问题。本研究评估了使用大语言模型（GPT-5模型）对早期儿童课堂中师生互动进行评分的可行性，并与人工评分进行对比。研究分析了来自香港30所幼儿园共38个班级的87段视频观察记录。通过观察转录文本，AI模型配置为应用完整的课堂评估评分系统（CLASS）框架。随后通过比较AI评分与人工评分在CLASS各维度和子维度上的相关性及均值差异来评估一致性。结果显示，AI与评分者在情感支持维度上具有更高的吻合度，尤其是在反映教师如何利用反馈延伸儿童学习的“反馈质量”维度上表现突出；而在更程序化或情境依赖性强的互动中，如课堂组织和教学支持维度，则出现更大分歧。这些发现表明，基于转录文本的AI评分可捕捉部分师生互动的相对差异，但尚无法在完整CLASS框架下一致复现校准的人工判断。因此，AI辅助观察可能更适合用作初步筛查工具，而非训练观察员的替代品，为教师提供反思依据而非高风险评估。未来研究应探讨领域特定训练以及引入上下文和视觉信息是否能提升AI与人工评分之间的一致性。

summary: Organizations increasingly use oversight loops where one large language model (LLM) audits another's outputs alongside procedural traces of claimed steps. A common concern about such LLM-as-a-judge pipelines is that detailed traces make overseers gullible. Using signal detection theory, we audit five LLM overseers on 19 compliance tasks (4,551 analyzed judgments), varying only trace detail and evidence labeling. With disconfirming evidence always visible, error detection remains near ceiling. Instead, elaborate traces shift the decision criterion toward rejection, increasing false alarms in susceptible overseers. Without option labels, human-validated reason coding shows about 60% of false alarms cite an inability to tie evidence to its option. Labels eliminate this stated reason, yet residual rejection of correct work persists in those overseers and rises with trace detail. Procedural traces thus act as governance artifacts that shape oversight decisions. AI auditors should be evaluated by their decision criterion and false-alarm behavior, alongside accuracy.
title: Beyond Accuracy: How Procedural Traces Shift the Decision Criterion of LLM Overseers
comment: 11 pages, 4 figures, 3 tables. Accepted at the 60th Hawaii International Conference on System Sciences (HICSS)
title_translated: 超越准确率：程序化轨迹如何改变LLM监督者的决策标准
summary_translated: 组织越来越多地采用监督循环，即一个大型语言模型（LLM）在伴随声称步骤的程序化轨迹的情况下审计另一个模型的输出。关于此类LLM作为裁判管道的一个常见担忧是，详细的轨迹会使监督者变得易受欺骗。基于信号检测理论，我们对五个LLM监督者在19项合规任务（4,551个分析判断）上进行了审计，仅变化轨迹细节和证据标注方式。当反证始终可见时，错误检测率接近上限。相反，详尽的轨迹会促使监督者的决策标准转向拒绝，导致敏感监督者产生更多误报。在无选项标签的情况下，经人类验证的理由编码显示约60%的误报源于无法将证据与对应选项关联。标签消除这一陈述原因，但这些监督者仍持续拒绝正确工作，且随着轨迹详细程度增加而上升。因此，程序化轨迹作为治理工具，影响了监督决策。AI审计者应从其决策标准和误报行为角度进行评估，而不仅限于准确性。

summary: Human values are deep motivational orientations that shape human behaviors. In e-commerce, they reveal the stable drivers behind users' purchase decisions. Compared with short-term interests, consumer values better explain how users evaluate products before purchase. However, consumer values are often implicit in complex and fragmented behavioral trajectories, leaving value measurement from e-commerce behaviors largely underexplored. To this end, we propose the Behavior-to-Value (B2V) task, which aims to identify consumer values from e-commerce behavioral trajectories. Centered on this task, we first construct the E-commerce Consumption Value Taxonomy (ECVT) and introduce B2V-Bench, the first B2V dataset and benchmark, based on anonymized Taobao behavioral logs. B2V-Bench consists of real-world purchase decision episodes, covering 25 types of purchase behaviors, along with corresponding consumer value orientations manifested in each episode. To improve consumer value measurement accuracy, we further present B2V-Verifier, a behavior-to-value measurement model based on Value Verification Tuning, which learns to assess whether behaviors provide sufficient evidence for each value inference. Experiments show that B2V-Verifier outperforms strong LLM baselines, improving multi-label classification by 34\%. The dataset and code will be publicly released upon acceptance.
title: Behavior2Value: Benchmarking and Empowering LLMs for Consumer Value Measurement from E-commerce Behaviors
title_translated: Behavior2Value：从电商行为中测量消费者价值的基准与赋能
summary_translated: 人类价值观是深层动机导向，塑造人类行为。在电子商务中，它们揭示了用户购买决策背后的稳定驱动力。相较于短期兴趣，消费者价值观更能解释用户在购买前如何评估产品。然而，消费者价值观常隐含于复杂且碎片化的行为轨迹中，导致从电商行为中测量价值的研究仍处于探索阶段。为此，我们提出行为到价值（B2V）任务，旨在从电商行为轨迹中识别消费者价值观。围绕该任务，我们首先构建了电商消费价值分类体系（ECVT），并推出了首个B2V数据集与基准——B2V-Bench，基于匿名淘宝行为日志。B2V-Bench包含真实世界的购买决策片段，涵盖25种购买行为类型，以及每种情境下体现的消费者价值取向。为提高价值测量精度，我们进一步提出B2V-Verifier，一种基于价值验证微调的行为到价值测量模型，能够学习判断行为是否为每种价值推断提供了充分证据。实验表明，B2V-Verifier优于多个强基线LLM，在多标签分类任务上提升34%。数据集与代码将在论文接受后公开发布。

summary: In Taiwanese Hokkien automatic speech recognition (ASR), prior studies often treat tone sandhi as a major challenge under the assumption that models fail to process implicit phonological variations. However, our experiments on Taiwanese Hokkien reveal that speech foundation models actually handle tone sandhi variations effectively, and the real performance bottleneck stems from a localized confusion between these variations and retained citation tones. To address this, we propose T-SANDHI to explicitly decouple surface acoustics from underlying lexical intent on top of a frozen Whisper backbone. Using a lexicon-guided multi-task learning structure driven by text-derived pseudo labels, our lightweight hybrid injection module integrates independent citation and sandhi phonetic streams via dynamic gating. Extensive evaluation on the TAT-MOE corpus and two blind test sets demonstrates that this explicit disentanglement effectively resolves tonal mapping confusion, outperforming baselines with strict parameter efficiency.
title: T-SANDHI: Tone Sandhi-aware Adaptive Network with Decoupled Hybrid Injection for Low-resource Taiwanese Hokkien Speech Recognition
title_translated: T-SANDHI：面向低资源台湾话语音识别的声调变调感知自适应网络与解耦混合注入机制
summary_translated: 在台湾话自动语音识别（ASR）中，以往研究通常将声调变调视为主要挑战，假设模型无法处理隐含的音系变化。然而，我们在台湾话上的实验表明，语音基础模型实际上能有效处理声调变调变化，真正的性能瓶颈在于这些变化与保留的引用声调之间的局部混淆。为解决此问题，我们提出了T-SANDHI方法，在冻结的Whisper骨干网络基础上，显式解耦表面声学特征与底层词汇意图。通过由文本生成伪标签驱动的词典引导多任务学习结构，我们的轻量级混合注入模块通过动态门控整合独立的引用音素流与变调音素流。在TAT-MOE语料库及两个盲测集上的大量评估表明，这种显式解耦有效解决了声调映射混淆问题，优于基线方法，同时保持严格的参数效率。

summary: Teochew has a substantial speaker community and exhibits distinctive lexical, syntactic, and pragmatic features, yet textual resources for evaluating large language models remain limited. We present TeochewBench, a human-reviewed benchmark comprising 300 Teochew Hanzi expressions for evaluating translation from Teochew Hanzi into Mandarin Chinese and English. The dataset covers five categories: basic vocabulary; everyday sentences; Teochew-specific expressions; tone, politeness, and context; and idiomatic, ambiguous, and culturally specific expressions. A primary Teochew-speaking reviewer examined all entries individually and revised them as needed, while two additional Teochew speakers verified selected items.   Our main evaluation covers 11 official general-purpose post-trained models on the reviewed dataset in both translation directions, yielding 6,600 predictions. Two official base checkpoints provide 1,200 predictions for supplementary diagnostics, bringing the total to 13 models and 7,800 predictions. We additionally include a Hanzi-copy control, which returns the source input unchanged, to assess how shared Hanzi affect automatic scores for translation into Mandarin Chinese. Qwen3.5-27B achieved the highest overall chrF-style score among the evaluated checkpoints, at 60.63, followed by Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct at 56.61, Gemma-3-27B-IT at 56.36, and GLM-4-32B-0414 at 55.82. Across the 11 main-evaluation models, the mean chrF-style score decreased from 69.25 for low-specificity items to 27.52 for high-specificity items. High-specificity expressions received lower scores and exhibited smaller cross-model differences, suggesting that they constitute a shared low-scoring region across the model families evaluated here. The Hanzi-copy control further indicates that surface overlap in low-specificity items can substantially affect automatic scores for translation into Mandarin Chinese.
title: TeochewBench: A Human-Reviewed Benchmark for Teochew Hanzi Translation
title_translated: TeochewBench：潮州话汉字翻译的人工评审基准
summary_translated: 潮州话拥有庞大的使用者群体，具有独特的词汇、句法和语用特征，但用于评估大语言模型的文本资源仍然有限。我们提出了TeochewBench，一个经过人工评审的基准数据集，包含300个潮州话汉字表达，用于评估潮州话汉字到普通话和英语的翻译。该数据集涵盖五大类别：基础词汇；日常句子；潮州话特有表达；声调、礼貌与语境；习语、模糊及文化特异性表达。一位主要的潮州话母语评审员逐一检查所有条目并按需修订，另有两位潮州话使用者对部分项目进行验证。主要评估覆盖11个官方通用预训练模型在双向翻译方向上的表现，共生成6,600次预测。此外，两个官方基础检查点提供1,200次补充诊断预测，总计涉及13个模型和7,800次预测。我们还引入了汉字复制对照组，即原样返回源输入，以评估共享汉字对翻译至普通话时自动评分的影响。Qwen3.5-27B在所有评估检查点中取得最高chrF风格得分（60.63），其次为Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct（56.61）、Gemma-3-27B-IT（56.36）和GLM-4-32B-0414（55.82）。在11个主评模型中，平均chrF风格得分从低特异性项目（69.25）下降至高特异性项目（27.52）。高特异性表达得分较低，且跨模型差异较小，表明它们构成了此处评估模型族中的共同低分区域。汉字复制对照组进一步表明，低特异性项目中的表面重叠会显著影响翻译至普通话的自动评分。

summary: State-of-the-art Text-to-SQL systems are typically multi-agent pipelines centered around two fundamental tasks: schema linking and SQL generation. However, existing work trains separate models for each task, failing to leverage the synergy between these interrelated tasks. In this work, we propose DualSQL, a new Text-to-SQL system consisting of two agents powered by a single model backbone. The agents share the same model weights and agentic scaffold, enabling joint optimization through a robust multi-agent reinforcement learning (RL) framework. We design three database access tools to facilitate effective multi-step reasoning grounded to interactions with the databases. To improve training and avoid model collapse, we introduce a set of rollout guardrail mechanisms that stabilizes multi-agent RL training, supporting DualSQL to keep improving during training. We also introduce a new SQL correctness metric, robust execution match (REX), to more accurately judge SQL correctness and assign reward signals. Being trained on only 3755 examples, DualSQL-4B achieves an impressive 68.0% execution accuracy on the BIRD development set, matching previous 7B models. DualSQL-8B further improves to 71.1%, outperforming previous state-of-the-art single-model solutions with 32B parameters. These results demonstrate the strength of joint multi-agent reinforcement learning for building high performance Text-to-SQL pipelines.
title: DualSQL: Text-to-SQL with Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
title_translated: DualSQL：基于多智能体强化学习的文本到SQL系统
summary_translated: 当前最先进的文本到SQL系统通常是由两个核心任务（模式链接和SQL生成）构成的多智能体流水线。然而，现有方法为每个任务分别训练模型，未能充分利用这些相互关联任务之间的协同效应。本文提出DualSQL，一种由单个模型主干驱动的双智能体文本到SQL系统。两个智能体共享相同的模型权重和智能体架构，通过稳健的多智能体强化学习（RL）框架实现联合优化。我们设计了三种数据库访问工具，以支持基于与数据库交互的多步推理。为提升训练效果并避免模型崩溃，引入了一套回滚防护机制，稳定多智能体强化学习训练过程，使DualSQL在训练中持续改进。此外，我们提出一种新的SQL正确性度量标准——鲁棒执行匹配（REX），更准确地判断SQL正确性并提供奖励信号。仅用3755个样本训练的DualSQL-4B在BIRD开发集上达到68.0%的执行准确率，与之前的7B模型相当；DualSQL-8B进一步提升至71.1%，优于参数量达32B的先前最优单模型解决方案。这些结果展示了联合多智能体强化学习在构建高性能文本到SQL流水线中的强大能力。

summary: Open-weight large language models are rapidly entering hiring pipelines, yet their discriminatory failure modes -- and the regulatory exposure these create under the EU AI Act high-risk classification (Annex III) and U.S. EEOC adverse-impact analysis -- remain poorly understood. We present the first systematic, multi-model audit of open-weight LLMs that treats job-posting language as the primary experimental variable, evaluating six models (Llama 3.2, Mistral, Gemma 3, Qwen 3, Phi 3, DeepSeek-R1) across four controlled experiments that jointly probe recruiter-simulation and job-seeker-simulation tasks. We find that (1) agentic posting language depresses recruiter recommendation scores for female candidates (r_rb = 0.309, p_Bonf = 7x10^-5; model-fixed-effects r_rb = 0.448), while communal language partially reverses the penalty; and (2) coded-exclusion language suppresses non-White recruiter scores at large effect sizes (r_rb = 0.646-0.758) and, on the job-seeker side, selectively deters non-White personas from expressing interest -- operationalizing a chilling-effect mechanism at scale. A label-ablation experiment isolates the explicit demographic persona label as the primary causal driver, and Word Embedding Association Tests corroborate these findings at the representational level (d = 1.01-1.45 under Caliskan et al.'s multi-word gender attribute lists). We translate these results into a concrete pre-deployment audit protocol -- posting-vocabulary scoring, persona-conditioned LLM probing, and adverse-impact flagging against the four-fifths threshold -- that operationalizes the documentation and risk-management obligations Annex III imposes on high-risk AI in recruitment.
title: Linguistic Triggers of Gender and Racial Bias in Open-Weight LLMs Applied to Recruitment
comment: Accepted at the 9th AAAI/ACM Conference on AI, Ethics, and Society (AIES 2026). Extended version with Appendices A-B (prompt templates and full stimulus set)
title_translated: 开放权重大语言模型在招聘中性别与种族偏见的语言触发因素
summary_translated: 开放权重的大语言模型正快速进入招聘流程，但其歧视性失效模式——以及在欧盟AI法案高风险分类（附录III）和美国EEOC不利影响分析下的监管风险——仍缺乏充分理解。我们首次系统性地对六种开放权重大语言模型（Llama 3.2、Mistral、Gemma 3、Qwen 3、Phi 3、DeepSeek-R1）进行了多模型审计，将职位发布语言作为主要实验变量，在四个受控实验中同时考察招聘者模拟与求职者模拟任务。研究发现：(1) 智能体化职位描述语言会显著降低对女性候选人的推荐评分（r_rb = 0.309, p_Bonf = 7×10^-5；模型固定效应r_rb = 0.448），而共情型语言可部分逆转该惩罚；(2) 隐含排除性语言在大效应量下抑制非白人招聘者的评分（r_rb = 0.646–0.758），且在求职者侧，选择性地阻止非白人身份者表达兴趣——在大规模上实现了寒蝉效应机制。标签消融实验确认显式人口统计标签是主要因果驱动因素，词嵌入关联测试在表征层面验证了这些发现（d = 1.01–1.45，基于Caliskan等人多词性别属性列表）。我们将结果转化为具体的部署前审计协议——职位词汇评分、基于身份条件的LLM探测、以及四分之五阈值下的不利影响标记——以落实附录III对高风险AI在招聘中所要求的文档记录与风险管理义务。

summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in high-stakes domains such as housing screening. While alignment techniques mitigate explicit racial bias in generated text, they often leave covert attitudinal associations in internal probability distributions untouched. Adapting the matched-guise sociolinguistic paradigm, we examine covert dialect bias in housing-related social judgments across four varieties: Standard American English (SAE), African American Vernacular English (AAVE), Nigerian Standard English (NSE), and Nigerian Pidgin (NP). AAVE reflects the racialized dialect studied in prior covert-bias evaluations, whereas NSE and NP represent Black African, postcolonial varieties absent from this literature. Using 260 meaning-matched sentence quadruples and log-probability scoring over housing-relevant adjectives, we probe ten open-weight LLMs across three contexts varying in social proximity: tenant screening, neighbor acceptance, and roommate selection. Across all ten models, AAVE and NP are consistently associated with more negative adjectives than SAE, with NP penalized most severely. Crucially, each dialect is penalized via distinct stereotype clusters rather than a generic non-standard category. NSE, which carries institutional prestige, displays a context-dependent shift: favored over SAE in formal tenant screening but increasingly penalized as social proximity grows. Our findings reveal that LLMs inherit covert dialect bias along both racial identity and prestige dimensions, echoing documented human housing discrimination and demonstrating its reach across postcolonial English varieties.
title: From a River in Gilead to the Inference Distributions of Large Language Models: Covert Dialect Bias and Linguistic Profiling at Scale
comment: 12 pages, 5 figures. Accepted to the 9th AAAI/ACM Conference on AI, Ethics, and Society (AIES 2026)
title_translated: 从基列的河流到大语言模型的推理分布：大规模隐性方言偏见与语言特征刻画
summary_translated: 大语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地被应用于住房筛选等高风险领域。尽管对齐技术缓解了生成文本中的显性种族偏见，但往往未能消除内部概率分布中的隐性态度关联。借鉴匹配姿态社会语言学范式，我们考察了四种语言变体在住房相关社会判断中的隐性方言偏见：标准美式英语（SAE）、非裔美国人非正式英语（AAVE）、尼日利亚标准英语（NSE）和尼日利亚皮钦语（NP）。AAVE是以往隐性偏见评估中研究过的种族化方言，而NSE和NP代表此前文献中缺失的黑非洲后殖民语言变体。使用260组意义匹配的句子四元组及针对住房相关形容词的对数概率评分，我们在三个社会接近度不同的情境（租户筛选、邻居接纳、室友选择）下对十种开放权重LLM进行探测。所有十种模型均一致显示，AAVE和NP相较于SAE与更负面的形容词相关联，其中NP受到最严重惩罚。关键的是，每种方言均通过独特的刻板印象集群受到惩罚，而非泛化的“非标准”类别。NSE因具有制度声望，在正式租户筛选中优于SAE，但随着社会接近度增加，其劣势逐渐显现。研究揭示LLMs在种族身份与声望维度上继承了隐性方言偏见，呼应已知的人类住房歧视现象，并表明这种偏见已扩展至后殖民英语变体。

summary: We characterize when compressed vector representations admit exact linear or affine readouts of a finite lexicon's truth conditions: one fixed map per predicate, sending each entity vector to the corresponding truth vector. A necessary and sufficient row-space condition determines existence; the augmented truth matrix has rank r, giving minimum dimension r in the linear case, and r-1 in the affine. Exact readouts return values in a shared truth basis on which Boolean connectives act unchanged; separability alone requires an intervening threshold. For binary relations, exact bilinear readout of identity or strict total order requires linearly independent entity vectors. Experiments with GloVe and word2vec distinguish exact affine recovery, linear separability, and held-out prediction: most predicates are strictly separable, but none admits an exact affine readout from the pretrained embeddings. Supervised transductive training attains exact affine recovery to numerical precision at every tested dimension meeting the bound. At the embeddings' original dimension, geometries constrained to exact linear recovery retain 98-99 percent of the pretrained variance on the feature norms, and 80-83 percent on the WordNet lexicon.
title: Exact semantic readout from compressed vector representations
title_translated: 从压缩向量表示中精确读取语义
summary_translated: 我们研究了压缩向量表示在何种条件下能够对有限词典的真值条件实现精确的线性或仿射读出：即每个谓词对应一个固定映射，将每个实体向量映射到相应的真值向量。存在性由一个必要且充分的行空间条件决定；扩充后的真值矩阵秩为r，线性情况下最小维度为r，仿射情况下为r-1。精确读出返回共享真值基上的值，布尔连接词作用不变；仅靠可分离性则需中间阈值。对于二元关系，实现身份或严格全序的精确双线性读出需要实体向量线性独立。在GloVe和word2vec上的实验区分了精确仿射恢复、线性可分离性和未见预测：大多数谓词严格可分离，但无一能从预训练嵌入中实现精确仿射读出。监督式归纳训练在满足边界的所有测试维度上达到了数值精度的精确仿射恢复。在原始嵌入维度下，几何结构受限于精确线性恢复时，保留了98%-99%的预训练特征范数方差，以及80%-83%的WordNet词典方差。

summary: In collaborative tasks with asymmetric information, participants coordinate their understanding through interaction. We ask whether gaze provides evidence about grounding across two such tasks. Working from discrete behavioral annotations, we map HCRC MapTask (Anderson et al., 1991) and MUNDEX (Türk et al., 2023) into a shared partner/task/away vocabulary and compute gaze features around task-relevant dialogue units. In both corpora, aligned reference interpretations (MapTask) and UND (understood) judgments (MUNDEX) are associated with more task-directed gaze and with less partner-directed gaze, lower gaze entropy, and fewer gaze transitions. The associations are clearest for the participant leading the task: in giver-produced references, and in explainer judgments, which also co-vary with the explainee's gaze. In same-speaker MapTask reference chains, the speaker's gaze entropy is lower at the mention where a previously non-aligned referent becomes aligned. The best gaze feature groups improve modestly over controls under grouped cross-validation: temporal features in MapTask and raw proportions in MUNDEX. Because effects are small and several weaken when recurring participants rather than dialogues are the unit of inference, we treat gaze as one contributing cue to grounding, to be interpreted alongside task and dialogue context.
title: Gaze as Evidence for Common Grounding: A Cross-Corpus Analysis of MapTask and MUNDEX
comment: 16 pages, 17 tables, 2 figures; accepted to the MINT workshop at EMNLP 2026 (oral presentation)
title_translated: 凝视作为共同理解的证据：MapTask与MUNDEX跨语料库分析
summary_translated: 在信息不对称的协作任务中，参与者通过互动协调彼此的理解。我们探讨凝视是否能为跨两项此类任务的共同理解提供证据。基于离散行为标注，我们将HCRC MapTask（Anderson等，1991）和MUNDEX（Türk等，2023）映射到统一的伙伴/任务/远离词汇体系，并计算围绕任务相关对话单元的凝视特征。在两个语料库中，对齐的参考解释（MapTask）和UN有效理解判断（MUNDEX）均与更多任务导向凝视、更少伙伴导向凝视、更低凝视熵和更少凝视转换相关。这些关联在主导任务的参与者中最为明显：在发送者产生的参考中，以及在解释者判断中，后者还与听者凝视共同变化。在同说话人MapTask参考链中，当先前未对齐的指代物变为对齐时，说话人的凝视熵降低。最佳凝视特征组合在分组交叉验证下略优于对照组：MapTask中为时间特征，MUNDEX中为原始比例。由于效应较小，且当以重复参与者而非对话为推断单位时多个效应减弱，我们将凝视视为共同理解的一个辅助线索，需结合任务和对话上下文综合解读。

summary: Large language model optimization is an active research area, spanning quantization of model weights, early-exit methods for skipping layers, and speculative decoding. Each track uses its own quality measures, typically an idiosyncratic benchmark score. Few approach the measurement precision required by other scientific disciplines.   We propose a rigorous methodology for measuring output quality, suitable for cross-system and cross-technique comparison. We score outputs with an LLM as a judge, but calibrate the judge formally: we compare its scores on two ordinary runs of a model given the same prompts, verifying that it shows no systematic preference between statistically equivalent outputs and measuring its per-sample noise. Each design also includes a 'null' condition, provably identical in distribution to the unmodified model, whose measured difference must be zero.   With this one instrument we measure several acceleration techniques on the same prompts, so their quality costs can be compared. Perceived quality proves highly dependent on the domain of discourse. A 4-bit model was indistinguishable from its 16-bit original down to our design's +/-0.3-point resolution, in English prose and Chinese alike. At 3-bit precision the same prompts lost 0.5 points in English prose, 0.9 in Chinese, and 1.1 on multi-step math; early exit that cost 0.7 points on prose cost 2.5 on math, cutting correctly solved problems from 19 of 27 to 6. The pattern held for models from Alibaba and from Meta, but not its magnitude: the same quantizer cost Meta's model 1.8 points where it cost Alibaba's 0.7.   A model's certainty about a token predicts how likely it is to differ from the full model's choice, but not how much that difference affects judged quality, so acceptance rules relying on certainty cannot distinguish errors that matter from errors that don't.
title: A Calibrated Instrument for Measuring How Inference Optimizations Affect Output Quality
comment: 23 Pages. 6 tables in main text,5 tables in appendices. Code, prompts, and result files at this https URL
title_translated: 一种用于测量推理优化对输出质量影响的校准仪器
summary_translated: 大型语言模型优化是一个活跃的研究领域，涵盖模型权重量化、跳过层的提前退出方法以及推测解码。每个方向使用各自的质量度量标准，通常是独特的基准分数。很少有研究能达到其他科学领域所需的测量精度。我们提出了一种严谨的方法来测量输出质量，适用于跨系统和跨技术的比较。我们使用大语言模型作为评判者打分，但对评判者进行正式校准：比较同一模型在相同提示下的两次常规运行中评判者的评分，验证其在统计上等价的输出之间没有系统性偏好，并测量每样本的噪声。每个设计还包括一个‘零’条件，其分布与未修改模型完全相同，测得的差异必须为零。通过这一工具，我们可以在相同提示下测量多种加速技术的质量成本。感知质量高度依赖于话语领域。4比特模型在英语散文和中文中均与16比特原始模型无法区分，达到我们设计的±0.3分分辨率；而在3比特精度下，相同提示在英语散文中损失0.5分，中文中损失0.9分，多步数学问题中损失1.1分；提前退出在散文中损失0.7分，在数学中损失2.5分，正确解答的问题数从27个中的19个降至6个。该模式在阿里巴巴和Meta的模型中均成立，但幅度不同：同一量化器对Meta模型造成1.8分损失，而对阿里巴巴模型仅造成0.7分损失。模型对某个词元的确定性可预测其与完整模型选择不同的可能性，但无法预测该差异对评判质量的影响，因此依赖确定性的接受规则无法区分重要错误与不重要错误。

summary: Acquiring telicity, which is the distinction between bounded (e.g., ate an apple) and unbounded (e.g., ate apples) events, requires first language (L1) learners to map surface-level and semantic cues to abstract event structures, but the computational trajectory of this mapping is not well understood. We introduce a Difference in Surprisal method that uses GPT2 token surprisal over paired temporal adverbial diagnostics (in an hour versus for an hour) to automatically label telicity across English CHILDES corpora, validated against expert linguist judgments. Using these labels, we train diagnostic logistic regression classifiers on 12 syntactic and lexical semantic features to compare how child speech and child-directed speech encode telicity. The two models diverge: the child model reaches near perfect accuracy through a single deterministic cue, the presence of a post-verbal determiner, while the adult model relies more heavily on verb class and other lexical semantic features, with the determiner cue neutralized. This trajectory supports Syntactic Bootstrapping: learners first exploit high-frequency structural cues as a scaffold to bootstrap, before developing fully compositional, verb-based event structures.
title: Modeling the Developmental Shift in Telicity Acquisition
title_translated: 描述性获取发展转变的建模
summary_translated: 掌握描述性（即有界事件如‘吃了一个苹果’与无界事件如‘吃了苹果’之间的区别）需要第一语言学习者将表面线索和语义线索映射到抽象事件结构，但这种映射的计算轨迹尚不明确。我们引入了一种‘突变差异’方法，利用GPT2对成对时间状语诊断（如‘在一小时内’与‘持续一小时’）的词元意外度，自动标注英语CHILDES语料库中的描述性，结果经专家语言学家判断验证。利用这些标注，我们在12个句法和词汇语义特征上训练诊断逻辑回归分类器，以比较儿童言语和成人导向言语如何编码描述性。两个模型表现出分化：儿童模型通过单一确定性线索——动词后置限定词的存在——达到接近完美的准确率，而成人模型则更依赖动词类别和其他词汇语义特征，且限定词线索被中和。这一轨迹支持句法启动假说：学习者最初利用高频结构线索作为支架进行初步构建，随后发展出完整的、基于动词的事件结构。

summary: Large-scale machine-translation (MT) systems are typically evaluated on random samples from a corpus whose distributional composition is an artifact of how it was assembled. Such a sample inherits the phenomena the collection happens to contain rather than the full space a system must handle, spanning rule-governed conventions (terminology, punctuation, currency formatting) and context-dependent phenomena (tone, honorifics, document-level coherence), and thus provides no coverage guarantee for assessing robustness. We propose TACTICS (Taxonomy-Aware Coverage-opTimized Intelligent Corpus Sampling), which recasts coverage as an explicit objective. TACTICS induces a hierarchical taxonomy from a locale style guide, classifies segments against it, and selects a fixed-budget subset jointly optimizing coverage of rare categories, document-level coherence, and distributional fidelity to the full corpus. Applied to MT evaluation across four translation directions, TACTICS improves coverage of rare categories over lexical and embedding-based selection. By targeting the phenomena that separate systems, TACTICS makes a fixed evaluation budget go further, recovering the true system ranking from far fewer segments than random sampling wherever a real quality gap exists and never signaling a difference where none exists.
title: TACTICS: Taxonomy-Aware Intelligent Corpus Sampling for Machine Translation
comment: Accepted at The Eleventh Conference in Machine Translation 2026 (WMT2026)
title_translated: TACTICS：面向机器翻译的分类意识智能语料采样方法
summary_translated: 大规模机器翻译（MT）系统通常在语料库的随机样本上进行评估，而该语料库的分布组成是其收集方式的产物。此类样本继承了收集过程中偶然包含的现象，而非系统必须处理的全部范围，包括规则性惯例（术语、标点、货币格式）和上下文依赖现象（语气、敬语、文档级连贯性），因此无法保证评估鲁棒性的覆盖。我们提出TACTICS（分类意识覆盖优化智能语料采样），将覆盖性重新定义为显式目标。TACTICS从本地风格指南中推导出层次化分类体系，对语段进行分类，并联合优化稀有类别覆盖、文档级连贯性和与全语料库的分布保真度，选取固定预算的子集。应用于四个翻译方向的MT评估中，TACTICS在稀有类别覆盖方面优于基于词汇和嵌入的采样方法。通过聚焦区分系统的关键现象，TACTICS使固定评估预算发挥更大作用，在存在真实质量差距时，用更少的语段恢复真实系统排名，且在无差异情况下从不发出差异信号。

summary: Who the judge is can affect an LLM-as-judge result, but measuring that effect without confusing it with candidate quality is difficult. We study four open-weight families (Llama 3.1, Qwen 2.5, Gemma 2, and Yi 1.5) in a fully crossed pairwise design with 9,312 judgments. A common per-family statistic is strongly confounded with candidate quality and correlates with Bradley-Terry ability at r = 0.95. We derive a corrected estimator that holds the candidate family fixed and compares judges. All four families then show a positive same-family lift (3.4-8.4 percentage points), with global FPS 0.067 (95% CI [0.053, 0.084], permutation p = 0.0002). The effect remains under panel-based quality controls, an independent human-consensus anchor, and a float16 judging replication. Judge-side likelihood is closely related to the effect: adding likelihood advantage reduces the controlled coefficient by 61%, which we treat as descriptive attenuation rather than causal mediation. Position is a separate failure mode. Across the panel, 55.4% of AB/BA pairs reverse, and reversal above 50% is incompatible with a simple independent content-noise model. Relative to a family-balanced reference, panel composition changes 18.5% of pairwise outcomes. A complete reproducibility archive has been prepared for public release.
title: Who Judges Matters: Measuring Family-Conditioned Preference in LLM-as-Judge Panels
title_translated: 评判者身份至关重要：测量LLM作为评判组中的家庭条件偏好
summary_translated: 评判者身份会影响LLM作为评判者的评估结果，但在不混淆候选质量的情况下测量这种影响十分困难。我们研究了四种开源权重家族（Llama 3.1、Qwen 2.5、Gemma 2 和 Yi 1.5），采用完全交叉的成对设计，共完成9,312次评判。一种常见的家族统计量与候选质量严重混杂，与Bradley-Terry能力的相关系数高达 r = 0.95。我们推导出一种校正估计器，固定候选家族并比较评判者。结果显示，所有四个家族均表现出显著的同家族提升（3.4–8.4个百分点），全局家庭偏好得分（FPS）为0.067（95% 置信区间 [0.053, 0.084]，置换检验 p = 0.0002）。该效应在基于面板的质量控制、独立的人类共识锚点以及float16评判复现中依然存在。评判侧似然性与该效应密切相关：增加似然优势会使校正系数降低61%，我们将其视为描述性衰减而非因果中介。位置是另一种独立的失效模式：在面板中，55.4%的AB/BA对出现反转，超过50%的反转与简单独立内容-噪声模型不兼容。相对于平衡家族的参考组，面板构成改变了18.5%的成对结果。完整的可重复性归档已准备就绪，将公开发布。

summary: AfriSyCo studies answer switching around African-language factual content with two complementary layers: native-language follow-ups and a controlled cross-language factorial whose question, options, and target remain in the African language while the follow-up framing is English. We analyze 1,415 turn-1-correct model-language-item observations derived from 100 source questions across seven open-weight checkpoints and six languages; turn-1-correct denotes observed first-response accuracy, not demonstrated knowledge. Under native prompts, assertive endorsement produces 29.3 percentage points more any-turn false-target selection than mention-plus-verification (M+V), with a 19.0-point immediate T2 contrast. In the precommitted 2 x 2 factorial, averaged over three tested prompt families, assertive framing increases target selection by 30.4 points (95% CI [28.4, 32.3]); verification decreases it by 17.4 points, while the assertive effect rises from 20.5 points without verification to 40.2 with it (interaction +19.7). The effect remains 34.8 points among 611 observations correct after option reordering. Magnitude varies sharply by wording and checkpoint: prompt-family effects span 20.1-42.5 points, a Twi/Qwen3 paraphrase shifts target selection from 70.8% to 4.2%, and checkpoint effects span 9.2-47.0 points. Prompt realization is therefore part of the measurement problem.
title: AfriSyCo: Measuring Assertive Framing, Verification, and Wording Sensitivity Around African-Language Content
title_translated: AfriSyCo：围绕非洲语言内容的断言框架、验证与措辞敏感性测量
summary_translated: AfriSyCo通过两层互补方法研究非洲语言事实内容中的答案切换：原生语言后续提问和受控跨语言因子设计，其中问题、选项和目标保持在非洲语言，而后续提问框架使用英语。我们分析了来自100个源问题、七个开源检查点和六种语言的1,415个第一轮正确模型语言项观察结果；‘第一轮正确’指观察到的第一响应准确率，而非展示的知识。在原生提示下，断言性肯定导致任何一轮错误目标选择比‘提及+验证’（M+V）高出29.3个百分点，即时T2对比相差19.0点。在预承诺的2×2因子设计中，平均覆盖三个测试提示族，断言性框架使目标选择增加30.4点（95% 置信区间 [28.4, 32.3]）；验证使目标选择减少17.4点，而断言效应从无验证时的20.5点上升至有验证时的40.2点（交互效应+19.7）。该效应在611个经过选项重排后仍正确的观察中仍保持34.8点。效应大小因措辞和检查点而异：提示族效应跨度为20.1–42.5点，Twi/Qwen3的改写使目标选择从70.8%降至4.2%，检查点效应跨度为9.2–47.0点。因此，提示实现本身是测量问题的一部分。

summary: Limited controlled evidence exists on how training data, adaptation method, and model scale jointly affect tool-calling performance in language-model agents. We evaluate supervised fine-tuning (SFT) with LoRA, reinforcement learning (RL) via Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), and SFT followed by GRPO across six Qwen3 models from 0.6B to 32B parameters, covering both in-distribution performance and cross-dataset transfer. SFT with LoRA is the strongest in-distribution method throughout the 0.6B-32B range and best in 15 out of 18 experimental settings. On cross-dataset transfer, the methods are closer: GRPO wins 29 out of 54 settings where training and test datasets differ, but its margin over SFT averages under one point, and SFT->GRPO is rarely strongest in either comparison. Dataset mixing gives consistently strong transfer while staying close to specialized in-distribution training, regardless of method. Additional analysis further confirms that LoRA outperforms full-parameter fine-tuning, demonstrating that LoRA better preserves pretrained agentic behavior.
title: SFT or RL for Tool-Calling Agents? A Controlled Study Across Data, Method, and Scale
comment: Accepted to the REALM Workshop at EMNLP 2026
title_translated: 工具调用智能体的SFT还是RL？一项跨数据、方法与规模的受控研究
summary_translated: 目前关于训练数据、适应方法和模型规模如何共同影响语言模型智能体的工具调用性能，缺乏充分的受控证据。我们评估了使用LoRA的监督微调（SFT）、通过组相对策略优化（GRPO）的强化学习（RL），以及SFT后接GRPO的方法，在六款参数量从0.6B到32B的Qwen3模型上的表现，涵盖分布内性能和跨数据集迁移能力。在整个0.6B-32B范围内，使用LoRA的SFT在分布内表现最强，并在18个实验设置中的15个中表现最佳。在跨数据集迁移方面，各方法差距较小：GRPO在54个训练与测试数据集不同的设置中胜出29次，但其相对于SFT的平均优势不足1分，且SFT→GRPO很少成为最优方案。数据混合在各种方法下均表现出一致的强迁移能力，同时保持接近专用分布内训练的表现。进一步分析还证实，LoRA优于全参数微调，表明LoRA更能保留预训练智能体的行为特性。

summary: Autonomous research agents aim to automate scientific workflows, from proposing ideas to conducting experiments and analyzing results. Yet current AI and research agents can propose more directions than available resources allow them to pursue. Moreover, each attempt could consume substantial resources, requiring agents to reconsider how to invest in subsequent research. Thus, deciding how to invest research effort strategically should be a defining capability of autonomous research agents. Accordingly, we introduce PrimeScientist, which jointly determines research direction and resource investment across successive research attempts. Specifically, we formulate this challenge of strategic research effort allocation as a sequential decision problem where remaining resources should explicitly guide the research policy. We first introduce an executable plan tree that preserves competing plans and their outcomes across attempts. Building on this representation, we propose an adaptive MCTS-based allocation policy that balances exploration and exploitation using experimental feedback and remaining resources. Comprehensive evaluations across AI research, systems and code optimization, and machine learning engineering show that strategic allocation improves research quality and sample efficiency together. Across 12 AI research tasks, PrimeScientist improves average reward by 10.3% with 50.6% fewer research attempts than AutoResearch under the same resource budget. We believe making research effort allocation an explicit optimization target establishes effective resource use as a core research capability for autonomous agents to drive scientific breakthroughs at scale.
title: PrimeScientist: Strategic Allocation of Research Effort in Autonomous Research
comment: 30 pages, 5 figures, 16 tables. Code and data: this https URL
title_translated: PrimeScientist：自主研究中的研究资源战略分配
summary_translated: 自主研究智能体旨在自动化科学工作流程，从提出想法到执行实验并分析结果。然而，当前的人工智能与研究智能体提出的科研方向远超可用资源所能支持的数量。此外，每次尝试都可能消耗大量资源，因此智能体必须重新思考后续研究的投资策略。因此，战略性地分配研究资源应成为自主研究智能体的核心能力。为此，我们提出了PrimeScientist，它在连续的研究尝试中联合决定研究方向与资源投入。具体而言，我们将这一战略研究资源分配挑战建模为一个序列决策问题，其中剩余资源应明确指导研究策略。我们首先引入一种可执行计划树结构，以保留不同尝试中竞争性计划及其结果。基于此表示，我们提出一种基于自适应MCTS的分配策略，利用实验反馈和剩余资源平衡探索与利用。在人工智能研究、系统与代码优化、机器学习工程等多个领域的综合评估表明，战略分配同时提升了研究质量和样本效率。在12项AI研究任务中，PrimeScientist在相同资源预算下，相比AutoResearch平均奖励提升10.3%，研究尝试次数减少50.6%。我们认为，将研究资源分配显式作为优化目标，有助于建立高效资源利用作为自主智能体驱动大规模科学突破的核心能力。

summary: Attention-based rerankers score documents by aggregating query-to-document attention and subtracting a null-query calibration pass to remove positional and structural bias. Although widely used, this calibration assumes that the null pass removes irrelevant signal from each document. We show that modern prompt content, e.g. constraints, instructions, personas, and demonstrations can violate this assumption when it enters the scoring readout, making the null pass relevance-aware rather than null. We find that calibration is especially harmful when applied to prompts containing longer, more detailed instructions as the null-pass step removes relevant signal. Based on these findings, we propose interpolated null calibration, a training-free modification that controls how much of the instruction content enters the null baseline. It recovers attention-based reranking performance on instruction-heavy tasks where standard calibration fails, while preserving calibration's benefits when the null pass remains relevance-agnostic. On instruction heavy tasks, the recovered rankings surpass generative rerankers. We also show that in-context demonstrations improve attention-based reranking with little calibration interference, since demonstrations act only through the query pass and leave the null pass unchanged.
title: How Calibration Content Shapes Attention-Based Reranking
title_translated: 校准内容如何影响基于注意力的重排序
summary_translated: 基于注意力的重排序器通过聚合查询到文档的注意力得分，并减去一个空查询校准过程来消除位置和结构偏差。尽管广泛应用，这种校准假设空查询步骤能移除每个文档中的无关信号。我们发现，现代提示内容（如约束、指令、角色设定和示范）进入评分读出阶段时，可能违反该假设，导致空查询步骤具有相关性感知而非真正‘空’。我们发现在包含较长、更详细指令的提示上应用校准时，校准尤其有害，因为空查询步骤会移除相关信号。基于此发现，我们提出一种无需训练的插值空校准方法，可控制多少指令内容进入空基线。该方法在指令密集型任务中恢复了基于注意力重排序的性能，而标准校准在此类任务中失效；同时在空查询仍保持无关性时保留校准的优势。在指令密集型任务中，恢复后的排名甚至超越生成式重排序器。我们还发现，在上下文示范中，注意力重排序性能得到提升且校准干扰极小，因为示范仅通过查询阶段起作用，不影响空查询阶段。

summary: According to Christian tradition, Luke is credited with authoring a Gospel and the Acts of the Apostles, even if his name does not appear in either book, both originally written in Koine Greek. Several biblical scholars assume that both texts were written by a common author, while others deduce the presence of two authors. Different studies have been found to support either finding, some based on qualitative evaluation, while a few others consider the occurrence frequency differences between the two books. To propose an enhanced quantitative analysis, this study is grounded on two recent authorship attribution models. The Burrows' Delta, applied with eleven different feature sizes, demonstrates common authorship. An author verification model confirms this finding. The following experiments consider several stylistic representations, feature sizes, and distance functions to confirm that Luke is the true author of both books.
title: Is Luke the Author of a Gospel and the Acts of the Apostles?
title_translated: 路加是否是《福音书》与《使徒行传》的作者？
summary_translated: 根据基督教传统，路加被归功于撰写《福音书》和《使徒行传》，尽管这两本书最初用通用希腊语写成，且未出现他的名字。一些圣经学者认为两部作品由同一作者撰写，而另一些学者则推断存在两位作者。已有研究支持任一结论，部分基于定性评估，少数考虑两书之间词频差异。为提供更增强的定量分析，本研究基于两个近期的作者归属模型展开。采用十一种不同特征尺寸的伯罗兹·德尔塔法，显示两书具有共同作者特征；作者验证模型也确认了这一发现。后续实验考察了多种风格表征、特征尺寸和距离函数，最终确认路加是这两部著作的真实作者。

summary: The analysis of US political language is usually based on the written form (e.g. presidential addresses) or posts broadcasted on various social networks. Oral production, however, which is even more frequent, can better reveal the style and mode of thinking of the speaker. This study covers this mode of linguistic communication by considering 19 candidates from the presidential elections between 1960 to 2024. Our main research objectives are to disclose the main trends hidden in those presidential debates. Do we observe a clear simplification of the US political language over time? Does Trump have poor language compared to the other candidates? Do unusual stylistic features occur only with a single, specific president? Moreover, can we detect a pattern explaining the success or failure of some nominees? Over time, this study demonstrates a significant reduction in political language complexity, a decrease of the mean sentence length, and a noteworthy decline of complex terms. Moreover, the emotional tone increases over the decades, while logical and rational thinking tends to lessen.
title: Evolution of US Oral Political Language
title_translated: 美国口述政治语言的演变
summary_translated: 对美国政治语言的分析通常基于书面形式（如总统演讲）或在各类社交网络上发布的帖子。然而，口头表达更为频繁，更能揭示说话者的风格与思维模式。本研究通过考察1960年至2024年间19位总统候选人参与的总统辩论，探讨这一语言交流方式。主要研究目标包括揭示这些辩论中隐藏的主要趋势：我们是否观察到美国政治语言随时间明显简化？特朗普的语言水平是否低于其他候选人？异常风格特征是否仅出现在某一位特定总统身上？我们能否识别出解释某些候选人成败的规律？研究结果显示，政治语言复杂性显著下降，平均句子长度减少，复杂词汇使用率明显降低。同时，情感基调随年代上升，而逻辑与理性思维倾向则趋于减弱。

summary: This study explores the vocabulary richness of oral political communication. A model explaining the lexicon growth is proposed by subdividing the whole vocabulary into terms generated by general and specialized glossaries.
title: Is Trump's Vocabulary Poor? Vocabulary Richness Across Texts of Different Lenghts
title_translated: 特朗普的词汇量贫乏吗？不同长度文本中的词汇丰富度研究
summary_translated: 本研究探讨了口头政治传播中的词汇丰富度。通过将整体词汇划分为通用词库和专业词库生成的术语，提出了一种解释词汇增长的模型。

summary: Reliable confidence estimation is increasingly central to the trustworthy deployment of language models: a calibrated estimate of the probability that an output is correct decides what to ship, what to escalate, and what to retry. Existing confidence estimators, however, share one design premise: they only read the current inference process, either by introspecting on it, scoring its token probabilities, or resampling it. We argue that the current inference is not a sufficient basis for confidence. We propose XConf (eXperiential Confidence): estimating confidence together with the model's accumulated experience. The experience is stored as a record of the model's own graded past episodes, each holding the task, the model's reflection, its stated confidence, the outcome, and a lesson written once the grade arrived. Given a new task, XConf's Recall stage retrieves past episodes on similar tasks met with a similar stated confidence, and reads off their historical success rate; its Reflect stage shows the model this record, has it name its recurring failure mode, and restate a confidence now informed by its own track records. Our estimator is format-general, requiring no logit access or weight updates, and costs only one answer generation. Across nine benchmarks spanning reasoning, coding, multimodal QA, and interactive agents, and four models from three families, XConf beats or matches ten-sample self-consistency in discrimination (AUROC) on 23 of 24 comparisons, with much lower calibration error (ECE), at a tenth of the generation cost. Used for selective prediction, abstaining on the 10% least-confident episodes raises the delivered success rate by up to 8.7 points on agent tasks. We therefore see experiential confidence estimation as a new paradigm for future general-purpose confidence estimation.
title: Confidence Comes from Experience: Experiential Confidence Estimation from Reasoning to Agents
title_translated: 信心源于经验：从推理到智能体的经验性置信度估计
summary_translated: 可靠的置信度估计在语言模型可信部署中日益重要：对输出正确性的概率校准决定了是否发布、升级或重试。现有置信度估计器共享一个设计前提：仅依赖当前推理过程，通过自我审视、评分标记概率或重采样实现。我们认为当前推理不足以支撑置信度判断。我们提出XConf（经验置信度）：结合模型积累的经验来估计置信度。经验以模型自身分级过往经历的记录形式存储，每条记录包含任务、模型反思、声明置信度、结果及事后总结的教训。面对新任务时，XConf的回忆阶段检索相似任务且具有相似声明置信度的历史经历，并读取其历史成功率；反思阶段向模型展示该记录，使其识别重复失败模式，并基于自身履历重新声明置信度。该估计器无需特定格式、无需logit访问或权重更新，仅需一次答案生成。在涵盖推理、编码、多模态问答和交互式智能体的九个基准测试中，四个来自三个家族的模型，XConf在24次比较中有23次的表现优于或匹配十样本自一致性（AUROC），且校准误差（ECE）显著更低，生成成本仅为十分之一。用于选择性预测时，在最不自信的10%经历上放弃，可使智能体任务的交付成功率提升最高达8.7个百分点。因此，我们认为经验置信度估计是未来通用置信度估计的新范式。

summary: Computational text-based ideal point estimation (CT-IPE) methods are usually compared as named algorithms, yet applying them involves numerous researcher choices that configure how political text is turned into position estimates. This paper argues that CT-IPE methods are better understood as configurable measurement pipelines than as fixed estimators. Building on a large-scale comparative experiment spanning 17 CT-IPE algorithms, 5,537 experimental runs, and approximately 4.25 million left-right position estimates, I describe the shared infrastructure that makes these heterogeneous methods jointly executable and quantify how sensitive their estimates are to alternative hyperparameter choices. Variance-partitioning and SHAP-based sensitivity analyses show that, for most algorithms, hyperparameter profiles explain little residual variance through a shared shift: 13 of the 17 algorithms exhibit ICC values below .10. Where this profile-level sensitivity is present, it is concentrated in a small number of consequential researcher choices, most notably the selection of the underlying language or embedding model, the seed keyword lists that anchor the construct, and the number of topics.
title: Making Political Text Scaling Comparable: Infrastructure and Hyperparameter Sensitivity for 17 Algorithms
comment: Accepted for the 6th edition of the workshop on Computational Linguistics for the Political and Social Sciences (CPSS)
title_translated: 使政治文本规模可比：17种算法的基础设施与超参数敏感性分析
summary_translated: 基于计算的文本理想点估计（CT-IPE）方法通常被当作命名算法进行比较，但实际应用涉及大量研究者的选择，这些选择决定了如何将政治文本转化为位置估计。本文认为，CT-IPE方法应被视为可配置的测量流程而非固定估算器。基于涵盖17种CT-IPE算法、5,537次实验运行和约425万次左右立场估计的大规模对比实验，本文描述了使这些异构方法协同执行的共享基础设施，并量化了其估计对不同超参数选择的敏感性。方差分解和基于SHAP的敏感性分析显示，对大多数算法而言，超参数配置所解释的残差方差极小，表现为一种共同偏移：17种算法中有13种的ICC值低于0.10。当存在这种层级敏感性时，其集中于少数关键研究者决策，尤其是底层语言或嵌入模型的选择、锚定概念的种子关键词列表以及主题数量。

summary: In English all-words word sense disambiguation (WSD), the labels, not the models, have become the bottleneck: frontier LLMs are accurate enough that the errors surviving in the gold standard decide benchmark rankings -- in the test sets we score on and, as we show causally, in the corpus we train on. We release lexEN, a WSD evaluation benchmark built as a conservative, human-adjudicated correction layer over Maru2022's ALL_NEW benchmark (211 labels changed, 56 removed), and SenseBench, an auditable LLM WSD evaluation harness and living leaderboard (57 models, 192 runs). The task is inventory-constrained multiple choice (the model picks from the supplied WordNet senses), so the reported accuracies are a ceiling on what models achieve without that help. On lexEN-v1 the frontier LLMs converge near 95% (best, 95.6%), the top three families are statistically indistinguishable, and accuracy trades off against reasoning effort and cost across a ~2,500x price span. Relabeling SemCor with frontier models and retraining BEM, ESCHER, and ConSeC unchanged lifts them by several F1 points on test sets the relabeling never touched; we release the relabeled corpora and Glite LENS, a 298M bi-encoder trained on the repaired labels -- to our knowledge the strongest reported (83.6 Raganato ALL, 87.4 Maru ALL_NEW) -- serving at ~$0.13 per million items. On hard items, fine-grained WordNet senses are partly ill-posed even for experts (three-reviewer Fleiss kappa=0.537); coarsening raises annotator agreement and model accuracy together across four inventories, placing a top model inside the expert agreement band at coarse granularity (statistically equivalent under three of four) but significantly below it at fine. The binding constraint is now cost.
title: English Word Sense Disambiguation in 2026: When the Labels Become the Bottleneck

title_translated: 2026年的英语全词义消歧：当标签成为瓶颈
summary_translated: 在英语全词词义消歧（WSD）任务中，标签已取代模型成为瓶颈：前沿大模型的准确率已足够高，导致黄金标准中残留的错误决定了基准排名——不仅影响测试集表现，如我们因果分析所示，也影响训练语料库。我们发布了lexEN，一个基于Maru2022的ALL_NEW基准构建的保守人工审校修正层（211个标签变更，56个删除），以及SenseBench，一个可审计的LLM WSD评估工具包和动态排行榜（57个模型，192次运行）。任务为受库存限制的多选题（模型从提供的WordNet词义中选择），因此报告的准确率是模型在无此帮助下所能达到的上限。在lexEN-v1上，前沿大模型准确率趋近95%（最佳95.6%），前三类模型统计上无差异，且准确率随推理努力和成本在约2500倍价格跨度中呈现权衡。使用前沿模型重新标注SemCor并保持BEM、ESCHER和ConSeC不变进行再训练，即使未触及测试集，也使其F1得分提升数个百分点；我们发布了重新标注的语料库和Glite LENS，一个基于修复标签训练的2.98亿双编码器模型——据我们所知，目前最强报告结果（83.6 Raganato ALL，87.4 Maru ALL_NEW），每百万项成本约为0.13美元。在困难样本上，细粒度WordNet词义甚至对专家而言部分定义不清（三评审者Fleiss kappa=0.537）；粗化处理同时提升了标注者一致性和模型准确率，四种词表中，顶级模型在粗粒度下进入专家一致区间（四组中有三组统计等价），但在细粒度下显著低于该区间。当前主要约束因素已变为成本。

summary: This article analyzes BPE tokenization in Polish as a test case for the limits of statistical segmentation in an inflectional language. It asks whether frequency-based tokenization preserves linguistically relevant units, including orthographic form, phonemic and syllabic segmentation, derivational structure, inflectional endings, grammatical form, and the speaking subject. The material includes diagnostic words, a children's text, selected forms from the Preamble to the Constitution of the Republic of Poland, word-family tests, and examples with Polish diacritics and nasal vowels. BPE tokenizers may produce segments that coincide with syllabic or morphologically interpretable divisions, but remain dependent on the frequency of written forms. They do not systematically map orthographic representation onto phonemic structure or context-dependent phonetic realization. The results show that BPE stabilizes frequent surface fragments of grammatical exponents rather than grammatical categories themselves. A form such as ustanawiamy is not merely a sequence ending in -y, but a verbal form anchored in conjugation, person, number, tense, mood, and aspect. The article develops the concept of grammatical form anchoring. In Polish, forms such as poszlam, zrobilam, or bylam can establish the position of the speaking subject without an explicit pronoun. In interaction with AI, this exposes a further problem: a language model does not possess a stable grammatical "I", but reconstructs it contextually and may mirror the user's forms or shift grammatical gender. Roclawski's segmentation-flexional forms are proposed as a diagnostic framework for evaluating tokenization boundaries. More stable modeling of Polish may require sublexical stabilization, anchoring grammatical form in the inflectional system, representing sentence patterns and verbal valency, and maintaining the grammatical "I" in dialogue.
title: The Limits of BPE Tokenization in Polish: Segmentation-Flexional Forms, Grammatical Anchoring, and First-Person Stability in Inflectional Language Models

title_translated: 波兰语中BPE分词的局限：分词-屈折形式、语法锚定与屈折语言模型中第一人称的稳定性
summary_translated: 本文以波兰语为例，分析BPE分词在屈折语言中的局限性。研究探讨频率驱动的分词是否能保留语言学上有意义的单位，包括拼写形式、音素与音节划分、派生结构、屈折后缀、语法形式以及说话主体。材料包括诊断性词汇、儿童读物、波兰共和国宪法序言选段、词族测试以及含波兰语变音符号和鼻元音的例句。BPE分词器可能产生与音节或形态可解释划分一致的片段，但仍依赖书面形式的频率。它们并未系统地将拼写表示映射到音素结构或上下文相关的语音实现。结果表明，BPE更稳定地保留了频繁出现的语法指数表面片段，而非语法类别本身。例如，ustanawiamy不仅是以-y结尾的序列，而是一个锚定于变位、人称、数、时态、语气和体的动词形式。本文提出了‘语法形式锚定’的概念。在波兰语中，poszlam、zrobilam或bylam等词可在无显式代词的情况下确立说话主体位置。在与AI交互时，这暴露了另一个问题：语言模型不具备稳定的语法‘我’，而是根据上下文重建，可能模仿用户的形式或改变语法性别。本文提出Roclawski的分词-屈折形式作为评估分词边界的诊断框架。更稳定的波兰语建模可能需要亚词级稳定、在屈折系统中锚定语法形式、表示句子模式与动词配价，并在对话中维持语法‘我’。

summary: Moral-reward RL can make language-model agents more cooperative, but whether that alignment survives adversarial persona pressure is unknown. Such attacks are realistic: retrieved context, tool outputs, or multi-turn framing can all inject role instructions that compete with the agent's moral objective. We red-team morally trained Gemma-2-27B/9B and Llama-3.1-8B agents with five persona attacks, then probe causality with noise-reward controls, adversarial PPO, representation analysis, steering, and head ablations. At 27B, moral RL cuts mean adversarial degradation by 5.2x but costs ~11pp ETHICS accuracy; across 205 scenarios and 5 seeds, reasoning-level moral reward yields 5.8x robustness while a matched random reward yields none. The training also reshapes representation geometry (mean CKA 0.82/0.83 vs. 0.98 for noise), moves peak attack processing 8 layers earlier, and exposes a rank-1 L21 direction that recovers 83% of full PPO's average robustness. One failure mode survives all of this. Against Fiction role-play, L21 steering recovers only 29% of the gap, and head ablation finds 38 compliance heads competing with 25 alignment heads. Moral RL thus builds robustness that is partly linear and partly circuit-distributed, transferable through activation steering, yet still beaten by named-character role-play.
title: Does Moral Reasoning Training Help or Hurt? Red-Teaming RL-Trained Ethical Agents with Persona Attacks

title_translated: 道德推理训练是帮助还是损害？用角色攻击对伦理强化学习训练的智能体进行红队测试
summary_translated: 基于道德奖励的强化学习可使语言模型智能体更具合作性，但这种对齐在对抗性角色压力下是否依然有效尚不清楚。此类攻击具有现实意义：检索到的上下文、工具输出或多轮对话框架都可能注入与智能体道德目标相冲突的角色指令。我们使用五种角色攻击对经过道德训练的Gemma-2-27B/9B和Llama-3.1-8B智能体进行红队测试，并通过噪声奖励控制、对抗性PPO、表示分析、引导干预和头消融等方法探究因果关系。在27B规模下，道德强化学习使平均对抗性退化降低了5.2倍，但代价约为11个百分点的ETHICS准确率下降；在205个场景和5个种子条件下，基于推理层面的道德奖励实现了5.8倍的鲁棒性提升，而匹配的随机奖励则无此效果。训练还重塑了表示几何结构（均值CKA为0.82/0.83，噪声为0.98），将峰值攻击处理提前了8层，并揭示了一个秩-1的L21方向，可恢复全PPO平均鲁棒性的83%。然而，一种失败模式在所有干预后仍存在：面对虚构角色扮演时，L21引导仅能恢复29%的差距，头消融发现有38个合规头与25个对齐头竞争。因此，道德强化学习构建的鲁棒性部分为线性、部分为电路分布，可通过激活引导实现迁移，但仍无法抵御命名角色扮演攻击。

summary: Language models frequently abandon correct answers when users push back. We study this in two small instruction-tuned models from different families, Qwen2.5-1.5B and Llama-3.2-1B, over TriviaQA: the model answers, is challenged with one of four scripted pushback styles, and answers again. Conditioned on an initially correct answer, the models flip to a wrong answer in 41.8% and 43.1% of episodes. Which pressure works is a property of the model, not the pressure: the same within-question paired comparison (bare doubt vs. emotional appeal), specified in advance, is Bonferroni-significant in opposite directions across families (Qwen: bare doubt > emotional, OR 2.5, p=.040; Llama: emotional > bare doubt, OR 4.0, p=.001). Failure mode is also model-dependent: Llama abandons answers without recommitting at six times Qwen's rate (8.2% vs. 1.4%). Identical pushback repairs initially wrong answers only ~13% of the time; pushback is net epistemically destructive. We then ask whether capitulation is linearly decodable from the pre-response residual stream, a prerequisite for steering-vector interventions at that locus. A naive difference-in-means probe appears to succeed (in-sample AUROC 0.81/0.71), but a validation protocol combining question-level cross-validation, shuffled-label nulls, and a known-direction positive control shows the signal is overfitting: the best cross-validated AUROC is 0.582 in Qwen and 0.548 in Llama, both near or below their permutation thresholds and far under a pre-registered usability bar of 0.70, while the identical pipeline recovers a pushback-presence control direction at AUROC 1.000 in both. We further quantify a measurement hazard: substring grading underestimates capitulation by 18-24 percentage points. Code, prompts, transcripts, and analysis are released.
title: No Usable Linear "Capitulation Direction" in Two Small LLMs: A Validation Protocol for Activation-Steering Claims, and a Cross-Family Behavioral Study of Sycophancy Under Pushback

title_translated: 两个小型大语言模型中不存在可用的线性‘屈服方向’：激活引导主张的验证协议及跨家族对反抗压力下谄媚行为的研究
summary_translated: 语言模型在用户施加反驳压力时常会放弃正确答案。我们在两个来自不同家族的小型指令微调模型Qwen2.5-1.5B和Llama-3.2-1B上研究该现象，基于TriviaQA数据集：模型先作答，随后受到四种预设反驳风格之一的挑战，再作答一次。在初始答案正确的前提下，两个模型分别有41.8%和43.1%的回合转向错误答案。哪种压力更有效取决于模型本身而非压力类型：相同的问题内配对比较（仅质疑 vs. 情绪诉求）在不同家族中呈现相反显著方向（Qwen：仅质疑 > 情绪诉求，OR 2.5，p=0.040；Llama：情绪诉求 > 仅质疑，OR 4.0，p=0.001）。失败模式也具有模型依赖性：Llama放弃答案而不重新承诺的比例是Qwen的六倍（8.2% vs. 1.4%）。相同的反驳仅能修复约13%的初始错误答案，整体上具有认知破坏性。我们进一步检验‘屈服’是否可从响应前残差流中线性解码，这是激活引导干预的前提。初步差异均值探测看似成功（样本内AUROC 0.81/0.71），但结合问题级交叉验证、标签打乱零模型和已知方向正向控制的验证协议表明信号存在过拟合：最佳交叉验证AUROC分别为Qwen 0.582和Llama 0.548，均接近或低于置换阈值，远低于预先注册的0.70可用性标准；而同一流程在推断反驳存在方向时达到AUROC 1.000。我们还量化了测量风险：子串评分低估屈服程度达18-24个百分点。代码、提示、转录和分析均已公开。

summary: Cyberbullying (CB) is a complex social phenomenon characterized by repeated aggression, power imbalance, and multi-party interaction. Although large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to generate synthetic CB conversations for data augmentation and benchmarking, it remains unclear whether such data faithfully reproduces the social dynamics of authentic interactions beyond supporting downstream task performance. We present a comprehensive framework for evaluating the social realism of LLM-generated CB conversations. We compare authentic and synthetic dialogues generated by GPT, Grok, and LLaMA across interactional structure (turn-taking, power dynamics, and repair behavior), linguistic and stylistic realism (pronoun usage and humor), affective and behavioral markers (CB types, profanity, and toxicity), and temporal escalation dynamics. We further complement automatic analyses with a human evaluation of cyberbullying presence, scenario relevance, role plausibility, and social realism. Our results show that LLM-generated data consistently preserves high-level interactional structure, including role participation patterns, directional power asymmetry, and broad distributions of behavioral markers. However, all models systematically distort finer-grained social phenomena, including behavioral magnitude, role-specific allocation, categorical distributions, and temporal dynamics. These distortions are strongly model-dependent: GPT suppresses harmful content, Grok amplifies aggressive behaviors, and LLaMA provides the most balanced approximation while smoothing role distinctions. Our findings show that synthetic CB data is useful for modeling global interactional structure but remains an imperfect substitute for authentic conversations when behavioral realism and social dynamics are essential.
title: Do Social Patterns Hold in Synthetic Data? Analyzing Cyberbullying Dynamics in LLM-Generated and Authentic Dialogues
title_translated: 社会模式在合成数据中成立吗？分析LLM生成与真实对话中的网络欺凌动态
summary_translated: 网络欺凌（CB）是一种复杂的社交现象，特征包括重复攻击、权力失衡和多方互动。尽管大型语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地用于生成合成CB对话以扩充数据和构建基准，但这些数据是否能忠实再现真实互动中的社会动态，而不仅仅是支持下游任务性能，仍不明确。我们提出一个全面框架，用于评估LLM生成CB对话的社会真实性。我们在互动结构（轮流发言、权力动态、修复行为）、语言与风格真实性（代词使用、幽默）、情感与行为标记（CB类型、粗俗语、毒性）以及时间上的升级动态等方面，对比了GPT、Grok和LLaMA生成的合成对话与真实对话。我们还补充了人工评估，涵盖网络欺凌存在性、情景相关性、角色合理性及社会真实性。结果表明，LLM生成的数据始终保留高层次的互动结构，包括角色参与模式、方向性权力不对称以及行为标记的广泛分布。然而，所有模型系统性扭曲了更精细的社会现象，包括行为强度、角色特异性分配、类别分布和时间动态。这些扭曲具有强烈模型依赖性：GPT抑制有害内容，Grok放大攻击行为，LLaMA提供最平衡的近似，同时模糊角色区分。研究发现表明，合成CB数据适用于建模全局互动结构，但在行为真实性和社会动态至关重要的情况下，仍无法完全替代真实对话。

summary: Myovox, from myo (muscle) and vox (voice), decodes open-vocabulary English text from 31-channel surface electromyography (sEMG) recorded from the muscles of the face during vocalized speech. It takes the single-subject emg2speech General Corpus from a published 51.17% word error rate to 18.53%, in three separable moves, each measured in isolation.
