Evaluated on the XARES-LLM benchmark with a frozen SmolLM2-135M backbone (LoRA-adapted) via five-fold cross-validation, CUES consistently identifies the same configuration per track from held-out development splits alone, without using test data for selection. For the broad Track~A suite, CUES selects a cross-family trio (Whisper-medium, mHuBERT-147, and Dasheng-base), achieving a 4.3% relative gain over Whisper-medium (0.771 vs. 0.739). For Track~B text generation, it re-anchors on a focused, speech-only pair (mHuBERT-147 and WavLM-base-plus) and actively abstains from adding a divergent encoder, outperforming mHuBERT-147 by 6.3% (0.589 vs. 0.554). Rather than a failure to scale, this divergence is consistent with a diversity--interference trade-off that CUES navigates per track from correlation signals alone: across the evaluated pool, added cross-family diversity tends toward an inverted-U on broad audio tasks but toward steady degradation on text generation, which favors a focused, speech-anchored set.
title: Correlation-Guided Encoder Selection for Multi-Encoder Large Audio-Language Models
title_translated: 基于相关性的多编码器大音频-语言模型编码器选择
summary_translated: 多编码器融合将大音频-语言模型（LALMs）扩展至超越语音中心的识别任务，但通过直觉或穷举搜索选择编码器往往引入冗余表示，并加剧本已受限的计算预算。我们提出 CUES（相关性引导的编码器选择），一种轻量级启发式方法，通过编码器性能表现之间的任务级和类别级皮尔逊相关性来估计互补性，仅需单编码器评估即可完成候选集评分——无需在选择过程中进行融合训练。在 XARES-LLM 基准测试上，使用冻结的 SmolLM2-135M 主干（LoRA 适配）并通过五折交叉验证评估，CUES 仅从保留的开发集即可一致地识别出每首曲目的相同配置，无需使用测试数据进行选择。对于广泛的 Track A 套件，CUES 选择了跨家族三元组（Whisper-medium、mHuBERT-147 和 Dasheng-base），相比 Whisper-medium 提升了 4.3%（0.771 vs. 0.739）。对于 Track B 文本生成任务，它重新锚定于聚焦的语音专用双编码器组合（mHuBERT-147 和 WavLM-base-plus），主动避免引入差异较大的编码器，相比 mHuBERT-147 提升 6.3%（0.589 vs. 0.554）。这种分歧并非扩展失败，而是与多样性-干扰权衡一致，CUES 仅通过相关性信号即可在不同任务间实现平衡：在评估池中，跨家族多样性在广泛音频任务上呈现倒U型趋势，但在文本生成任务上则导致持续退化，表明后者更偏好聚焦于语音的集合。

summary: Lightweight audio-visual speech enhancement (AVSE) models face a critical trade-off between computational efficiency and cross-modal alignment accuracy. While simple concatenation lacks relational expressiveness, dense cross-attention incurs computational overhead and is prone to unreliable cross-modal correspondence under strong acoustic interference. We propose Sparse Graph-Guided Mamba (SG-Mamba), a lightweight AVSE framework that integrates a sparse heterogeneous graph with a linear-complexity Mamba backbone. The graph explicitly models modality-specific relations through content-adaptive attention and cross-frame audio-visual connections, while Mamba captures long-range temporal context. We further introduce an audio skip connection to preserve spectral detail without sacrificing noise suppression. Evaluated on LRS3, SG-Mamba achieves competitive or superior performance against strong lightweight baselines and reaches 13.091 dB SI-SDR under noise-only condition. It also remains robust in cluttered multi-speaker conditions with a competitive cost of 3.45 G MACs (or 6.90 G FLOPs). Results on VoxCeleb2 further suggest that explicit structural priors improve robustness, generalizability, and computational efficiency in lightweight AVSE.
title: G-Mamba: Sparse Graph-Guided Mamba for Audio-Visual Speech Enhancement
title_translated: G-Mamba：用于音视频语音增强的稀疏图引导 Mamba
summary_translated: 轻量级音视频语音增强（AVSE）模型面临计算效率与跨模态对齐精度之间的关键权衡。简单的拼接缺乏关系表达能力，而密集的跨注意力带来计算开销，并在强声学干扰下容易出现不可靠的跨模态对应。我们提出稀疏图引导 Mamba（SG-Mamba），一种轻量级 AVSE 框架，将稀疏异构图与线性复杂度的 Mamba 主干相结合。图结构通过内容自适应注意力和跨帧音视频连接显式建模模态特异性关系，而 Mamba 则捕捉长时序上下文。我们还引入音频跳跃连接，在不牺牲降噪能力的前提下保留频谱细节。在 LRS3 上的评估显示，SG-Mamba 在与强大轻量基线的对比中表现优异或更优，在仅噪声条件下达到 13.091 dB 的 SI-SDR。在嘈杂的多人说话场景中也保持鲁棒性，计算成本仅为 3.45 G MACs（或 6.90 G FLOPs）。VoxCeleb2 上的结果进一步表明，显式的结构先验可提升轻量级 AVSE 的鲁棒性、泛化能力和计算效率。

summary: Speech Large Language Models (Speech-LLMs), typically built from a pre-trained speech encoder, a modality projector, and an LLM fine-tuned with Low-Rank Adapters (LoRA), have shown strong Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) performance on general-domain speech. However, adapting them to domain-shifted speech, such as child or dialectal speech, remains challenging under limited target-domain data. Given the dominant role of the LLM in Speech-LLMs, with cross-entropy loss applied only at the LLM output, the speech encoder may receive insufficient adaptation to new acoustic conditions. In this paper, we propose Encoder Awakening via Adapters (EAVA), a simple yet effective domain-adaptive fine-tuning method for Speech-LLM-based ASR. First, lightweight adapters are inserted into each encoder layer and trained exclusively, enabling target-domain acoustic knowledge to be incorporated into the encoder while preserving its pre-trained knowledge. Second, the full model is jointly fine-tuned on the target domain with LoRA applied to the LLM. Experiments on three domain-shifted ASR datasets, covering child and dialectal speech, show that EAVA consistently outperforms vanilla fine-tuning and other baselines, achieving new state-of-the-art performance.
title: Encoder Awakening via Adapters: Effective Domain-Adaptive Fine-tuning of Speech-LLMs
title_translated: 通过适配器唤醒编码器：面向语音-大语言模型的有效领域自适应微调
summary_translated: 语音大语言模型（Speech-LLMs）通常由预训练语音编码器、模态投影器和使用低秩适配器（LoRA）微调的大语言模型组成，在通用语音领域表现出强大的自动语音识别（ASR）性能。然而，在有限目标领域数据下，将其适应于儿童语音或方言等域偏移语音仍具挑战性。鉴于大语言模型在 Speech-LLMs 中占据主导地位，且交叉熵损失仅作用于大语言模型输出，语音编码器可能无法充分适应新的声学条件。本文提出通过适配器唤醒编码器（EAVA），一种简单而有效的基于 Speech-LLM 的 ASR 领域自适应微调方法。首先，在每个编码器层插入轻量级适配器并单独训练，使目标领域的声学知识得以融入编码器，同时保留其预训练知识。其次，将整个模型在目标领域联合微调，对大语言模型应用 LoRA。在涵盖儿童和方言语音的三个域偏移 ASR 数据集上的实验表明，EAVA 持续优于基线方法，实现了新的最先进性能。

summary: Long-context LLM inference is bottlenecked by attention, whose repeated KV-cache reads make decoding memory-bound. Self-speculative decoding alleviates this by drafting tokens with sparse attention and verifying them with full attention, but existing batched methods remain synchronized: all requests in a batch share a single draft-verify schedule, even though the optimal draft length varies widely across requests and changes dynamically within each request. We propose ASPIRE, a non-synchronized batched self-speculative decoding framework built on three components. First, a unified mixed forward allows drafting and verifying requests to coexist in the same batched forward pass, removing the need for global draft-verify phases. Second, a lightweight online speculation scheduler uses per-request acceptance-rate estimates and a batch-aware cost model to let each request independently choose when to verify. Third, an intra-draft refresh layer performs full attention at a single designated layer during drafting, updating the sparse context at every draft step to reduce staleness during drafting. Across three models and five reasoning and long-context benchmarks, ASPIRE achieves $1.70$-$4.58\times$ speedup in decoding throughput over autoregressive baselines and improves average speedup by approximately $27\%$ over the strongest prior self-speculative baselines.
title: ASPIRE: Asynchronous Batched Self-Speculative Decoding for Long-Context LLM Inference
title_translated: ASPIRE：用于长上下文大语言模型推理的异步批处理自推测解码
summary_translated: 长上下文大语言模型推理受制于注意力机制，其重复的 KV 缓存读取使解码成为内存瓶颈。自推测解码通过稀疏注意力草拟 token 并用全注意力验证来缓解此问题，但现有的批处理方法仍保持同步：批内所有请求共享单一草拟-验证调度，尽管最优草拟长度在不同请求间差异巨大且在每个请求内部动态变化。我们提出 ASPIRE，一种非同步批处理自推测解码框架，包含三个组件。第一，统一的混合前向传播允许草拟和验证请求共存于同一批处理前向传递中，消除了全局草拟-验证阶段的需求。第二，轻量级在线推测调度器利用每个请求的接受率估计和批处理感知的成本模型，使每个请求可独立决定何时验证。第三，内部草拟刷新层在草拟过程中于指定层执行全注意力，每一步草拟都更新稀疏上下文，减少草拟过程中的过时问题。在三个模型和五个推理与长上下文基准测试中，ASPIRE 相较于自回归基线实现了 1.70–4.58 倍的解码吞吐量加速，平均速度提升约 27% 超过最强的先前自推测基线。

summary: We study the problem of demonstration selection, which involves selecting a subset of examples for prepending to a query to a language model. This problem is closely related to in-context learning and language model inference. Since the inference cost of a transformer model scales quadratically with sequence length, the selection problem becomes especially challenging in a long-context scenario. In this paper, we tackle this problem by building on state space models (SSMs), which require only linear inference time given the input. Our approach involves two algorithms. The first learns a small set of SSMs through distillation of a (trained) transformer model. We partition all the layers into consecutive groups. Then for each group, we estimate a separate state space model to replicate the input-output behavior within the adjacent layers. Second, we map the distilled model outputs to a small set of tokens, and apply these embeddings for demonstration selection in downstream applications. We perform extensive experiments in both synthetic and real-world datasets to validate our approach. We demonstrate that the distilled SSMs only incur an approximation error of less than $0.7\%$ relative to the true output. In downstream evaluation, we show that on several text classification and reasoning tasks, our approach reduces FLOPs by $14.2\times$ and improves accuracy by $6.48\%$ relative to baseline demonstration selection methods.
title: Long-Context Demonstration Selection Using State Space Models
title_translated: 基于状态空间模型的长上下文示范选择
summary_translated: 我们研究了示范选择问题，即从一组示例中选取子集并将其前置到语言模型的查询中。该问题与上下文学习和语言模型推理密切相关。由于Transformer模型的推理成本随序列长度呈二次增长，因此在长上下文场景下该问题尤为挑战。本文通过构建状态空间模型（SSMs）来解决这一问题，因为SSMs在给定输入的情况下仅需线性推理时间。我们的方法包含两个算法：首先通过蒸馏训练好的Transformer模型来学习一组小型SSMs，将所有层划分为连续组，并为每组估计一个独立的状态空间模型以复现相邻层间的输入输出行为；其次，我们将蒸馏后的模型输出映射到一组少量标记，并利用这些嵌入在下游应用中进行示范选择。我们在合成数据集和真实世界数据集上进行了大量实验以验证该方法。结果表明，蒸馏后的SSMs相对于真实输出的近似误差小于0.7%。在下游评估中，我们的方法在多个文本分类和推理任务上相比基线示范选择方法，减少了14.2倍的FLOPs，并提升了6.48%的准确率。

summary: Real-world intelligent systems increasingly operate under open-world conditions, where user intents are not fixed or exhaustively known a priori and may evolve as new interaction patterns emerge. This paper proposes a unified uncertainty-aware probabilistic framework for continual new intent discovery under an evolving label space. Each utterance is encoded through an adaptive $β$-VAE into a latent mean, used for classification and density modelling and a posterior uncertainty estimate acting as a global reliability signal. Classifier confidence, posterior uncertainty and DP-GMM likelihood are combined through a multi-signal decision mechanism to distinguish known intents from potentially novel samples. Candidate novel instances are clustered through a density-based discovery module and only reliable clusters are promoted to new labels, enabling controlled label-space expansion. Replay and Elastic Weight Consolidation mitigate catastrophic forgetting and preserve previously acquired knowledge. The paper formalises continual intent discovery as a structured multi-phase open-world problem, introduces adaptive label-space expansion under stability--plasticity constraints and uses posterior uncertainty to regulate trusted-sample selection, pseudo-labelling, novelty admission and replay. Experiments show high novelty precision, stable adaptation across sequential phases and limited forgetting. Near-zero NMI and ARI indicate limited reconstruction of the complete fine-grained intent taxonomy, consistent with the framework's conservative promotion strategy. Qualitative analyses nevertheless reveal dense and locally coherent semantic clusters, showing that reliable novel structures can be discovered without exhaustive recovery of the underlying taxonomy.
title: Uncertainty-Aware Continual Learning for Open-World Intent Discovery Under an evolving Label Space
title_translated: 面向开放世界意图发现的不确定性感知持续学习：在不断演化的标签空间下
summary_translated: 现实世界中的智能系统越来越多地在开放世界条件下运行，用户意图并非固定且事先完全可知，随着新交互模式的出现而不断演变。本文提出了一种统一的不确定性感知概率框架，用于在不断演化的标签空间下实现持续的新意图发现。每个语句通过自适应的β-VAE编码为潜在均值，用于分类、密度建模以及生成后验不确定性估计，作为全局可靠性信号。通过多信号决策机制结合分类器置信度、后验不确定性与DP-GMM似然，以区分已知意图与潜在新样本。候选新实例通过基于密度的发现模块聚类，仅可靠聚类被提升为新标签，从而实现受控的标签空间扩展。回放机制和弹性权重巩固缓解灾难性遗忘，保留先前获得的知识。本文将持续意图发现形式化为结构化的多阶段开放世界问题，引入在稳定-可塑性约束下的自适应标签空间扩展，并利用后验不确定性调节可信样本选择、伪标签、新颖性接纳和回放过程。实验显示高新颖性精度、跨序列阶段的稳定适应以及有限遗忘。接近零的NMI和ARI表明对完整细粒度意图分类体系的重建有限，这与框架保守的标签提升策略一致。定性分析则揭示出密集且局部语义连贯的聚类，表明即使不完全恢复底层分类体系，也能发现可靠的新型结构。

summary: We present NeMo Data Designer (NDD), an open-source, general-purpose framework for multi-modal synthetic data generation (SDG). Designed to be intuitive to use, NDD provides a declarative configuration format in which human and/or agent users define each dataset column, with column types spanning text, code, structured outputs, images, embeddings, and statistical samplers that are explicitly configured to steer dataset diversity. Additional column types and functionality can be introduced using the framework's flexible plugin system. NDD's configuration is an inspectable artifact, supporting workflow sharing and reproducibility. SDG is an inherently iterative process. NDD therefore builds a preview-and-revision loop into its core workflow, allowing users to generate and inspect a small number of records, refine the specification, and rerun generation at full scale. At runtime, NDD resolves dependencies, schedules calls to user-provided model endpoints, and retries failed requests. We describe NDD's architecture and programming model and present case studies spanning structured, agentic, multimodal, and domain-specialized tasks, including datasets used in Nemotron model development and in production enterprise deployments.
title: NeMo Data Designer: An Extensible Framework for Multimodal Synthetic Data Generation
title_translated: NeMo数据设计师：一个多模态合成数据生成的可扩展框架
summary_translated: 我们介绍了NeMo数据设计师（NDD），一个开源的通用多模态合成数据生成（SDG）框架。NDD设计为易于使用，提供声明式配置格式，允许人类或代理用户定义每个数据集列，列类型涵盖文本、代码、结构化输出、图像、嵌入以及显式配置以引导数据集多样性的统计采样器。通过灵活的插件系统，还可引入额外的列类型和功能。NDD的配置是一个可检查的产物，支持工作流共享与可复现性。合成数据生成本质上是迭代过程，因此NDD在其核心工作流中融入了预览与修订循环，使用户能够生成并检查少量记录，优化规范后重新大规模运行生成。运行时，NDD解析依赖关系，调度调用用户提供的模型端点，并重试失败请求。我们描述了NDD的架构与编程模型，并展示了涵盖结构化、代理型、多模态及领域专用任务的案例研究，包括Nemotron模型开发中使用的数据集以及生产级企业部署中的数据。

summary: A large language model (LLM) agent can follow more graph paths without acquiring more independent evidence. GraphEcho tests whether agents mistake these repeated encounters for additional corroboration. The benchmark varies path counts and evidential origins while holding evidence content fixed, and evaluates both judgments and active exploration. Controlled synthetic experiments reveal model-dependent judgment shifts, but redundant supporting paths increase the share of repeated walks across all evaluated frozen agents. Provenance-aware post-training (PAPT) reduces revisits and improves synthetic accuracy, yet covers fewer distinct sources. On scientific claims, it continues to reduce repetition while accuracy declines. These findings expose a gap between efficient exploration and effective evidence use: an agent can learn to stop repeating itself while overlooking information it needs. GraphEcho provides a controlled way to evaluate both what graph agents conclude and whether their exploration reaches distinct evidential sources.
title: GraphEcho: Structural Redundancy and Evidence Provenance in LLM Graph Agents
title_translated: GraphEcho：大语言模型图代理中的结构冗余与证据溯源
summary_translated: 大型语言模型（LLM）代理可以在不获取更多独立证据的情况下遍历更多图路径。GraphEcho测试代理是否会将这些重复经历误认为额外的佐证。该基准在保持证据内容不变的前提下，变化路径数量和证据来源，评估代理的判断与主动探索行为。受控的合成实验揭示了模型依赖的判断偏移，但冗余的支持路径增加了所有评估冻结代理中重复行走的比例。具有溯源意识的后训练（PAPT）减少了重复访问并提高了合成准确性，但覆盖的独立来源更少。在科学主张任务中，尽管准确性下降，PAPT仍持续减少重复。这些发现揭示了高效探索与有效证据利用之间的差距：代理可能学会停止重复自身，却忽视了所需信息。GraphEcho提供了一种受控方式，用于评估图代理得出的结论及其探索是否触及不同的证据来源。

summary: Three recent results describe what look like unrelated LLM reliability problems. Yin et al. (2026) show reasoning RL collapses tool-reliability representations. Suleymanov et al. (2026) show that under safety-constrained generation, large models rewrite flagged spans while small models truncate. Bastounis et al. (2024) prove any consistent-reasoning system without an implicit "I don't know" function must hallucinate infinitely often on broad problem classes. We argue these findings converge on a single intervention: calibrated abstention is what each independently identifies as the missing capability, even though the unavailability they document, a capability gap, a policy gap, and a recursion-theoretic gap, has a different source in each case. Honesty post-training has narrowed the gap in deployed models, but principled closure of the class Bastounis identifies requires a calibrated abstention function whose training signal at the leaderboard level is absent: dominant benchmarks assign zero reward to decline, so the leaderboard gradient that would select for the function does not exist. We propose four changes to evaluation: triple-scoring, abstention-rate reporting, capability-stratified evaluation, and mandatory calibration metrics. Benchmark reform is necessary, not sufficient, for closing the gap the theorem identifies.
title: The Missing "I Don't Know": Why Three Reasoning-Reliability Findings Converge on Calibrated Abstention
comment: 12 pages, 4 tables. Accepted to AACL-IJCNLP 2026 (main conference)
title_translated: 缺失的‘我不知道’：为何三种推理可靠性发现汇聚于校准性回避
summary_translated: 三项近期研究描述了看似无关的大型语言模型（LLM）可靠性问题。Yin等人（2026）指出，推理强化学习会破坏工具可靠性表示；Suleymanov等人（2026）发现，在安全约束生成下，大模型会重写被标记段落，而小模型则截断；Bastounis等人（2024）证明，任何没有隐含‘我不知道’功能的一致性推理系统，在广泛问题类别上必然无限次产生幻觉。我们认为这些发现汇聚于单一干预措施：校准性回避是各方独立识别出的缺失能力，尽管其不可用的原因——能力缺口、政策缺口、递归理论缺口——在每种情况下各不相同。诚实后训练已在部署模型中缩小了这一差距，但要严格闭合Bastounis所识别的类别，需要一个校准性回避函数，而该函数在排行榜层面缺乏训练信号：主流基准对拒绝行为给予零奖励，因此无法形成选择该函数的梯度。我们提议四项评估改革：三重评分、回避率报告、能力分层评估以及强制校准指标。基准改革虽必要，但不足以填补该定理所揭示的差距。

summary: When agentic sessions run to a million tokens with many sessions resident at once, the KV cache and the index that ranks it live in host memory, and the scan that ranks all n keys for a top-k step becomes the traffic that bounds decoding. We present Fathom, a key scan in which each query decides how many bits of each key channel to read. The 4-bit K cache is stored channel-major as bit planes, so a prefix of t planes is exactly the channel's t-bit quantizer, and the query spends its bit budget by reverse water-filling over the variance-weighted importance of its channels. At one million tokens on Qwen3-8B a decode step is 1.67x faster in GPU time than with the 136-bit scans of Double Sparsity, Loki and SparQ r=32, and in the same GPU time as SparQ's 68-bit read (r=16) Fathom reads 18% fewer bytes with lower attention error on six of seven model and context settings. On RULER-style tasks every per-token scan matches exact top-k decoding, and on real coding-agent sessions Fathom reaches the step agreement of the most accurate 136-bit scan at 92 bits. The store is the 4-bit K copy a quantized serving stack already holds, and the method is not faster when the index is resident in GPU memory.
title: Fathom: Per-Query Read Depth for Sparse Decoding over Offloaded KV Caches
title_translated: Fathom：针对离线KV缓存稀疏解码的按查询读取深度
summary_translated: 当智能体会话在同时运行数百万个token且多个会话驻留时，KV缓存及其排序索引位于主机内存中，对所有n个键进行top-k步骤排序的扫描成为解码的瓶颈。我们提出Fathom，一种查询可自适应决定每个键通道读取位数的关键扫描方法。4比特K缓存以通道优先方式存储为比特平面，前t个平面恰好构成该通道的t比特量化器，查询通过在通道重要性（基于方差加权）上反向水填的方式消耗其比特预算。在Qwen3-8B模型上处理一百万token时，Fathom的解码步骤比Double Sparsity、Loki和SparQ r=32的136比特扫描快1.67倍GPU时间，且与SparQ的68比特读取（r=16）在相同GPU时间内完成，但Fathom读取的字节数减少18%，并在七种设置中的六种上表现出更低的注意力误差。在RULER风格任务中，每个token的扫描均匹配精确的top-k解码；在真实编码代理会话中，Fathom仅用92比特即可达到最准确136比特扫描的步骤一致性。该存储方案利用了量化服务栈已有的4比特K副本，当索引驻留在GPU内存中时，该方法并无加速优势。

summary: Large language model (LLM) trading agents can combine market data, news, and executable analysis, but their behavior is often controlled by static hand-written tool-use policies that are fixed before deployment. This limits their ability to adapt how they gather evidence, invoke tools, verify signals, and manage risk under changing market regimes. We introduce EvolveTrade, a self-evolving framework that treats the system prompt of a tool-using trading agent as a text-parameterized policy. After each update interval, a Policy Agent revises this policy using accumulated decision traces and realized portfolio feedback, while keeping the backbone LLM fixed. The updated policy is then used for the next batch of trading decisions, enabling the agent to refine its information-acquisition and portfolio-construction procedure over time. Experiments across multiple market regimes and two LLM backbones show that EvolveTrade often improves Sharpe Ratio and Cumulative Return over fixed-policy LLM baselines, achieving the improved SR and CR in most evaluated settings. Behavioral analyses further show that self-evolved policies increase code-mediated analysis and activate regime-relevant computations; case-level policy-to-return attributions trace how policy-induced allocation changes contribute to realized return differences. These results suggest that adapting the reusable procedure governing tool use is a key direction for building more robust LLM trading agents.
title: EvolveTrade: Experience-Driven Policy Refinement for Self-Evolving LLM Trading Agents
title_translated: EvolveTrade：面向自演化大语言模型交易智能体的经验驱动策略优化
summary_translated: 大语言模型（LLM）交易智能体能够整合市场数据、新闻和可执行分析，但其行为通常受静态的手写工具使用策略控制，这些策略在部署前即固定不变，限制了其在不同市场环境下适应性地调整证据收集、工具调用、信号验证和风险管控的能力。我们提出EvolveTrade，一个自演化框架，将使用工具的交易智能体的系统提示视为文本参数化的策略。每次更新周期后，策略智能体利用累积的决策轨迹和实际投资组合反馈来修订该策略，同时保持骨干LLM不变。更新后的策略用于下一阶段的交易决策，使智能体能够随时间不断优化其信息获取与组合构建过程。在多种市场环境及两种LLM骨干上的实验表明，EvolveTrade通常优于固定策略的LLM基线，在大多数评估场景中提升了夏普比率（Sharpe Ratio）和累计回报（Cumulative Return）。行为分析进一步显示，自演化的策略增强了代码驱动的分析，并激活与市场状态相关的计算；案例级的策略-回报归因分析揭示了策略引起的配置变化如何贡献于实际回报差异。结果表明，动态调整控制工具使用的可复用流程是构建更稳健LLM交易智能体的关键方向。
